passages.title: In the Southern Urals, business came up with how to develop medical tourism
passages.passage: According to South Ural entrepreneurs, public-private partnership can contribute to the expansion of the presence of business in the field of social services.  For example, such their type as medical tourism is not yet developing too actively, while the country has set a goal to quadruple the export of health services by 2024 - up to a million dollars a year.  What business and the authorities of the Chelyabinsk region should do for this, the correspondent of "RG" found out.  There are also a lot of non-resident patients in Yekaterinburg.  After the procedures, they could not be bored in the hospital, but to see the sights.  Photo: Tatyana Andreeva / RG Better you to us In the Southern Urals, dentists began to attract patients "from the outside", then ophthalmologists, traumatologists, and other narrow specialists began to occupy market niches.  There are also multi-purpose centers that receive visitors.  This even caused talk that, they say, strangers will create a queue, and there are not enough medical facilities for their own...  Such fears are devoid of grounds, said the vice-president of the Chelyabinsk branch of the “Support of Russia ” candidate of medical Sciences Alexei Larin.  Yes, he notes, there are problems with the primary link in the region, they must be solved.  But in the field of specialized assistance, there is a reserve - it is possible to increase its volumes several times rather quickly.  Dmitry Dovbnya, Chairman of the Committee on Tourism of the Chelyabinsk branch of OPORA, notes: it is necessary to distinguish between medical exports and tourism.  The first is tied exclusively to the consumption of medical services: residents of other regions or countries came, received assistance, left back.  The range of services of the second is wider.  For example, there are procedures, such as IVF, that require the patient to live near the clinic for some time.  Waiting he "compensates" acquaintance with the city, its sights.  Sanatorium patients are even more active in this regard.  The districts of Sochi and Kavminvod have long demonstrated how beneficial the arrival of people whose goal is to improve their health can be for the territory.  This experience should be used in the Southern Urals, which was once the health resort of the entire industrial Urals: local lakes went from Yekaterinburg, Tyumen, Perm, northern regions, those who are contraindicated in a sharp change in climate.  The task of the business is to expand the range of purely tourist services for such guests.  When the South Urals go to be treated in other regions, this is also medical tourism, but at the same time the Chelyabinsk region loses an amount close to a billion rubles.  Irina Gekht, the first vice-governor in charge of social issues, draws attention to the fact that along with the export of medical services there are also imports.  When the South Urals go to be treated in other regions, this is also medical tourism, but at the same time the Chelyabinsk region loses an amount close to a billion rubles.  Therefore, it is interested in attracting consumers of services from other regions, for the provision of which it has the necessary competencies.  Speech, in particular, about transplantation, pediatric neurosurgery, a number of other areas where Chelyabinsk doctors work at the level of European standards.  Alexey Larin lists: private clinics of the region are able to provide high-tech assistance in the field of oncology, ophthalmology, traumatology and orthopedics, obstetrics and gynecology...  What attracts foreign patients?  In some countries, Dmitry Dovbnya notes, due to traditional specifics or policies aimed at limiting the birth rate, a number of medical services have been banned.  In China, it is in vitro fertilization, in Arab countries - laser treatment.  Residents of China are also interested in dental services - here they are cheaper than in their homeland.  Among the clients of private medicine, there are many former compatriots who left for Germany, Israel, scattered around the world.  They often visit relatives, and the price and quality of medical services encourage them to seek help in Chelyabinsk clinics: in developed countries, similar treatment for the family budget is much more burdensome.  Frequent guests in medical institutions of the region and residents of Kazakhstan.  Moreover, it is they who form the main flow from the near abroad.  Director and chief physician of the private medical center Elena Kolyada said that 95 percent of all international appeals to her institution are accounted for by residents of the neighboring republic.  Among the most popular services are IVF, surgical treatment, polyclinic examination, pediatrician consultations.  Many, as, indeed, all over the world, are concerned about prevention - comprehensive examination programs have been developed for such tourists.  Unfortunately, there are no statistics in the field of medical tourism in the region yet.  Each institution counts its own figures, for example, for the clinic Elena Kolyada this market annually grows by 10-15 percent.  Coordinator of international internships of the Ural Society of Aesthetic Medicine Specialists Irina Kuznetsova says that everything depends on the profile of the medical institution - for some, the growth reaches 25-32 percent.  To spur the development of exports can create a unique product that does not exist in other territories.  For the firm headed by Irina, this was an international project involving Italian surgeons invited to Russia: they provide high-tech care to patients, including those with severe post-traumatic consequences.  It is clear that the goal of the development of medical tourism, as well as any other services, is additional financial revenues to the budgets of clinics, the city, the region.  After all, Russians from other regions "bring" with them funding through compulsory health insurance, foreigners - "live" money.  At the same time, even in state medical institutions, the receipt of extra-budgetary funds can increase many times.  However, representatives of Opora Rossii believe that private clinics should be the basis for the development of the export direction, since the main function of public health is social.  But public-private partnership will clearly benefit the industry, especially when it comes to creating infrastructure, acquiring expensive equipment. - The modern world is generally moving towards car sharing: when you use, but do not own.  This principle can open a second wind to medical entrepreneurship, which remains the marketing of the product, its promotion, - says Dmitry Dovbnya. - We would like business to complement the system that already exists, - develops the idea of Irina Gekht, - maybe offering assistance that the state does not provide so professionally, as a socially oriented non-profit organization does, engaged, for example, in the rehabilitation of children with autism.  Officials are ready to include entrepreneurs providing such services in state support programs: to reduce taxes for them, to provide subsidies, to open access to the compulsory medical insurance system.  And similar examples in the region already exist, one of them is a Magnitogorsk company that carries out early diagnosis of oncological diseases.  But before spreading the experience, the authorities want to understand how many social entrepreneurs there are in the region, in what areas they work, and how effective they are.  The next stage is the creation of a self-regulatory organization uniting social business, or a state structure under the auspices of the regional government.  The Russian capitals have already reached this level of development: in St. Petersburg, the medical tourism agency was created under the regional Ministry of Health, in Moscow it exists as a private initiative, but also works effectively.  Expanding the export of health services will require other interactions.  On the one hand, you will need new hotels, hostels where patients can stay, new tourist products, and this is an uncultivated field for business.  On the other hand, logistics and infrastructure development will have to be addressed.  So it is impossible to do without cooperation with the authorities.  According to the Medical Tourism Index (MTI), by 2025, the turnover of this market in the world will exceed three trillion dollars.  The annual increase is estimated at a minimum of 25 percent.  Among the most popular countries among tourists going for medical care are Canada, Great Britain, Israel, Italy, Germany, France, South Korea, Singapore, India.  Russia is not yet among the leaders of such ratings, but experts believe that it has great potential.

passages.title: Taiwan Beauty and Medical Tourism Launches Ministry of Health and Welfare to Establish a Promotion Team Wang Zhengkun to Provide Practical Advice
passages.passage: ▲ Dr. Wang Zhengkun was invited to participate in the Beauty Medical Tourism Launching Conference, with Lin Dai (middle) and Liu Yueh-ping (right) of the Ministry of Health and Welfare. (photo / photo by Lin Yue-fan) Reporter Lin Yue / Tainan reported that the Ministry of Health and Welfare held the Beauty Medical Tourism Launching Conference on January 7. The Tourism Bureau, the Taiwan Society of Dermatology, the Society of Plastic Surgery, the Society of Aesthetic Surgery and other related units have jointly discussed how to successfully promote medical tourism in Taiwan.  Dr. Wang Zhengkun attended the meeting on behalf of the Taiwan Society of Dermatology and put forward suggestions based on practical experience, hoping to expand the number of hospital clinics to participate in, reduce barriers to promote and create a national brand of beauty and medical tourism in Taiwan, so that the supply chain of beauty and medical tourism can reach foreign end consumers, that is, foreign patients can know about medical beauty and tourism in Taiwan.  Taiwan ’ s medical technology surpasses Singapore, but the value of medical tourism has long been lost to Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia and South Korea. Foreign patients who go to Asia for medical treatment will choose the above countries first, but will not choose Taiwan.  Dr. Wang Zhengkun is a dermatologist. He served as president of the Medical Laser Photonics Association of the Republic of China and president of the Greater Tainan Tourism Alliance. He is currently the director of the International Association for the Promotion of Medical Health.  Legislator Lin Dai-hua, referring to the opinions of the participants, asked the Ministry of Health and Welfare to set up a "beauty medical tourism promotion group" to deal with the promotion of matters, and carry out inter-ministerial integration, hoping that foreign guests will come to Taiwan in large numbers, Taiwan's medical treatment will be sold to foreigners in large numbers, and Taiwan's economy will flourish.  The meeting resolved to select model medical institutions, simplify the content and certification process of aesthetic medicine certification, make it easy for legal clinics to pass the audit, expand clinic participation, relax international medical advertising regulations, establish an international medical dispute mediation mechanism and invite relevant medical associations to provide suggestions.  Dr. Wang Zhengkun said that the international medical programs are comprehensive, including acute and severe diseases, disease treatment, health examination, medical aesthetics, and dental aesthetics.  Medical tourism in Taiwan has been planned in various departments, but it has not been able to attract foreign patients to the door because of the supply chain, the entire industry supply chain can not reach foreign patients.  In the past 10 years, hospitals, clinics, travel agencies and government departments have developed many programs, perhaps because of the lack of marketing in Taiwan, foreign patients are a little unfamiliar to Taiwan's medical reputation, and no foreign agents are willing to bring a large number of patients to Taiwan for treatment.  Wang Zhengkun said that although Taiwan's hospitals and clinics are ready, they have not seen a large influx of foreign patients into Taiwan.  Therefore, to learn the success factors of other countries is a key point, Korea's medical beauty can successfully develop, is to use the power of the whole country in the world to market medical beauty, film, form a culture, expand international advertising, in-depth life, deeply rooted in the hearts of the people, Korean medical beauty marketing strength, breadth and depth are tens of times that of Taiwan, so that foreign patients talk about medical beauty think of Korea.  Then, Korean hospital clinics and agents around the world to form a supply chain, negotiate cooperation conditions, agents from various countries to bring foreign patients to South Korea, this implementation of the concept of supply chain management, in order to really contact foreign patients, in order to bring foreigners into the country for consumption.  If beauty medical tourism can be developed, it is not only medical institutions that benefit, but the entire hotel accommodation industry, transportation industry, tourism industry, and private consumption can be greatly improved.

passages.title: Tracing prostheses used in plastic surgery
passages.passage: According to Mehr News Agency, Hamed Bateni, in connection with the issue of medical tourism, said: "The medical conditions of the country have scientifically caused patients from other countries to travel to Iran from the region and even from remote parts of the world and benefit from the medical field in Iran."  Pointing out that some people think that patients from other parts of the world come to Iran only because of the cheapness of medical services, he said: "This is a mistake because many countries offer cheaper services in the field of medicine, but patients do not trust and do not want to travel to their country for treatment because their medicine is not strong or the facilities of surgical centers are weak and sometimes unsterile."  The head of the Iranian Society of Plastic and Aesthetic Surgeons continued: In recent years, measures have been started to organize medical tourists through the Ministry of Health and gradually the programs are going to be written and comprehensive so that we hope that soon the field of medical tourism will be completely out of control and operated by translators or non-standard institutions and only under the supervision of the Ministry of Health.  In response to the question of what effect the sanctions of the enemies have had on the field of plastic and cosmetic surgery and whether you are facing a shortage of drugs in this field, he noted: The field of plastic and cosmetic surgery is not very dependent on the aspect of drugs with shortages, but equipment and devices such as implants, prosthetics and beauty products with changing currency fluctuations have increased prices and sometimes products are scarce and imports are not easy.  He said: "The equipment required by plastic surgeons is provided by different brands, depending on the company's production and distribution and their price varies, but all of these equipment and equipment are of good quality and there is no problem in this regard."  The head of the Iranian Society of Plastic and Aesthetic Surgeons noted that most of the equipment and equipment needed for plastic and cosmetic surgery such as implants and prostheses do not have passenger or luggage entry because the reference of these devices is known and all of them have serial numbers that can be traced on the website of the manufacturer and distributor, so there is no concern in this regard.  Bateni said that patients can use this serial number and specifications to track the prosthesis and device used in their body and make sure of its quality, because the prostheses used in plastic and cosmetic surgeries are different from some other surgeries and the patient has a direct role in its preparation.

passages.title: 35% of global tourism revenue is Iran ’ s share
passages.passage: The advanced and widespread health services in Iran compared to neighboring countries and the relative superiority of these services in terms of price compared to many advanced countries has made the market of health and medical services in Iran attractive to citizens of other countries and a new branch of tourism called health tourism has emerged in the country.  The presence of many of these health tourists can not be limited to health services; these people can also travel to tourist or pilgrimage areas of Iran during and after treatment, which can also help the tourism development of those areas.  According to the Public Relations Department of the Institute of Cultural Heritage and Tourism, Saeed Amirian, discussed this issue at the specialized meeting of “Risk Management in Health Tourism ” held by the Institute of Tourism.  He described medical tourism as an economic activity that requires trade in services and participation of at least two medical and tourism sectors, adding that medical tourism in most cases includes dental services, cosmetic surgery and other types of surgeries.  Amirian, in the definition of health tourism, said: The use of services that improve or increase health and increase the morale of the person and in a place outside his residence for more than 24 hours is considered to be a health tourism.  Referring to the flow of patients from developed countries to developing countries to receive medical services, he said: “The intensifying factor in the flow of medical tourism in recent years is the third payer, employer or insurance, which encourages patients to find medical services at more affordable and faster prices. ”  In describing the dimensions of medical tourism in Iran, he said: Iran ’ s share of attracting this type of tourism during one year was only 350 million dollars; that is, only 0.35% of global health tourism revenue is Iran ’ s share, and with this amount of income, Iran ranks 10th in terms of attracting health tourists.  Referring to the importance of health tourism in Iran, Amirian stated: "The advanced and widespread health services in Iran compared to neighboring countries and the relative superiority of these services in terms of price compared to many advanced countries has made the market of health and health services of Iran attractive to citizens of other countries and a new branch of tourism called health tourism in the country emerges."  He went on to say something about the risk of tourism, saying: "It is mainly a defect in our knowledge of the future and risk is more in the future; risk and uncertainty start exactly where knowledge ends."  The expert added: "By stating that the risk of uncertainties with probabilities and possible outcomes is known, the risk classification is small and large scale, systematic and unsystematic.  Referring to the theoretical reflections of risk and uncertainty in tourism, Amirian said: "Risk is more as something to be avoided, but risk and uncertainty are considered as tourist attractions, especially adventure tourism."  He went on to describe the risks in tourism including individual risks for tourists, the responsibility of tourism service providers, destination risks and social risks, and by giving examples of risks in individual tourism, he explained the ways to cover risks for individual tourists, destination risks, social and tourism risks and governments and risk management.  Referring to the risk in tourism companies and its types, he said the four main strategies for risk management at the company level are knowledge, diversity, trust, and insurance, and said the risk management principle includes four steps; identification of small and large threats that the company may face in the future, analyzing risks and assessing the amount of costs that each risk may bring to the company, formulating a strategy for each possible risk and designing practical measures to deal with it and monitor damage. It is a risk to the company and a modification of past strategies and approaches.

passages.title: The main directions of beauty tourism: plastic, weight loss, sleep
passages.passage: Hair transplants in Turkey, sleep recovery in Switzerland, liposuction in Brazil: health tourism is booming and expanding horizons.  "Kommersant Style" tells about popular destinations and beauty programs from around the world.  Medical tourism is not a new phenomenon: there have always been those who want to improve their health abroad.  Many countries have their own medical specialization - they are able to do something better than others.  For example, the United States, Brazil, Japan, Mexico and Italy account for 41.4% of all global plastic surgeries.  Patients Beyond Borders estimates that 14 million people travel abroad every year to seek health care.  The obvious reason for the popularity of such tourism for many is the difference in prices.  For example, rhinoplasty in the United States will cost an average of $4.8 thousand, and in Thailand - $1.6 thousand, in a Moscow clinic - about 200 thousand rubles, depending on the complexity.  According to the WHO, Brazil has the best healthcare system in Latin America thanks to the mass accreditation of hospitals by the Joint International Commission (JCI – the largest and oldest medical accreditation organization in the world).  This led to the phenomenon of such tourism in the country.  Surgeons here are like hairdressers.  The most popular procedures in Brazil are liposuction, abdominoplasty and buttock augmentation, called brazilian butt lift.  Of course, the cult of the body is due to the hot climate.  Interestingly, every year the government subsidizes almost half a million operations, for the locals it is the “right to beauty ”.  The same operations are being carried out in neighboring Colombia.  Almost all patients are from the United States.  About 50,000 medical tourists visit the country every year.  From 2012 to 2018, medical tourism in Colombia grew by 264%.  There are more surgeons in South Korea.  It has one of the highest rates of plastic surgery in the world - about 1 million procedures per year, as well as the largest number of plastic surgeons per capita.  The country boasts a thriving tourism industry in this area.  In Korea, they strive to make facial features more Europeanized, so first of all, they change the shape of the nose, eyes (double eyelid surgery), jaws and cheekbones.  The management of Incheon Airport in Seoul even considered the possibility of creating a plastic surgery clinic in one of the terminals so that travelers did not need to travel around the city.  Photo: Getty Images Turkey, although not one of the most popular places for plastic surgery, but the leader in the market of hair transplantation.  Often on the streets of Istanbul and other major cities of the country you can meet people with bandaged heads.  For comparison, hair transplantation costs about $25 thousand in the United States and Europe, in Turkey - from $600 to $2 thousand, in a Moscow clinic - about 100 thousand rubles. for one graft (a group of one to four follicles).  According to the Hurriyet newspaper, in 2017, among 750 thousand tourists, 60 thousand came for hair transplantation.  Most are from the Middle East.  Popular destinations for dental tourism are Thailand, which is called the "Land of Smiles", Vietnam, Mexico and Costa Rica, in Europe - Hungary and Poland.  The most common procedures are the installation of implants, veneers and crowns, bleaching.  For example, Hungary has become the best place in Europe for this direction, it is visited annually by about 7 thousand patients.  This is due to favorable prices, qualified doctors and modern technologies.  Another two popular areas of tourism are the restoration of sleep and weight loss, but not just on detox programs, but thanks to sports in the camps.  Fitness camps are actually recreational sports camps for adults, where in the circle of like-minded people you can surf in Sri Lanka with the Good Story Surf school, go skating on Lake Baikal with Team Trip or learn how to ski in the vicinity of Gstaad with Pro Trener, World Class or SlimFitClub trainers.  Six Senses Douro Valley The newest wellness trend is slip-retreats, which literally teach you to sleep.  As a rule, resorts for the restoration of sleep are located in picturesque places: in the mountains, overlooking the water.  For example, in Portugal, Germany, Italy and Switzerland.  Services include a menu of pillows: from special anti-snoring to filled with water or memory foam, sleep masks and earplugs to choose from, a music library, meditation on demand, as well as staff who can advise on sleep issues.  For example, the hotel in Manhattan, The Benjamin, designed the Rest & Renew program with Rebecca Robbins, a professor of sleep medicine at Cornell University.  Similar programs have Six Senses Douro Valley in Portugal, Peak Health in Switzerland and Lefay on Lake Garda.  Berlin ’ s Swisstel included in its DeepSleep retreat sessions of aroma- and light therapy, as well as inhalation of mountain air.  Beauty tourism is a thriving niche in the industry.  Clinics and hotels offer complete packages, including transfers, flights, meals and even excursions.  According to a joint study by Visa and Oxford Economics, the global medical tourism industry will grow by 25% per year over the next ten years.  Daria Bogomolova

Cosmetic surgery is a significant focus of medical tourism, with many individuals traveling abroad for various procedures, including cosmetic dental surgery.

According to a comprehensive report on the consumption behavior of new white collar workers in China in 2020, nearly 20% of male white collar workers spend 1131 yuan (about 4863 NT dollars) per month on skin care, which is basically the same as women's 1197 yuan (about 5147 NT dollars) [505a6874-9f5c-4c24-8eac-ce43469e9b8d]. 
This growing interest in personal care and beauty treatments has led to an increase in demand for cosmetic surgery and dental services.

In China, the number of medical and aesthetic medical orders on e-commerce platforms during the double 11 period in 2020 increased by nearly seven-fold, with nearly 30% of the orders coming from male consumers [505a6874-9f5c-4c24-8eac-ce43469e9b8d]. 
This trend is expected to continue, with the global medical tourism industry projected to grow by 25% per year over the next ten years [e28842f6-c377-4bd8-9c8d-ff8d8c91424f].

One of the most popular destinations for cosmetic surgery is Turkey, where hair transplantation is a highly sought-after procedure. 
According to the Hurriyet newspaper, in 2017, among 750 thousand tourists, 60 thousand came for hair transplantation, mostly from the Middle East [e28842f6-c377-4bd8-9c8d-ff8d8c91424f].

Cosmetic dental surgery, including implants, is also a popular destination for medical tourism. 
In Brazil, the most popular procedures are liposuction, abdominoplasty, and buttock augmentation, known as the "Brazilian butt lift" [e28842f6-c377-4bd8-9c8d-ff8d8c91424f]. 
This trend is also seen in neighboring Colombia, where almost all patients are from the United States, with 50,000 medical tourists visiting the country every year [e28842f6-c377-4bd8-9c8d-ff8d8c91424f].

The costs of cosmetic surgery and dental services vary significantly depending on the destination. 
In the United States, rhinoplasty can cost an average of $4.8 thousand, while in Thailand, the same procedure can cost as little as $1.6 thousand [e28842f6-c377-4bd8-9c8d-ff8d8c91424f]. 
In Russia, the cost of hair transplantation can range from 100 thousand rubles to 2 thousand rubles per graft, depending on the clinic and the complexity of the procedure [e28842f6-c377-4bd8-9c8d-ff8d8c91424f].

Despite the growing demand for cosmetic surgery and dental services, there are also challenges associated with medical tourism. 
One of the main concerns is the lack of regulation and oversight in some countries, which can lead to poor quality care and increased risk of complications [505a6874-9f5c-4c24-8eac-ce43469e9b8d].

Title: In the Southern Urals, business came up with how to develop medical tourism
Content: According to South Ural entrepreneurs, public-private partnership can contribute to the expansion of the presence of business in the field of social services.  For example, such their type as medical tourism is not yet developing too actively, while the country has set a goal to quadruple the export of health services by 2024 - up to a million dollars a year.  What business and the authorities of the Chelyabinsk region should do for this, the correspondent of "RG" found out.  There are also a lot of non-resident patients in Yekaterinburg.  After the procedures, they could not be bored in the hospital, but to see the sights.  Photo: Tatyana Andreeva / RG Better you to us In the Southern Urals, dentists began to attract patients "from the outside", then ophthalmologists, traumatologists, and other narrow specialists began to occupy market niches.  There are also multi-purpose centers that receive visitors.  This even caused talk that, they say, strangers will create a queue, and there are not enough medical facilities for their own...  Such fears are devoid of grounds, said the vice-president of the Chelyabinsk branch of the “Support of Russia ” candidate of medical Sciences Alexei Larin.  Yes, he notes, there are problems with the primary link in the region, they must be solved.  But in the field of specialized assistance, there is a reserve - it is possible to increase its volumes several times rather quickly.  Dmitry Dovbnya, Chairman of the Committee on Tourism of the Chelyabinsk branch of OPORA, notes: it is necessary to distinguish between medical exports and tourism.  The first is tied exclusively to the consumption of medical services: residents of other regions or countries came, received assistance, left back.  The range of services of the second is wider.  For example, there are procedures, such as IVF, that require the patient to live near the clinic for some time.  Waiting he "compensates" acquaintance with the city, its sights.  Sanatorium patients are even more active in this regard.  The districts of Sochi and Kavminvod have long demonstrated how beneficial the arrival of people whose goal is to improve their health can be for the territory.  This experience should be used in the Southern Urals, which was once the health resort of the entire industrial Urals: local lakes went from Yekaterinburg, Tyumen, Perm, northern regions, those who are contraindicated in a sharp change in climate.  The task of the business is to expand the range of purely tourist services for such guests.  When the South Urals go to be treated in other regions, this is also medical tourism, but at the same time the Chelyabinsk region loses an amount close to a billion rubles.  Irina Gekht, the first vice-governor in charge of social issues, draws attention to the fact that along with the export of medical services there are also imports.  When the South Urals go to be treated in other regions, this is also medical tourism, but at the same time the Chelyabinsk region loses an amount close to a billion rubles.  Therefore, it is interested in attracting consumers of services from other regions, for the provision of which it has the necessary competencies.  Speech, in particular, about transplantation, pediatric neurosurgery, a number of other areas where Chelyabinsk doctors work at the level of European standards.  Alexey Larin lists: private clinics of the region are able to provide high-tech assistance in the field of oncology, ophthalmology, traumatology and orthopedics, obstetrics and gynecology...  What attracts foreign patients?  In some countries, Dmitry Dovbnya notes, due to traditional specifics or policies aimed at limiting the birth rate, a number of medical services have been banned.  In China, it is in vitro fertilization, in Arab countries - laser treatment.  Residents of China are also interested in dental services - here they are cheaper than in their homeland.  Among the clients of private medicine, there are many former compatriots who left for Germany, Israel, scattered around the world.  They often visit relatives, and the price and quality of medical services encourage them to seek help in Chelyabinsk clinics: in developed countries, similar treatment for the family budget is much more burdensome.  Frequent guests in medical institutions of the region and residents of Kazakhstan.  Moreover, it is they who form the main flow from the near abroad.  Director and chief physician of the private medical center Elena Kolyada said that 95 percent of all international appeals to her institution are accounted for by residents of the neighboring republic.  Among the most popular services are IVF, surgical treatment, polyclinic examination, pediatrician consultations.  Many, as, indeed, all over the world, are concerned about prevention - comprehensive examination programs have been developed for such tourists.  Unfortunately, there are no statistics in the field of medical tourism in the region yet.  Each institution counts its own figures, for example, for the clinic Elena Kolyada this market annually grows by 10-15 percent.  Coordinator of international internships of the Ural Society of Aesthetic Medicine Specialists Irina Kuznetsova says that everything depends on the profile of the medical institution - for some, the growth reaches 25-32 percent.  To spur the development of exports can create a unique product that does not exist in other territories.  For the firm headed by Irina, this was an international project involving Italian surgeons invited to Russia: they provide high-tech care to patients, including those with severe post-traumatic consequences.  It is clear that the goal of the development of medical tourism, as well as any other services, is additional financial revenues to the budgets of clinics, the city, the region.  After all, Russians from other regions "bring" with them funding through compulsory health insurance, foreigners - "live" money.  At the same time, even in state medical institutions, the receipt of extra-budgetary funds can increase many times.  However, representatives of Opora Rossii believe that private clinics should be the basis for the development of the export direction, since the main function of public health is social.  But public-private partnership will clearly benefit the industry, especially when it comes to creating infrastructure, acquiring expensive equipment. - The modern world is generally moving towards car sharing: when you use, but do not own.  This principle can open a second wind to medical entrepreneurship, which remains the marketing of the product, its promotion, - says Dmitry Dovbnya. - We would like business to complement the system that already exists, - develops the idea of Irina Gekht, - maybe offering assistance that the state does not provide so professionally, as a socially oriented non-profit organization does, engaged, for example, in the rehabilitation of children with autism.  Officials are ready to include entrepreneurs providing such services in state support programs: to reduce taxes for them, to provide subsidies, to open access to the compulsory medical insurance system.  And similar examples in the region already exist, one of them is a Magnitogorsk company that carries out early diagnosis of oncological diseases.  But before spreading the experience, the authorities want to understand how many social entrepreneurs there are in the region, in what areas they work, and how effective they are.  The next stage is the creation of a self-regulatory organization uniting social business, or a state structure under the auspices of the regional government.  The Russian capitals have already reached this level of development: in St. Petersburg, the medical tourism agency was created under the regional Ministry of Health, in Moscow it exists as a private initiative, but also works effectively.  Expanding the export of health services will require other interactions. Title: Taiwan Beauty and Medical Tourism Launches Ministry of Health and Welfare to Establish a Promotion Team Wang Zhengkun to Provide Practical Advice
Content: ▲ Dr. Wang Zhengkun was invited to participate in the Beauty Medical Tourism Launching Conference, with Lin Dai (middle) and Liu Yueh-ping (right) of the Ministry of Health and Welfare. (photo / photo by Lin Yue-fan) Reporter Lin Yue / Tainan reported that the Ministry of Health and Welfare held the Beauty Medical Tourism Launching Conference on January 7. The Tourism Bureau, the Taiwan Society of Dermatology, the Society of Plastic Surgery, the Society of Aesthetic Surgery and other related units have jointly discussed how to successfully promote medical tourism in Taiwan.  Dr. Wang Zhengkun attended the meeting on behalf of the Taiwan Society of Dermatology and put forward suggestions based on practical experience, hoping to expand the number of hospital clinics to participate in, reduce barriers to promote and create a national brand of beauty and medical tourism in Taiwan, so that the supply chain of beauty and medical tourism can reach foreign end consumers, that is, foreign patients can know about medical beauty and tourism in Taiwan.  Taiwan ’ s medical technology surpasses Singapore, but the value of medical tourism has long been lost to Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia and South Korea. Foreign patients who go to Asia for medical treatment will choose the above countries first, but will not choose Taiwan.  Dr. Wang Zhengkun is a dermatologist. He served as president of the Medical Laser Photonics Association of the Republic of China and president of the Greater Tainan Tourism Alliance. He is currently the director of the International Association for the Promotion of Medical Health.  Legislator Lin Dai-hua, referring to the opinions of the participants, asked the Ministry of Health and Welfare to set up a "beauty medical tourism promotion group" to deal with the promotion of matters, and carry out inter-ministerial integration, hoping that foreign guests will come to Taiwan in large numbers, Taiwan's medical treatment will be sold to foreigners in large numbers, and Taiwan's economy will flourish.  The meeting resolved to select model medical institutions, simplify the content and certification process of aesthetic medicine certification, make it easy for legal clinics to pass the audit, expand clinic participation, relax international medical advertising regulations, establish an international medical dispute mediation mechanism and invite relevant medical associations to provide suggestions.  Dr. Wang Zhengkun said that the international medical programs are comprehensive, including acute and severe diseases, disease treatment, health examination, medical aesthetics, and dental aesthetics.  Medical tourism in Taiwan has been planned in various departments, but it has not been able to attract foreign patients to the door because of the supply chain, the entire industry supply chain can not reach foreign patients.  In the past 10 years, hospitals, clinics, travel agencies and government departments have developed many programs, perhaps because of the lack of marketing in Taiwan, foreign patients are a little unfamiliar to Taiwan's medical reputation, and no foreign agents are willing to bring a large number of patients to Taiwan for treatment.  Wang Zhengkun said that although Taiwan's hospitals and clinics are ready, they have not seen a large influx of foreign patients into Taiwan.  Therefore, to learn the success factors of other countries is a key point, Korea's medical beauty can successfully develop, is to use the power of the whole country in the world to market medical beauty, film, form a culture, expand international advertising, in-depth life, deeply rooted in the hearts of the people, Korean medical beauty marketing strength, breadth and depth are tens of times that of Taiwan, so that foreign patients talk about medical beauty think of Korea.  Then, Korean hospital clinics and agents around the world to form a supply chain, negotiate cooperation conditions, agents from various countries to bring foreign patients to South Korea, this implementation of the concept of supply chain management, in order to really contact foreign patients, in order to bring foreigners into the country for consumption.  If beauty medical tourism can be developed, it is not only medical institutions that benefit, but the entire hotel accommodation industry, transportation industry, tourism industry, and private consumption can be greatly improved.

Title: Tracing prostheses used in plastic surgery
Content: According to Mehr News Agency, Hamed Bateni, in connection with the issue of medical tourism, said: "The medical conditions of the country have scientifically caused patients from other countries to travel to Iran from the region and even from remote parts of the world and benefit from the medical field in Iran."  Pointing out that some people think that patients from other parts of the world come to Iran only because of the cheapness of medical services, he said: "This is a mistake because many countries offer cheaper services in the field of medicine, but patients do not trust and do not want to travel to their country for treatment because their medicine is not strong or the facilities of surgical centers are weak and sometimes unsterile."  The head of the Iranian Society of Plastic and Aesthetic Surgeons continued: In recent years, measures have been started to organize medical tourists through the Ministry of Health and gradually the programs are going to be written and comprehensive so that we hope that soon the field of medical tourism will be completely out of control and operated by translators or non-standard institutions and only under the supervision of the Ministry of Health.  In response to the question of what effect the sanctions of the enemies have had on the field of plastic and cosmetic surgery and whether you are facing a shortage of drugs in this field, he noted: The field of plastic and cosmetic surgery is not very dependent on the aspect of drugs with shortages, but equipment and devices such as implants, prosthetics and beauty products with changing currency fluctuations have increased prices and sometimes products are scarce and imports are not easy.  He said: "The equipment required by plastic surgeons is provided by different brands, depending on the company's production and distribution and their price varies, but all of these equipment and equipment are of good quality and there is no problem in this regard."  The head of the Iranian Society of Plastic and Aesthetic Surgeons noted that most of the equipment and equipment needed for plastic and cosmetic surgery such as implants and prostheses do not have passenger or luggage entry because the reference of these devices is known and all of them have serial numbers that can be traced on the website of the manufacturer and distributor, so there is no concern in this regard.  Bateni said that patients can use this serial number and specifications to track the prosthesis and device used in their body and make sure of its quality, because the prostheses used in plastic and cosmetic surgeries are different from some other surgeries and the patient has a direct role in its preparation.

Title: 35% of global tourism revenue is Iran ’ s share
Content: The advanced and widespread health services in Iran compared to neighboring countries and the relative superiority of these services in terms of price compared to many advanced countries has made the market of health and medical services in Iran attractive to citizens of other countries and a new branch of tourism called health tourism has emerged in the country.  The presence of many of these health tourists can not be limited to health services; these people can also travel to tourist or pilgrimage areas of Iran during and after treatment, which can also help the tourism development of those areas.  According to the Public Relations Department of the Institute of Cultural Heritage and Tourism, Saeed Amirian, discussed this issue at the specialized meeting of “Risk Management in Health Tourism ” held by the Institute of Tourism.  He described medical tourism as an economic activity that requires trade in services and participation of at least two medical and tourism sectors, adding that medical tourism in most cases includes dental services, cosmetic surgery and other types of surgeries.  Amirian, in the definition of health tourism, said: The use of services that improve or increase health and increase the morale of the person and in a place outside his residence for more than 24 hours is considered to be a health tourism.  Referring to the flow of patients from developed countries to developing countries to receive medical services, he said: “The intensifying factor in the flow of medical tourism in recent years is the third payer, employer or insurance, which encourages patients to find medical services at more affordable and faster prices. ”  In describing the dimensions of medical tourism in Iran, he said: Iran ’ s share of attracting this type of tourism during one year was only 350 million dollars; that is, only 0.35% of global health tourism revenue is Iran ’ s share, and with this amount of income, Iran ranks 10th in terms of attracting health tourists.  Referring to the importance of health tourism in Iran, Amirian stated: "The advanced and widespread health services in Iran compared to neighboring countries and the relative superiority of these services in terms of price compared to many advanced countries has made the market of health and health services of Iran attractive to citizens of other countries and a new branch of tourism called health tourism in the country emerges."  He went on to say something about the risk of tourism, saying: "It is mainly a defect in our knowledge of the future and risk is more in the future; risk and uncertainty start exactly where knowledge ends."  The expert added: "By stating that the risk of uncertainties with probabilities and possible outcomes is known, the risk classification is small and large scale, systematic and unsystematic.  Referring to the theoretical reflections of risk and uncertainty in tourism, Amirian said: "Risk is more as something to be avoided, but risk and uncertainty are considered as tourist attractions, especially adventure tourism."  He went on to describe the risks in tourism including individual risks for tourists, the responsibility of tourism service providers, destination risks and social risks, and by giving examples of risks in individual tourism, he explained the ways to cover risks for individual tourists, destination risks, social and tourism risks and governments and risk management.  Referring to the risk in tourism companies and its types, he said the four main strategies for risk management at the company level are knowledge, diversity, trust, and insurance, and said the risk management principle includes four steps; identification of small and large threats that the company may face in the future, analyzing risks and assessing the amount of costs that each risk may bring to the company, formulating a strategy for each possible risk and designing practical measures to deal with it and monitor damage. It is a risk to the company and a modification of past strategies and approaches.

Title: The main directions of beauty tourism: plastic, weight loss, sleep
Content: Hair transplants in Turkey, sleep recovery in Switzerland, liposuction in Brazil: health tourism is booming and expanding horizons.  "Kommersant Style" tells about popular destinations and beauty programs from around the world.  Medical tourism is not a new phenomenon: there have always been those who want to improve their health abroad.  Many countries have their own medical specialization - they are able to do something better than others.  For example, the United States, Brazil, Japan, Mexico and Italy account for 41.4% of all global plastic surgeries.  Patients Beyond Borders estimates that 14 million people travel abroad every year to seek health care.  The obvious reason for the popularity of such tourism for many is the difference in prices.  For example, rhinoplasty in the United States will cost an average of $4.8 thousand, and in Thailand - $1.6 thousand, in a Moscow clinic - about 200 thousand rubles, depending on the complexity.  According to the WHO, Brazil has the best healthcare system in Latin America thanks to the mass accreditation of hospitals by the Joint International Commission (JCI – the largest and oldest medical accreditation organization in the world).  This led to the phenomenon of such tourism in the country.  Surgeons here are like hairdressers.  The most popular procedures in Brazil are liposuction, abdominoplasty and buttock augmentation, called brazilian butt lift.  Of course, the cult of the body is due to the hot climate.  Interestingly, every year the government subsidizes almost half a million operations, for the locals it is the “right to beauty ”.  The same operations are being carried out in neighboring Colombia.  Almost all patients are from the United States.  About 50,000 medical tourists visit the country every year.  From 2012 to 2018, medical tourism in Colombia grew by 264%.  There are more surgeons in South Korea.  It has one of the highest rates of plastic surgery in the world - about 1 million procedures per year, as well as the largest number of plastic surgeons per capita.  The country boasts a thriving tourism industry in this area.  In Korea, they strive to make facial features more Europeanized, so first of all, they change the shape of the nose, eyes (double eyelid surgery), jaws and cheekbones.  The management of Incheon Airport in Seoul even considered the possibility of creating a plastic surgery clinic in one of the terminals so that travelers did not need to travel around the city.  Photo: Getty Images Turkey, although not one of the most popular places for plastic surgery, but the leader in the market of hair transplantation.  Often on the streets of Istanbul and other major cities of the country you can meet people with bandaged heads.  For comparison, hair transplantation costs about $25 thousand in the United States and Europe, in Turkey - from $600 to $2 thousand, in a Moscow clinic - about 100 thousand rubles. for one graft (a group of one to four follicles).  According to the Hurriyet newspaper, in 2017, among 750 thousand tourists, 60 thousand came for hair transplantation.  Most are from the Middle East.  Popular destinations for dental tourism are Thailand, which is called the "Land of Smiles", Vietnam, Mexico and Costa Rica, in Europe - Hungary and Poland.  The most common procedures are the installation of implants, veneers and crowns, bleaching.  For example, Hungary has become the best place in Europe for this direction, it is visited annually by about 7 thousand patients.  This is due to favorable prices, qualified doctors and modern technologies.  Another two popular areas of tourism are the restoration of sleep and weight loss, but not just on detox programs, but thanks to sports in the camps.  Fitness camps are actually recreational sports camps for adults, where in the circle of like-minded people you can surf in Sri Lanka with the Good Story Surf school, go skating on Lake Baikal with Team Trip or learn how to ski in the vicinity of Gstaad with Pro Trener, World Class or SlimFitClub trainers.  Six Senses Douro Valley The newest wellness trend is slip-retreats, which literally teach you to sleep.  As a rule, resorts for the restoration of sleep are located in picturesque places: in the mountains, overlooking the water.  For example, in Portugal, Germany, Italy and Switzerland.  Services include a menu of pillows: from special anti-snoring to filled with water or memory foam, sleep masks and earplugs to choose from, a music library, meditation on demand, as well as staff who can advise on sleep issues.  For example, the hotel in Manhattan, The Benjamin, designed the Rest & Renew program with Rebecca Robbins, a professor of sleep medicine at Cornell University.  Similar programs have Six Senses Douro Valley in Portugal, Peak Health in Switzerland and Lefay on Lake Garda.  Berlin ’ s Swisstel included in its DeepSleep retreat sessions of aroma- and light therapy, as well as inhalation of mountain air.  Beauty tourism is a thriving niche in the industry.  Clinics and hotels offer complete packages, including transfers, flights, meals and even excursions.  According to a joint study by Visa and Oxford Economics, the global medical tourism industry will grow by 25% per year over the next ten years.  Daria Bogomolova

Title: Taiwan Beauty and Medical Tourism Launches Ministry of Health and Welfare to Establish a Promotion Team Wang Zhengkun to Provide Practical Advice
Content: ▲ Dr. Wang Zhengkun was invited to participate in the Beauty Medical Tourism Launching Conference, with Lin Dai (middle) and Liu Yueh-ping (right) of the Ministry of Health and Welfare. (photo / photo by Lin Yue-fan) Reporter Lin Yue / Tainan reported that the Ministry of Health and Welfare held the Beauty Medical Tourism Launching Conference on January 7. The Tourism Bureau, the Taiwan Society of Dermatology, the Society of Plastic Surgery, the Society of Aesthetic Surgery and other related units have jointly discussed how to successfully promote medical tourism in Taiwan.  Dr. Wang Zhengkun attended the meeting on behalf of the Taiwan Society of Dermatology and put forward suggestions based on practical experience, hoping to expand the number of hospital clinics to participate in, reduce barriers to promote and create a national brand of beauty and medical tourism in Taiwan, so that the supply chain of beauty and medical tourism can reach foreign end consumers, that is, foreign patients can know about medical beauty and tourism in Taiwan.  Taiwan ’ s medical technology surpasses Singapore, but the value of medical tourism has long been lost to Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia and South Korea. Foreign patients who go to Asia for medical treatment will choose the above countries first, but will not choose Taiwan.  Dr. Wang Zhengkun is a dermatologist. He served as president of the Medical Laser Photonics Association of the Republic of China and president of the Greater Tainan Tourism Alliance. He is currently the director of the International Association for the Promotion of Medical Health.  Legislator Lin Dai-hua, referring to the opinions of the participants, asked the Ministry of Health and Welfare to set up a "beauty medical tourism promotion group" to deal with the promotion of matters, and carry out inter-ministerial integration, hoping that foreign guests will come to Taiwan in large numbers, Taiwan's medical treatment will be sold to foreigners in large numbers, and Taiwan's economy will flourish.  The meeting resolved to select model medical institutions, simplify the content and certification process of aesthetic medicine certification, make it easy for legal clinics to pass the audit, expand clinic participation, relax international medical advertising regulations, establish an international medical dispute mediation mechanism and invite relevant medical associations to provide suggestions.  Dr. Wang Zhengkun said that the international medical programs are comprehensive, including acute and severe diseases, disease treatment, health examination, medical aesthetics, and dental aesthetics.  Medical tourism in Taiwan has been planned in various departments, but it has not been able to attract foreign patients to the door because of the supply chain, the entire industry supply chain can not reach foreign patients.  In the past 10 years, hospitals, clinics, travel agencies and government departments have developed many programs, perhaps because of the lack of marketing in Taiwan, foreign patients are a little unfamiliar to Taiwan's medical reputation, and no foreign agents are willing to bring a large number of patients to Taiwan for treatment.  Wang Zhengkun said that although Taiwan's hospitals and clinics are ready, they have not seen a large influx of foreign patients into Taiwan.  Therefore, to learn the success factors of other countries is a key point, Korea's medical beauty can successfully develop, is to use the power of the whole country in the world to market medical beauty, film, form a culture, expand international advertising, in-depth life, deeply rooted in the hearts of the people, Korean medical beauty marketing strength, breadth and depth are tens of times that of Taiwan, so that foreign patients talk about medical beauty think of Korea.  Then, Korean hospital clinics and agents around the world to form a supply chain, negotiate cooperation conditions, agents from various countries to bring foreign patients to South Korea, this implementation of the concept of supply chain management, in order to really contact foreign patients, in order to bring foreigners into the country for consumption.  If beauty medical tourism can be developed, it is not only medical institutions that benefit, but the entire hotel accommodation industry, transportation industry, tourism industry, and private consumption can be greatly improved.

Title: Tracing prostheses used in plastic surgery
Content: According to Mehr News Agency, Hamed Bateni, in connection with the issue of medical tourism, said: "The medical conditions of the country have scientifically caused patients from other countries to travel to Iran from the region and even from remote parts of the world and benefit from the medical field in Iran."  Pointing out that some people think that patients from other parts of the world come to Iran only because of the cheapness of medical services, he said: "This is a mistake because many countries offer cheaper services in the field of medicine, but patients do not trust and do not want to travel to their country for treatment because their medicine is not strong or the facilities of surgical centers are weak and sometimes unsterile."  The head of the Iranian Society of Plastic and Aesthetic Surgeons continued: In recent years, measures have been started to organize medical tourists through the Ministry of Health and gradually the programs are going to be written and comprehensive so that we hope that soon the field of medical tourism will be completely out of control and operated by translators or non-standard institutions and only under the supervision of the Ministry of Health.  In response to the question of what effect the sanctions of the enemies have had on the field of plastic and cosmetic surgery and whether you are facing a shortage of drugs in this field, he noted: The field of plastic and cosmetic surgery is not very dependent on the aspect of drugs with shortages, but equipment and devices such as implants, prosthetics and beauty products with changing currency fluctuations have increased prices and sometimes products are scarce and imports are not easy.  He said: "The equipment required by plastic surgeons is provided by different brands, depending on the company's production and distribution and their price varies, but all of these equipment and equipment are of good quality and there is no problem in this regard."  The head of the Iranian Society of Plastic and Aesthetic Surgeons noted that most of the equipment and equipment needed for plastic and cosmetic surgery such as implants and prostheses do not have passenger or luggage entry because the reference of these devices is known and all of them have serial numbers that can be traced on the website of the manufacturer and distributor, so there is no concern in this regard.  Bateni said that patients can use this serial number and specifications to track the prosthesis and device used in their body and make sure of its quality, because the prostheses used in plastic and cosmetic surgeries are different from some other surgeries and the patient has a direct role in its preparation.

Title: 35% of global tourism revenue is Iran ’ s share
Content: The advanced and widespread health services in Iran compared to neighboring countries and the relative superiority of these services in terms of price compared to many advanced countries has made the market of health and medical services in Iran attractive to citizens of other countries and a new branch of tourism called health tourism has emerged in the country.  The presence of many of these health tourists can not be limited to health services; these people can also travel to tourist or pilgrimage areas of Iran during and after treatment, which can also help the tourism development of those areas.  According to the Public Relations Department of the Institute of Cultural Heritage and Tourism, Saeed Amirian, discussed this issue at the specialized meeting of “Risk Management in Health Tourism ” held by the Institute of Tourism.  He described medical tourism as an economic activity that requires trade in services and participation of at least two medical and tourism sectors, adding that medical tourism in most cases includes dental services, cosmetic surgery and other types of surgeries.  Amirian, in the definition of health tourism, said: The use of services that improve or increase health and increase the morale of the person and in a place outside his residence for more than 24 hours is considered to be a health tourism.  Referring to the flow of patients from developed countries to developing countries to receive medical services, he said: “The intensifying factor in the flow of medical tourism in recent years is the third payer, employer or insurance, which encourages patients to find medical services at more affordable and faster prices. ”  In describing the dimensions of medical tourism in Iran, he said: Iran ’ s share of attracting this type of tourism during one year was only 350 million dollars; that is, only 0.35% of global health tourism revenue is Iran ’ s share, and with this amount of income, Iran ranks 10th in terms of attracting health tourists.  Referring to the importance of health tourism in Iran, Amirian stated: "The advanced and widespread health services in Iran compared to neighboring countries and the relative superiority of these services in terms of price compared to many advanced countries has made the market of health and health services of Iran attractive to citizens of other countries and a new branch of tourism called health tourism in the country emerges."  He went on to say something about the risk of tourism, saying: "It is mainly a defect in our knowledge of the future and risk is more in the future; risk and uncertainty start exactly where knowledge ends."  The expert added: "By stating that the risk of uncertainties with probabilities and possible outcomes is known, the risk classification is small and large scale, systematic and unsystematic.  Referring to the theoretical reflections of risk and uncertainty in tourism, Amirian said: "Risk is more as something to be avoided, but risk and uncertainty are considered as tourist attractions, especially adventure tourism."  He went on to describe the risks in tourism including individual risks for tourists, the responsibility of tourism service providers, destination risks and social risks, and by giving examples of risks in individual tourism, he explained the ways to cover risks for individual tourists, destination risks, social and tourism risks and governments and risk management.  Referring to the risk in tourism companies and its types, he said the four main strategies for risk management at the company level are knowledge, diversity, trust, and insurance, and said the risk management principle includes four steps; identification of small and large threats that the company may face in the future, analyzing risks and assessing the amount of costs that each risk may bring to the company, formulating a strategy for each possible risk and designing practical measures to deal with it and monitor damage. It is a risk to the company and a modification of past strategies and approaches.

Title: The main directions of beauty tourism: plastic, weight loss, sleep
Content: Hair transplants in Turkey, sleep recovery in Switzerland, liposuction in Brazil: health tourism is booming and expanding horizons.  "Kommersant Style" tells about popular destinations and beauty programs from around the world.  Medical tourism is not a new phenomenon: there have always been those who want to improve their health abroad.  Many countries have their own medical specialization - they are able to do something better than others.  For example, the United States, Brazil, Japan, Mexico and Italy account for 41.4% of all global plastic surgeries.  Patients Beyond Borders estimates that 14 million people travel abroad every year to seek health care.  The obvious reason for the popularity of such tourism for many is the difference in prices.  For example, rhinoplasty in the United States will cost an average of $4.8 thousand, and in Thailand - $1.6 thousand, in a Moscow clinic - about 200 thousand rubles, depending on the complexity.  According to the WHO, Brazil has the best healthcare system in Latin America thanks to the mass accreditation of hospitals by the Joint International Commission (JCI – the largest and oldest medical accreditation organization in the world).  This led to the phenomenon of such tourism in the country.  Surgeons here are like hairdressers.  The most popular procedures in Brazil are liposuction, abdominoplasty and buttock augmentation, called brazilian butt lift.  Of course, the cult of the body is due to the hot climate.  Interestingly, every year the government subsidizes almost half a million operations, for the locals it is the “right to beauty ”.  The same operations are being carried out in neighboring Colombia.  Almost all patients are from the United States.  About 50,000 medical tourists visit the country every year.  From 2012 to 2018, medical tourism in Colombia grew by 264%.  There are more surgeons in South Korea.  It has one of the highest rates of plastic surgery in the world - about 1 million procedures per year, as well as the largest number of plastic surgeons per capita.  The country boasts a thriving tourism industry in this area.  In Korea, they strive to make facial features more Europeanized, so first of all, they change the shape of the nose, eyes (double eyelid surgery), jaws and cheekbones.  The management of Incheon Airport in Seoul even considered the possibility of creating a plastic surgery clinic in one of the terminals so that travelers did not need to travel around the city.  Photo: Getty Images Turkey, although not one of the most popular places for plastic surgery, but the leader in the market of hair transplantation.  Often on the streets of Istanbul and other major cities of the country you can meet people with bandaged heads.  For comparison, hair transplantation costs about $25 thousand in the United States and Europe, in Turkey - from $600 to $2 thousand, in a Moscow clinic - about 100 thousand rubles. for one graft (a group of one to four follicles).  According to the Hurriyet newspaper, in 2017, among 750 thousand tourists, 60 thousand came for hair transplantation.  Most are from the Middle East.  Popular destinations for dental tourism are Thailand, which is called the "Land of Smiles", Vietnam, Mexico and Costa Rica, in Europe - Hungary and Poland.  The most common procedures are the installation of implants, veneers and crowns, bleaching.  For example, Hungary has become the best place in Europe for this direction, it is visited annually by about 7 thousand patients.  This is due to favorable prices, qualified doctors and modern technologies.  Another two popular areas of tourism are the restoration of sleep and weight loss, but not just on detox programs, but thanks to sports in the camps.  Fitness camps are actually recreational sports camps for adults, where in the circle of like-minded people you can surf in Sri Lanka with the Good Story Surf school, go skating on Lake Baikal with Team Trip or learn how to ski in the vicinity of Gstaad with Pro Trener, World Class or SlimFitClub trainers.  Six Senses Douro Valley The newest wellness trend is slip-retreats, which literally teach you to sleep.  As a rule, resorts for the restoration of sleep are located in picturesque places: in the mountains, overlooking the water.  For example, in Portugal, Germany, Italy and Switzerland.  Services include a menu of pillows: from special anti-snoring to filled with water or memory foam, sleep masks and earplugs to choose from, a music library, meditation on demand, as well as staff who can advise on sleep issues.  For example, the hotel in Manhattan, The Benjamin, designed the Rest & Renew program with Rebecca Robbins, a professor of sleep medicine at Cornell University.  Similar programs have Six Senses Douro Valley in Portugal, Peak Health in Switzerland and Lefay on Lake Garda.  Berlin ’ s Swisstel included in its DeepSleep retreat sessions of aroma- and light therapy, as well as inhalation of mountain air.  Beauty tourism is a thriving niche in the industry.  Clinics and hotels offer complete packages, including transfers, flights, meals and even excursions.  According to a joint study by Visa and Oxford Economics, the global medical tourism industry will grow by 25% per year over the next ten years.  Daria Bogomolova

Title: The lawyer told how to save on medicine in another region
Content: https: / / static.news.ru / photo / 34b4225c-b016-11e9-9977-fa163e074e61 _ 660.jpg Photo: Konstantin Kokoshkin / Global Look Press Some medical services are more profitable to get in the regions, because there may be more attractive prices.  This was told by medical lawyer Irina Gritsenko.  According to the expert, the most popular areas in the medical tourism industry are dentistry and cosmetology.  In the regions, prices for these services are almost twice lower than for similar ones in the capital.  You can save, even taking into account the cost of the road, reports the Agency "Prime".  In addition, a whole industry of the medical services market has been formed with its infrastructure, management and even medical tourism agencies.  The lawyer believes that in the context of global economic competition, the phenomenon of medical tourism makes the medical industry develop faster - due to the development of new technologies and improving patient care. passages.title: Architect: dense buildings will be more comfortable for Muscovites
passages.passage: The principle of dense development, according to which housing construction will be implemented within the framework of the renovation program in Moscow, will create quiet secluded places for residents of new buildings due to the clear zoning of spaces.  Chief architect of the capital Sergey Kuznetsov told about the planning of the development in an interview with Izvestia.  According to him, the program will use the same approach to the planning of residential areas as in the center of Moscow.  “No one notices that the building here is denser by two or three times than in areas with Khrushchev.  This is due to the clear zoning of spaces.  People have their own courtyards that they like and are actually very quiet places for a fairly narrow circle of people.  Organized space simulates the behavior of people, and outsiders do not go there, ” the architect explained.  He also noted that concentrated areas of green areas are much more useful than a large area with bushes and trees scattered randomly around the area.  According to Sergey Kuznetsov, in densely built-up areas of the city, air movement is more calm, there are no strong winds, and trees do not fall as often.  Due to this, in winter it is not so cold, and in summer it is not so hot, because there is a shadow.  “From the point of view of safety, dense construction gives many advantages, ” the architect concluded.  Read more in the exclusive interview of Sergey Kuznetsov “Izvestia ”:“ The densely built up city is more comfortable ”

passages.title: Luhansk region and the values of European parks
passages.passage: I remember the ambivalent feelings when I saw how in Prague or Warsaw locals play football in parks, organize exhibitions or sports competitions.  Ukraine still lives on the Soviet imperative: "do not walk on the lawns", with all the ensuing consequences.  The essence of the European "park" paradigm is that such territories are not considered only as places for green spaces.  These are full-fledged public spaces open to people coming with different goals and interests.  Including for physical education and sports.  In the Luhansk region launched an innovative portal that will promote the region Based on this, the requirements for the park as a place of socialization are applicable.  It should be interesting for a teenager on a skateboard, and for a mother with a stroller.  It seems to me that our people are already ready to perceive a new park culture, with a synthesis of environmental and utilitarian functions.  Finding for yourself an opportunity to retire, and a space for communication, and – involvement in the cultural landscape.  In this context, we are trying to fit the program of creating a network of sports grounds in the Luhansk region within the framework of the national project of the President "Healthy Country".  Its essence is in the creation of new public spaces on the territory of local communities.  Not just sports, but universal, for interesting pastime of different social groups.  We have already received funds for 52 sites, and in two years we expect to build 215.  80% of the cost will be provided by the state, subject to 20% co-financing by the community and the region.  The most effective and initiative communities will receive the right to participate in the project.  See also See Paris and the Maldives without going abroad: 5 places in Ukraine, where you have not been yet Provide for the creation of a navigation map for the active involvement of different age groups.  We will install information stands and QR codes on the simulators to watch video instructions of the exercises through a smartphone.  We will provide a unified concept and design of sites.  We will make the highest environmental and safety requirements to minimize the risk of accidents.  Attracting public investment in the construction of health infrastructure is not just a mechanism for updating existing simulators.  This is an attempt to instill in the Luhansk region the European trends of public park spaces.  A significant part of the sports grounds will be placed in areas with green spaces or in places where they will be equipped in the future.  It can be small squares or front gardens, which will appear thanks to new sports locations.  This format, by the way, corresponds to the modern trend of leaving one central park.  European urbanists believe that for the balanced development of territories in the context of decentralization, in addition to the main, the so-called pocket parks in different parts of the community are important.  This provides aesthetic pleasure and stimulates the physical activity of local residents.  At the same time, natural ecosystems are comprehensively protected and local communities are economically strengthened.  The weak point of park zones in Ukraine is their actual availability at certain hours.  The downside of this phenomenon is their attraction to anti-social elements.  The presence of sports infrastructure will increase their public value and eliminate security risks.  And over time, it will instill life there and help attract investments.

passages.title: Construction and operation of 12 pocket parks in Gorgan
passages.passage: Yahya Sotoudeh Nia, in an interview with Mehr reporter, said: "Pocket parks or small parks are small-scale urban open spaces that large cities and cities go to them to create green space."
