Title: Oxygen and hydrogen on Mars proposed to get from brine
Content: Scientists have developed a method for producing oxygen and hydrogen from a liquid saline solution in Martian lakes using electrolysis.  A feature of the experiment was the use of lead-ruthenium oxide as an electrocatalyst for oxygen production.  The production of oxygen using such an installation was 25 times more energy efficient than in the case of MOXIE, launched to the Red Planet as part of the Mars 2020 mission, and the size and weight of the device for life support based on the described technology will be less than that of analogues.  The article was published in the journal PNAS.  Conditions on Mars are far from favorable for humans: the atmosphere is rarefied and 95 percent consists of carbon dioxide, and temperature changes exceed 100 degrees Celsius with an average temperature of minus 63 degrees.  Therefore, colonization of the Red Planet is impossible without the creation of a life support system that would be able to provide people with oxygen for breathing and fuel (for example, hydrogen) for energy supply and, ideally, return flight.  To solve the first problem, NASA created MOXIE (Mars Oxygen ISRU Experiment) - an experimental installation for obtaining oxygen from atmospheric carbon dioxide by electrolysis.  To test the effectiveness of such a method in the field, the installation became part of the Mars Rover Perseverance, which was launched on July 30, 2020 as part of the Mars 2020 mission.  An alternative source of not only oxygen, but also hydrogen on Mars can be water, the first direct evidence of the existence of which on the red planet was obtained in 1971.  Particularly attractive for use in applications, however, would be the reserves of salt water, impurities in which would allow it to remain in a liquid state even at low temperature and pressure.  The first traces of such brine (liquid salt solution) with magnesium perchlorate as the main component were found on Mars in 2015, and in 2018, a reservoir with a diameter of about 20 kilometers was found under the polar ice of the planet, which could have been formed due to volcanic activity.  Later, planetary scientists confirmed that such lakes on Mars really exist and can be numerous.  Now Pralay Gayen (Pralay Gayen) from the University of Washington in St. Louis together with colleagues created an installation for obtaining oxygen and hydrogen from a saline solution close in composition and temperature to that in Martian lakes.  As a brine in the experiment, a solution of magnesium perchlorate in water with a concentration of 2.8 mol per liter was used, cooled to minus 36 degrees Celsius and blown by carbon dioxide (the latter played the role of the Martian atmosphere).  As an electrocatalyst for the production of oxygen, the scientists used lead-ruthenium oxide Pb2Ru2O7-δ, the effectiveness of which they previously showed for alkaline solutions.  The electrocatalyst for hydrogen production was platinum on activated carbon - the standard catalyst in this case, and a commercially produced anion-exchange membrane was used as a separator.  Installation diagram.  In the red region, oxygen is produced, in the blue - hydrogen.  Image source: Pralay Gayen et al. / PNAS In the course of the study, scientists showed that lead-ruthenium oxide as an electrocatalyst is indeed several times more effective than the ruthenium oxide commonly used in such installations.  After the behavior of the created installation was studied in a wide range of temperatures from − 36 to 21 degrees Celsius and saw no radical fluctuations in the efficiency and rate of production.  The current output of the experimental installation was 70 percent, and the energy efficiency was in the range between 36 and 70 percent (depending on the voltage applied to the plates).  In addition, the installation was resistant to degradation of the catalyst: scientists were not able to find traces of ruthenium in the solution after 300-minute operation of the device.  The rate of production of oxygen (blue dots) and hydrogen (red dots), depending on the density of the cathode current.  Image source: Pralay Gayen et al. / PNAS Also, the researchers compared the achieved rate of oxygen production with MOXIE values of 10-22 grams per hour: it turned out that with the same energy supply, the created installation produces 25 times more oxygen than the experiment on the Mars Rover “Perseverance ”.  To have the same rate of oxygen production as MOXIE, the device would have to have electrodes with an area of ​ ​ 28-62 square centimeters, and to ensure the vital activity of a sleeping and actively moving person, this parameter would have to be 375 and 1235 square centimeters, respectively.  At the same time, the mass and volume of the installation will be less than if you use the technology inherent in MOXIE.  Moreover, the developed method of obtaining oxygen does not require its subsequent purification, while during electrolysis in MOXIE, carbon monoxide is also produced, which must be filtered.  Dependence on the power consumption of the rate of oxygen production of the installation (blue line), as well as its capes and volume to ensure various modes of human life (black lines).  The blue dot is the power and rate of oxygen production at MOXIE.  Image source: Pralay Gayen et al. / PNAS Previously, we talked about another method of obtaining oxygen from carbon dioxide in the Martian atmosphere (like MOXIE): scientists proposed to do this using low-temperature plasma.  And what is the role of the Mars Rover “Perseverance ” in addition to checking the method of oxygen production, you can read in our material“ Mars, there and back ”.  Nikita Kozyrev

Title: New technology will be able to produce hydrogen and oxygen from salty Martian water
Content: In space launches, weight matters a lot, so the less we have to take with us, the better.  Now engineers at St. Louis University have developed a new electrolysis device that can convert very salty Martian water into breathable oxygen and hydrogen for fuel.  As you may remember from school, water electrolysis is the process of using electricity to break down water into its constituent hydrogen and oxygen atoms.  These gases can then be collected for use, so in theory electrolysis could be a way for astronauts to produce their own oxygen and hydrogen on the Red Planet.  The problem is that it doesn ’ t work well with brackish water, and that ’ s all you can find on Mars.  First, it is necessary to reduce the high salt content, which is a complex process in this inhospitable alien environment.  Therefore, for the new study, scientists have developed a new electrolysis system that can work with salt water in the extreme cold of the Martian atmosphere.  The key change is in two electrodes: the team created an anode from lead ruthenate pyrochlor and a cathode from platinum on the coal.  To test the new electrolyzer design, scientists modeled the Martian atmosphere, which required cooling to -36 ° C — and it worked.  The researchers say that at the same input power, the new electrolyzer produces 25 times more oxygen than MOXIE, the instrument aboard the Mars Rover Perseverance, which squeezes oxygen from carbon dioxide in the air.  While this technology has intriguing potential uses for astronauts, it ’ s worth remembering that water on Mars is a fairly rare commodity, so it ’ s probably better to use for drinking, although it also requires removing salt first.  Instead, the technology could first find application here on Earth.  "By demonstrating these electrolyzers in challenging Martian conditions, we also intend to deploy them in much milder conditions on Earth to use salt water to produce hydrogen and oxygen, for example by electrolysis of seawater," Pralai Gayen, a co-author of the study, said in a statement.  The study was published in the journal Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences.

Title: Mars Rover Perseverance successfully tested the device to extract oxygen from the Martian atmosphere
Content: An experimental device called MOXIE (Mars Oxygen In-Situ Resource Utilization Experiment) was first tested on April 20, and this test was recognized as successful: for an hour of operation, the installation the size of a conventional toaster was able to produce more than 5 grams of oxygen, writes Newsru.  The atmosphere of Mars is almost 96% carbon dioxide (CO2).  The MOXIE unit is capable of converting this carbon dioxide into oxygen and carbon monoxide (CO, carbon monoxide), which is a by-product of the processing and is released back into the atmosphere.  The process of processing carbon dioxide occurs by electrolysis of solid oxides at a temperature of 800 degrees Celsius.  During operation, the device captures carbon dioxide, passes through a filter to remove dust and compresses it, providing pressure at ground level.  The gas then passes through a heated electrolysis cell, which consists of several layers of nickel alloy and ceramics.  Ceramic elements of the cell are able to conduct current at high temperature - they pass oxygen ions and trap carbon monoxide.  The outer surface of MOXIE is covered with a thin layer of gold.  This coating protects the MOXIE surface from heating, protecting the rover electronics located next to the instrument.  Future astronauts: breathe easier.  The MOXIE technology demonstration aboard @ NASAPersevere successfully extracted oxygen from the thin Martian atmosphere — a critical component for life support on the Red Planet and rocket fuel for the trip home. https: / / t.co / HOsguer. hYgkP pic.twitter.com / SwL0etf9Uu — NASA JPL (@ NASAJPL) April 21, 2021 The maximum estimated performance of MOXIE is up to 10 grams of oxygen per hour.  The test program includes at least nine more tests over two years.  These tests will be carried out under different conditions to assess the performance of the plant.  In the future, more large-scale oxygen production on Mars may come in handy for practical purposes.  First, oxygen is used as an oxidizing agent for rocket fuel.  For example, to launch a rocket with four astronauts from Mars to Earth requires about 7 tons of fuel and 25 tons of oxygen.  The ability to produce this amount of oxygen during the astronauts ’ stay on Mars will prevent this oxygen from being delivered from Earth – delivering a large and productive oxygen generator modeled on MOXIE would be a more practical solution.  Secondly, oxygen, which makes up 21% of the Earth's atmosphere, is needed for breathing - four astronauts will be enough one ton of oxygen for a year on Mars.  We will remind, the Rover Perseverance landed in the area of 45-kilometer crater Jezero, named after the village in Bosnia and Herzegovina.  This crater is located on the western edge of the Isis Plain (a giant impact crater north of the equator of Mars).  As scientists suggest, in ancient times in the area of ​ ​ the crater Ezero was a river delta, where organic matter and other potential traces of microorganisms that could have lived on Mars about 3 billion years ago could have been collected.  The crater itself was then filled with water and was a lake.

Title: How does NASA build a base with breathable air on Mars?
Content: The purpose of writing this article is to understand how we can now prepare for human life on an alien planet, and to do so, Digital Trends spoke to two experts.  Michael Hackett, a professor at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, and Assad Abu Bakr, a NASA engineer, talk about how to keep astronauts alive on a planet that wants to take their lives.  The window of opportunity to send humans to the Red Planet has to pass some kind of necessary timeframe.  Because of the structure of the orbits of Earth and Mars, the easiest way to get from one planet to another is to use the Hohmann Transport Orbit, in which the spacecraft moves in an elliptical orbit and slowly and steadily pushes out.  Hackett explains, “It ’ s because of the way the planets move.  Earth is in orbit around Mars and is moving faster than Mars, so every once in a while they collide.  A year on Mars equals about two years on Earth. ”  So you have to go with the exact timing to launch astronauts to Mars.  Every Martian year, or every 26 months on Earth, is given a window of opportunity at which Mars is closest to Earth.  "So you have an optimal opportunity every 26 months to send a spacecraft to Mars through this orbit.  “So the plans for Mars are to send the infrastructure first, and then after 26 months, we ’ ll send the crew. ”  Sending infrastructure doesn ’ t just mean ensuring astronauts have access to air to breathe and food to eat.  It also means sending and building power plants, a habitat, rovers, and vehicles that will allow astronauts to leave Mars once the mission is complete.  Why is oxygen so important?  The first major problem to deal with when building a Martian base is the production of oxygen.  When you hear about producing oxygen on Mars, you ’ re probably thinking about the simplest human need: having air to breathe, and certainly not finding a way to produce a breathable atmosphere inside a confined habitat on Mars.  But the habitat will require, at least compared to other components of the project, very small amounts of oxygen.  By other components, we mean things like rocket propellants that lift astronauts off the surface of the planet.  Hackett explains, “We are trying to manufacture the drive prerequisites.  "We're not trying to make fuel, we're trying to get some of the necessary chemical reactions that we never think about on Earth."  On the ground, when you burn gasoline in your car ’ s engine, you use oxygen that weighs several times more than your fuel to cause that reaction.  The same is true of pieces of wood burning in the fireplace.  “But if you go somewhere where there is no free oxygen, you have to take oxygen with you. ”  Modern missiles have several liquid oxygen tanks that provide the final fuel and add a lot of weight to the entire payload.  “We ’ ll need about 30 tons of oxygen to get those astronauts off the surface and into orbit, and if we have to take those 30 tons of oxygen with us to Mars, the whole mission will be delayed for about a decade.  A much easier solution would be to send an empty tank there and fill it with oxygen. ”  Using what is available to produce oxygen on Mars, Hackett and his colleagues are working on a concept called In-situ Resource Utilization (ISRU).  Basically, it means using whatever is already found on Mars to build what we need.  They will have to experiment with a device called MOXIE, which, along with NASA's Endurance rover, successfully landed on Mars in February 2021.  MOXIE is essentially a miniature version of a much larger device that picks up carbon dioxide, which is found abundantly in the Martian atmosphere, and produces oxygen.  This device may seem complicated at first glance, but it ’ s actually similar to a very well-known technology on the planet.  According to Hackett, “MOXIE is very much like a fuel cell.  There is basically no difference between the two.  If you take a fuel cell and you reverse the two wires that have been wired into it, you have an electrification system.  This means that if the device is a fuel cell, you have a fuel and an oxidizer that deliver a stable molecule.  If you have carbon monoxide as fuel and oxygen, carbon dioxide is produced.  You also get electricity. ”  “Now, if you reverse that, you have to let in carbon dioxide and electricity, and what you get is carbon monoxide and oxygen.  That ’ s how we ’ ll solve the problem. ”  This seemingly simple idea is radical in that it addresses a problem that no one outside the aerospace community sees as a challenge: producing oxygen.  Hackett said, “Nobody wants to produce oxygen on Earth.  No one has a reason to do that.  Oxygen is everywhere. ”  How to build an oxygen machine?  Understanding the chemical rules of making an oxygen machine is one thing, and designing and implementing a version of it that fits inside a rover is another.  Abu Bakr, the MOXIE thermal engineer at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory and who has been involved in the development of the MOXIE project from the beginning, explains how the experimental device was built and what obstacles the NASA lab team had to overcome.  He said: “The biggest challenge we ’ ve ever had is a little bit of energy.  The rover has a radioisotope thermoelectric generator, which is a nuclear source of electricity, so people think the rover relies on nuclear power, but that's not the case.  The rover is powered by batteries and has an atomic charger next to it. ”  This means that researchers need to be very careful about how much energy is being used to keep the battery from draining.  The entire Mars Endurance operates at only 110 watts, which is just a little more energy than it takes to light a light-bulb bulb.  As a result, a device like MOXIE has to operate with very small amounts of energy.  Simple knowledge but equipment design is only one aspect of trial and error – the other is to see if the idea works at all on Mars.  Even with concepts that work well on Earth, an alien environment can have unforeseen consequences, from the impact of the planet ’ s thin atmosphere on how heat is transferred to the depreciation of equipment in unexpected ways due to weaker gravity and unknown dust.  That ’ s why NASA engineers will soon be collecting MOXIE data to test its performance in Mars ’ true environment.  “In many ways, ” says Abu Bakr,“ MOXIE doesn ’ t really collect scientific data. ”  Compared to scientific equipment such as telescopes and spectrometers used to analyze rock samples, the data collected by MOXIE is relatively simple.  “What we get is almost like telemetry data in engineering.  We measure voltages and currents and temperatures, things like that.  This is our data, and the data is very small.  You can almost fit all of them in a floppy disk. ”  This means the team can get very quick feedback on whether the system is working properly – in just a few days.  Unlike other instruments on the endurance rover, which require weeks, months, or even years to analyze the data, MOXIE is a demonstration of practical performance rather than trial and error.  Abu Bakr said, “What we ’ re doing is not science, it ’ s technology.  We want to know whether the system works, and if we want to increase the scale in the future, what we need to do to make our goal work. ”  If MOXIE is successful, it will show how practical the ISRU principle is on Mars.  Then expanding the scale of the project and building a version of the machine on a real scale that produces oxygen at a much higher rate will be relatively easy; and the good news is that a larger version will appear more efficient and produce significant amounts of oxygen without requiring much energy.  With the oxygen challenge solved, we could move on to other resources humans need to survive on Mars.  Another essential resource that we need to establish in order to produce it on the Red Planet is water.  Water isn ’ t just necessary for humans to drink, but it ’ s also important because of the hydrogen and carbon dioxide compounds that can bring a plethora of efficient chemical compounds.  Hackett said: “The idea in the short term is to automate certain amounts of ISRU to make our mission possible.  “Once we build our base on Mars — a base like the McMurdo Station in Antarctica or the International Space Station — we can move on to more sophisticated ISRU methods like ice extraction. ”  “A lot of people feel like we need to extract ice automatically.  But I say no, it ’ s not worth the effort.  Ice is a mineral, which means you have to look for it underground, dig it out of the ground, and purify it.  It would be easier to take ice with us to Mars.  It's like a moxie, but it's a mechanical tree.  It breathes carbon dioxide and exhales oxygen. ”  Hackett argues that MOXIE is much easier to find resources through mining.  “It doesn ’ t have to go anywhere, it doesn ’ t have to look for anything.  These are methods in IRSU that appear to be really practical in the short term.  “You ’ re doing things as simple as possible, and one day you ’ ll have access to enough people

Title: Earth ’ s microbes should be sent to Mars.
Content: Space agencies have taken a lot of precautions not to contaminate celestial bodies with terrestrial microbes, but some researchers believe sending Earth microbes to Mars could be beneficial because doing so could transform the Martian environment into a habitat for humans.  Researchers have recently said that Earth ’ s microbes should be sent to Mars for colonization so that the Red Planet becomes a suitable place for humans to live.  A recent study has shown that the spread of Earth ’ s microbes could trigger a change in the structure of the Red Planet and create an environment where humans can live.  Scientists have developed a process that involves screening promising microbes and leaving the most important on Mars.  The researchers' new paper shows that the release of human microbes is the beginning of the process of restructuring the Red Planet and creating an environment in which humans can inhabit.  Jose Lopez, a microbiologist and professor at Nova Southeastern University in Florida, USA, conducted the study with his colleagues.  They asked NASA and other space agencies to send microbes to Mars so they could change the planet ’ s unpredictable environment and create a habitable environment on Mars.  The main argument of the researchers is that preventing pollution is nearly impossible, but it can be done by doing some things, such as sending human microbes there.  According to the researchers, microorganisms are what made our planet habitable.  As we know, without beneficial microorganisms, life cannot exist.  More than four billion years ago, Earth was not a habitable place, but microbial life arose and evolved over time.  The findings were published in the FEMS Journal of Microbiology Ecology.

Title: Scientists have found organisms that can give rise to life on Mars
Content: Scientists have found organisms that can give rise to life on Mars 16.02.2021, 14: 58 They are able to grow and multiply in the conditions of the red planet.  New experiments have shown that cyanobacteria, also known as blue-green algae, can successfully grow in Martian atmospheric conditions.  Of course, a few more ingredients will be needed, but when humans get to Mars, they will be able to create life support systems based on cyanobacteria for the human habitat, writes nv.ua.  "Here we show that cyanobacteria can use the gases available in the Martian atmosphere, at low overall pressure, as a source of carbon and nitrogen," said astrobiologist Cyprien Verso from the University of Bremen in Germany.  "Under these conditions, cyanobacteria retained their ability to grow in water containing only Martian dust, and they could be used to feed other microbes.  This can help make long-term missions to Mars sustainable, ” the authors of the study believe.  All types of cyanobacteria produce oxygen as a byproduct of photosynthesis, and even today they are an invaluable source of it.  For several years, scientists have speculated whether we could use the ability of cyanobacteria to produce oxygen to live on Mars.  This will bring additional benefits.  The atmosphere of Mars consists mainly of carbon dioxide (95 percent) and nitrogen (3 percent), which are fixed by cyanobacteria, turning them into organic compounds and nutrients, respectively.  However, atmospheric pressure on Mars is a big problem. Title: Oxygen and hydrogen on Mars proposed to get from brine
Content: Scientists have developed a method for producing oxygen and hydrogen from a liquid saline solution in Martian lakes using electrolysis.  A feature of the experiment was the use of lead-ruthenium oxide as an electrocatalyst for oxygen production.  The production of oxygen using such an installation was 25 times more energy efficient than in the case of MOXIE, launched to the Red Planet as part of the Mars 2020 mission, and the size and weight of the device for life support based on the described technology will be less than that of analogues.  The article was published in the journal PNAS.  Conditions on Mars are far from favorable for humans: the atmosphere is rarefied and 95 percent consists of carbon dioxide, and temperature changes exceed 100 degrees Celsius with an average temperature of minus 63 degrees.  Therefore, colonization of the Red Planet is impossible without the creation of a life support system that would be able to provide people with oxygen for breathing and fuel (for example, hydrogen) for energy supply and, ideally, return flight.  To solve the first problem, NASA created MOXIE (Mars Oxygen ISRU Experiment) - an experimental installation for obtaining oxygen from atmospheric carbon dioxide by electrolysis.  To test the effectiveness of such a method in the field, the installation became part of the Mars Rover Perseverance, which was launched on July 30, 2020 as part of the Mars 2020 mission.  An alternative source of not only oxygen, but also hydrogen on Mars can be water, the first direct evidence of the existence of which on the red planet was obtained in 1971.  Particularly attractive for use in applications, however, would be the reserves of salt water, impurities in which would allow it to remain in a liquid state even at low temperature and pressure.  The first traces of such brine (liquid salt solution) with magnesium perchlorate as the main component were found on Mars in 2015, and in 2018, a reservoir with a diameter of about 20 kilometers was found under the polar ice of the planet, which could have been formed due to volcanic activity.  Later, planetary scientists confirmed that such lakes on Mars really exist and can be numerous.  Now Pralay Gayen (Pralay Gayen) from the University of Washington in St. Louis together with colleagues created an installation for obtaining oxygen and hydrogen from a saline solution close in composition and temperature to that in Martian lakes.  As a brine in the experiment, a solution of magnesium perchlorate in water with a concentration of 2.8 mol per liter was used, cooled to minus 36 degrees Celsius and blown by carbon dioxide (the latter played the role of the Martian atmosphere).  As an electrocatalyst for the production of oxygen, the scientists used lead-ruthenium oxide Pb2Ru2O7-δ, the effectiveness of which they previously showed for alkaline solutions.  The electrocatalyst for hydrogen production was platinum on activated carbon - the standard catalyst in this case, and a commercially produced anion-exchange membrane was used as a separator.  Installation diagram.  In the red region, oxygen is produced, in the blue - hydrogen.  Image source: Pralay Gayen et al. / PNAS In the course of the study, scientists showed that lead-ruthenium oxide as an electrocatalyst is indeed several times more effective than the ruthenium oxide commonly used in such installations.  After the behavior of the created installation was studied in a wide range of temperatures from − 36 to 21 degrees Celsius and saw no radical fluctuations in the efficiency and rate of production.  The current output of the experimental installation was 70 percent, and the energy efficiency was in the range between 36 and 70 percent (depending on the voltage applied to the plates).  In addition, the installation was resistant to degradation of the catalyst: scientists were not able to find traces of ruthenium in the solution after 300-minute operation of the device.  The rate of production of oxygen (blue dots) and hydrogen (red dots), depending on the density of the cathode current.  Image source: Pralay Gayen et al. / PNAS Also, the researchers compared the achieved rate of oxygen production with MOXIE values of 10-22 grams per hour: it turned out that with the same energy supply, the created installation produces 25 times more oxygen than the experiment on the Mars Rover “Perseverance ”.  To have the same rate of oxygen production as MOXIE, the device would have to have electrodes with an area of ​ ​ 28-62 square centimeters, and to ensure the vital activity of a sleeping and actively moving person, this parameter would have to be 375 and 1235 square centimeters, respectively.  At the same time, the mass and volume of the installation will be less than if you use the technology inherent in MOXIE.  Moreover, the developed method of obtaining oxygen does not require its subsequent purification, while during electrolysis in MOXIE, carbon monoxide is also produced, which must be filtered.  Dependence on the power consumption of the rate of oxygen production of the installation (blue line), as well as its capes and volume to ensure various modes of human life (black lines).  The blue dot is the power and rate of oxygen production at MOXIE.  Image source: Pralay Gayen et al. / PNAS Previously, we talked about another method of obtaining oxygen from carbon dioxide in the Martian atmosphere (like MOXIE): scientists proposed to do this using low-temperature plasma.  And what is the role of the Mars Rover “Perseverance ” in addition to checking the method of oxygen production, you can read in our material“ Mars, there and back ”.  Nikita Kozyrev

Title: New technology will be able to produce hydrogen and oxygen from salty Martian water
Content: In space launches, weight matters a lot, so the less we have to take with us, the better.  Now engineers at St. Louis University have developed a new electrolysis device that can convert very salty Martian water into breathable oxygen and hydrogen for fuel.  As you may remember from school, water electrolysis is the process of using electricity to break down water into its constituent hydrogen and oxygen atoms.  These gases can then be collected for use, so in theory electrolysis could be a way for astronauts to produce their own oxygen and hydrogen on the Red Planet.  The problem is that it doesn ’ t work well with brackish water, and that ’ s all you can find on Mars.  First, it is necessary to reduce the high salt content, which is a complex process in this inhospitable alien environment.  Therefore, for the new study, scientists have developed a new electrolysis system that can work with salt water in the extreme cold of the Martian atmosphere.  The key change is in two electrodes: the team created an anode from lead ruthenate pyrochlor and a cathode from platinum on the coal.  To test the new electrolyzer design, scientists modeled the Martian atmosphere, which required cooling to -36 ° C — and it worked.  The researchers say that at the same input power, the new electrolyzer produces 25 times more oxygen than MOXIE, the instrument aboard the Mars Rover Perseverance, which squeezes oxygen from carbon dioxide in the air.  While this technology has intriguing potential uses for astronauts, it ’ s worth remembering that water on Mars is a fairly rare commodity, so it ’ s probably better to use for drinking, although it also requires removing salt first.  Instead, the technology could first find application here on Earth.  "By demonstrating these electrolyzers in challenging Martian conditions, we also intend to deploy them in much milder conditions on Earth to use salt water to produce hydrogen and oxygen, for example by electrolysis of seawater," Pralai Gayen, a co-author of the study, said in a statement.  The study was published in the journal Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences.

Title: Mars Rover Perseverance successfully tested the device to extract oxygen from the Martian atmosphere
Content: An experimental device called MOXIE (Mars Oxygen In-Situ Resource Utilization Experiment) was first tested on April 20, and this test was recognized as successful: for an hour of operation, the installation the size of a conventional toaster was able to produce more than 5 grams of oxygen, writes Newsru. The MOXIE unit is capable of converting this carbon dioxide into oxygen and carbon monoxide (CO, carbon monoxide), which is a by-product of the processing and is released back into the atmosphere.  The process of processing carbon dioxide occurs by electrolysis of solid oxides at a temperature of 800 degrees Celsius.  During operation, the device captures carbon dioxide, passes through a filter to remove dust and compresses it, providing pressure at ground level.  The gas then passes through a heated electrolysis cell, which consists of several layers of nickel alloy and ceramics.  Ceramic elements of the cell are able to conduct current at high temperature - they pass oxygen ions and trap carbon monoxide.  The outer surface of MOXIE is covered with a thin layer of gold.  This coating protects the MOXIE surface from heating, protecting the rover electronics located next to the instrument.  Future astronauts: breathe easier. Title: How does NASA build a base with breathable air on Mars?
Content: The purpose of writing this article is to understand how we can now prepare for human life on an alien planet, and to do so, Digital Trends spoke to two experts.  Michael Hackett, a professor at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, and Assad Abu Bakr, a NASA engineer, talk about how to keep astronauts alive on a planet that wants to take their lives.  The window of opportunity to send humans to the Red Planet has to pass some kind of necessary timeframe.  Because of the structure of the orbits of Earth and Mars, the easiest way to get from one planet to another is to use the Hohmann Transport Orbit, in which the spacecraft moves in an elliptical orbit and slowly and steadily pushes out.  Hackett explains, “It ’ s because of the way the planets move.  Earth is in orbit around Mars and is moving faster than Mars, so every once in a while they collide.  A year on Mars equals about two years on Earth. ”  So you have to go with the exact timing to launch astronauts to Mars.  Every Martian year, or every 26 months on Earth, is given a window of opportunity at which Mars is closest to Earth.  "So you have an optimal opportunity every 26 months to send a spacecraft to Mars through this orbit.  “So the plans for Mars are to send the infrastructure first, and then after 26 months, we ’ ll send the crew. ”  Sending infrastructure doesn ’ t just mean ensuring astronauts have access to air to breathe and food to eat.  It also means sending and building power plants, a habitat, rovers, and vehicles that will allow astronauts to leave Mars once the mission is complete.  Why is oxygen so important?  The first major problem to deal with when building a Martian base is the production of oxygen.  When you hear about producing oxygen on Mars, you ’ re probably thinking about the simplest human need: having air to breathe, and certainly not finding a way to produce a breathable atmosphere inside a confined habitat on Mars.  But the habitat will require, at least compared to other components of the project, very small amounts of oxygen.  By other components, we mean things like rocket propellants that lift astronauts off the surface of the planet.  Hackett explains, “We are trying to manufacture the drive prerequisites.  "We're not trying to make fuel, we're trying to get some of the necessary chemical reactions that we never think about on Earth."  On the ground, when you burn gasoline in your car ’ s engine, you use oxygen that weighs several times more than your fuel to cause that reaction.  The same is true of pieces of wood burning in the fireplace.  “But if you go somewhere where there is no free oxygen, you have to take oxygen with you. ”  Modern missiles have several liquid oxygen tanks that provide the final fuel and add a lot of weight to the entire payload.  “We ’ ll need about 30 tons of oxygen to get those astronauts off the surface and into orbit, and if we have to take those 30 tons of oxygen with us to Mars, the whole mission will be delayed for about a decade.  A much easier solution would be to send an empty tank there and fill it with oxygen. ”  Using what is available to produce oxygen on Mars, Hackett and his colleagues are working on a concept called In-situ Resource Utilization (ISRU).  Basically, it means using whatever is already found on Mars to build what we need.  They will have to experiment with a device called MOXIE, which, along with NASA's Endurance rover, successfully landed on Mars in February 2021.  MOXIE is essentially a miniature version of a much larger device that picks up carbon dioxide, which is found abundantly in the Martian atmosphere, and produces oxygen.  This device may seem complicated at first glance, but it ’ s actually similar to a very well-known technology on the planet.  According to Hackett, “MOXIE is very much like a fuel cell.  There is basically no difference between the two.  If you take a fuel cell and you reverse the two wires that have been wired into it, you have an electrification system.  This means that if the device is a fuel cell, you have a fuel and an oxidizer that deliver a stable molecule.  If you have carbon monoxide as fuel and oxygen, carbon dioxide is produced.  You also get electricity. ”  “Now, if you reverse that, you have to let in carbon dioxide and electricity, and what you get is carbon monoxide and oxygen.  That ’ s how we ’ ll solve the problem. ”  This seemingly simple idea is radical in that it addresses a problem that no one outside the aerospace community sees as a challenge: producing oxygen.  Hackett said, “Nobody wants to produce oxygen on Earth.  No one has a reason to do that.  Oxygen is everywhere. ”  How to build an oxygen machine?  Understanding the chemical rules of making an oxygen machine is one thing, and designing and implementing a version of it that fits inside a rover is another.  Abu Bakr, the MOXIE thermal engineer at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory and who has been involved in the development of the MOXIE project from the beginning, explains how the experimental device was built and what obstacles the NASA lab team had to overcome.  He said: “The biggest challenge we ’ ve ever had is a little bit of energy.  The rover has a radioisotope thermoelectric generator, which is a nuclear source of electricity, so people think the rover relies on nuclear power, but that's not the case.  The rover is powered by batteries and has an atomic charger next to it. ”  This means that researchers need to be very careful about how much energy is being used to keep the battery from draining.  The entire Mars Endurance operates at only 110 watts, which is just a little more energy than it takes to light a light-bulb bulb.  As a result, a device like MOXIE has to operate with very small amounts of energy.  Simple knowledge but equipment design is only one aspect of trial and error – the other is to see if the idea works at all on Mars.  Even with concepts that work well on Earth, an alien environment can have unforeseen consequences, from the impact of the planet ’ s thin atmosphere on how heat is transferred to the depreciation of equipment in unexpected ways due to weaker gravity and unknown dust.  That ’ s why NASA engineers will soon be collecting MOXIE data to test its performance in Mars ’ true environment.  “In many ways, ” says Abu Bakr,“ MOXIE doesn ’ t really collect scientific data. ”  Compared to scientific equipment such as telescopes and spectrometers used to analyze rock samples, the data collected by MOXIE is relatively simple.  “What we get is almost like telemetry data in engineering.  We measure voltages and currents and temperatures, things like that.  This is our data, and the data is very small.  You can almost fit all of them in a floppy disk. ”  This means the team can get very quick feedback on whether the system is working properly – in just a few days.  Unlike other instruments on the endurance rover, which require weeks, months, or even years to analyze the data, MOXIE is a demonstration of practical performance rather than trial and error.  Abu Bakr said, “What we ’ re doing is not science, it ’ s technology.  We want to know whether the system works, and if we want to increase the scale in the future, what we need to do to make our goal work. ”  If MOXIE is successful, it will show how practical the ISRU principle is on Mars.  Then expanding the scale of the project and building a version of the machine on a real scale that produces oxygen at a much higher rate will be relatively easy; and the good news is that a larger version will appear more efficient and produce significant amounts of oxygen without requiring much energy.  With the oxygen challenge solved, we could move on to other resources humans need to survive on Mars.  Another essential resource that we need to establish in order to produce it on the Red Planet is water.  Water isn ’ t just necessary for humans to drink, but it ’ s also important because of the hydrogen and carbon dioxide compounds that can bring a plethora of efficient chemical compounds.  Hackett said: “The idea in the short term is to automate certain amounts of ISRU to make our mission possible.  “Once we build our base on Mars — a base like the McMurdo Station in Antarctica or the International Space Station — we can move on to more sophisticated ISRU methods like ice extraction. ”  “A lot of people feel like we need to extract ice automatically. passages.title: Lawyers are among the most regular segments of society in the payment of job taxes.
passages.passage: A member of the Board of Directors of the Center ’ s Bar Association emphasized in a note that lawyers are among the most disciplined segments of society in paying job taxes.  According to ISNA, the text of Seyyed Mehdi Hojjati ’ s note in this regard is as follows: “In recent years, the Bar Association, the legal profession and the lawyers have been subjected to the most severe attacks and attacks, and the process of hitting and accusing the body of the independent legal body of the country is a growing trend.  Among the most recent allegations made by a few media outlets and currents that have targeted the country ’ s legal institution, tax evasion of lawyers and focusing on it as a new pretext for launching a new round of attacks on the Bar Associations and its members, which of course has been accompanied by the constant support of the national media.  Claims of tax evasion by lawyers start with providing false statistics about the number of cases filed in the judicial system.  While some newspapers have pointed to the existence of 15 million cases annually in the judiciary, which of about 15 million cases in the judicial courts, less than 10 percent of cases have lawyers, and they have assumed that 10 percent of the cases are equal to 1.5 million cases, which if both parties have lawyers, therefore, lawyers represent a total of 3 million cases annually, and then with The unrealistic assumption and confirmation of the 20 million Tomans figure for each of the lawyers on both sides of the case has concluded that the total turnover of the attorney market is 60 trillion tomans, and lawyers, if they account for 20% of this turnover, have 12 trillion tomans tax evasion!!  Regardless of the fact that many cases in the judiciary do not have a second party in the sense of private interest (such as cases of drugs or alcohol, etc.).  The remarkable point in this article is that the claimants of the existence of 15 million current cases in the country ’ s judiciary are not yet familiar with a category called “rotational statistics ” and“ unique statistics ” in the country ’ s judiciary, and therefore, ultimately, their analysis turns out to be incorrect and wrong.  It should be noted that a case goes through different stages from the time it is registered in the judicial authorities and until the end of the hearing and execution of the verdict, and in each of these stages, it is registered with a new number.  For example, the plaintiff ’ s lawsuit is filed once in the first phase in the general legal court.  After the verdict is issued, the person who has been harmed by the court ’ s decision will appeal the verdict and the case will be registered again in the province ’ s appeals court, and if the appeal court ’ s decision is admissible (such as claims on the principle of divorce), it will be registered again in the Supreme Court. The operation would take that number.  In this way, a case can be registered several times in different judicial authorities and the statistics of its registration can reach 10 cases, while a single case and a single case that is registered only with different numbers.  However, these statistics, which result from the repeated registration of the case in the judicial system and at each stage, are determined for that class of archives; this is the case of "rotational statistics" that shows the workflow of a case in different stages and the path that a case has taken in different stages of the judicial system; in fact, if we add a process to the cases, we get rotational statistics; while "unique statistics" The actual number of disputes processed in the courts and the number of entries to the judiciary is disconnected from the steps that a case goes through in order to reach a conclusion and execute a verdict.  Thus, despite the statistics that the existence of current cases in the judiciary by some media and the honorable people of Iran is statistically among the most contentious people in the world, the actual statistics of current cases in the Iranian judiciary are about a third of the statistics wrongly announced by some media.  According to the Minister of Justice, in 95, about 5 million and 585 thousand cases and in 96, about 5 million and 825 thousand and 331 unique cases entered the judicial system of the country.  Thus, even if we accept the impossibility of 10% of the claim for the presence of lawyers and 20 million Tomans of lawyers for each case, in this case, the turnover of the country ’ s legal district will be reduced to 20 trillion, which is a significant difference with the alleged figure of some media.  On the other hand, the claim of 12 thousand billion Tomans by lawyers is not an unjustified claim, because regardless of how the lawyers calculate the amount of income of lawyers is based on incorrect components, apparently the perception of tax evasion lawyers has been that lawyers with an income of 60 trillion Tomans per year, do not even pay a rial for taxes to the government, which the charge of twelve thousand Tomans by calculating the 20 percent of the above amount attributed to them!  Meanwhile, lawyers both pay tax at the time of the declaration of attorney, through the annulment of tax stamps, and each year by submitting tax returns to the asset offices, their taxes are calculated with amounts much heavier than the actual figure, which is not proportionate to the income and expenses of lawyers.  However, the statistics provided by some of the newspapers are such that statistics are used to reach a predetermined result, for example, one of the newspapers that previously claimed 20 percent of cases entered the court with a lawyer and the income of each lawyer for each case was 50 million tomans; subsequently, after a departure from the previous statistics, another statistic was presented as above, which based on what was stated in the previous chapter, was false. income. This proves that the average of 20 million Tomans for each case is also a false and indisputable statistic, and the number of cases that lawyers are involved in the process of judicial proceedings without receiving the right of attorney is much higher than the public imagination.  For example, the chairman of the Committee of Emadamam Khomeini recently reported the statistics of five thousand voluntary legal services by lawyers members of the Bar Associations to the clients of this institution in the first quarter of 2019 that the lawyers have not received any amount in return as a fee or a fee for consultation, and yet the media are less likely to mention such services provided by lawyers. passages.title: Roskachestvo has refuted the myth of preservatives in protein bars
passages.passage: https: / / static.news.ru / photo / thunk _ 660.jpg Roskachestvo specialists checked four types of bars of 20 brands from Russia, Poland and Germany and did not find them exceeding the permissible norms for preservatives.  According to 86 indicators, protein (protein) bars, cereal bars, fruit and nut-fruit bars, as well as bars for weight loss were checked.  The myth that the bars consist of solid preservatives has not been confirmed.  Manufacturers, if they use them, then without exceeding the regulatory norms.  In addition, trans fats in any of the goods are not found at all, — stated in the message of Roskachestvo.  According to experts, protein bars justified their name, since they do contain the highest amount of protein in comparison with other categories.  At the same time, the spread in protein content was more than twice: from 35.7 g per 100 g to 16.9 g.  In the bars of two trademarks revealed a discrepancy in the mass fraction of carbohydrates with the declared indicators in the labeling.  In the healthy snack cereal bar, it is overstated ten times, and in the Bombbar protein bar it is understated almost three times.  Experts also found that a third of manufacturers indicate incorrect data about the energy value of their bars.  At the same time, some underestimate the number of calories, others overestimate.  There was also a discrepancy in the amount of vitamins and minerals in bars, although the discrepancy with the number indicated on the label is small.  Earlier, NEWS.ru reported that Roskachestvo conducted a study of spices that are sold in most Russian stores.  A number of violations on microbiological indicators were identified.  The study began after a survey that showed that some buyers are afraid of low-quality products that may contain hazardous substances.

passages.title: Scientists have learned the taste of an electronic cigarette, which “kills ” the lungs
passages.passage: All 10 fragrances tested cause some level of toxicity in the cells.  A new study shows that e-cigarettes with a taste of chocolate are "particularly harmful" to the lungs.  As reported in a study published on Psychology.org, in fact, scientists have found that all 10 of the flavors tested cause some level of toxicity in the cells lining the lungs, which in some cases leads to their death.  Toxins also significantly reduce the ability of immune system cells to remove bacteria and regulate inflammation.  An article about the study was published in the American Journal of Lung Physiology, Cell and Molecular Physiology.  Data show that the chemical profiles of the studied e-liquid flavors (apple, banana, chewing gum, cappuccino, cherry, chocolate, cinnamon, mango, peppermint and tobacco) contained up to 15 chemicals.  The most harmful flavors, such as chocolate and banana, contain a large amount of a chemical component called the benzene ring.  Flavors with a lower concentration of the benzene ring were less harmful.  The researchers also found that different brands of chocolate and banana-flavored e-cigarette liquids with fewer benzene ring chemicals were also less harmful.  According to the researchers, the aim of the study was to determine whether immune dysfunction and toxicity in the lungs, which were previously observed in earlier studies, depended on the taste used, regardless of the presence of nicotine.  To find out, they exposed lung cells from healthy, non-smoking people to e-cigarette vapors produced with a variety of flavorings.  "We believe that this study provides evidence that the potential harm from the use of flavorings is not related to the name on the bottle, but rather to the chemical composition of the flavorant, the flavorings present and their concentration," said researcher Miranda Win, Ph.D., Adelaide Hospital in Australia.  "This suggests that any restrictions on permitted flavors should be based on data of this kind to ensure that permitted foods do represent the least possible level of harm," she adds.

Dr. Abbas Paryani, in an interview with ISNA, said that these goods are in their specific categories of oils, meat products, beverages, tobacco, cosmetics, drugs with the possibility of abuse, sauces and...  They will be divided.  He said that this year we did not have an increase in harmful goods to health, adding: in some cases, a harmful product replaces another product.  This is also due to the annual monitoring of the production of new goods or the estimation of the consumption of a particular commodity.  The head of the task force for determining the list of harmful health goods, emphasizing that the extent of their damage to the whole community is considered in the examination of the goods, said: The product may or may not be harmful to a person, but this is not our criterion and we look at the whole community and the prevalence of non-communicable diseases, and one of the factors that causes the name of the product on the list of the damage is the total consumption.  Referring to the fact that the formation of the list of harmful goods goes back to the year 90, he stated: Advertising of goods that are on this list is prohibited.  Once the names of these items are included in the list of harmful goods, some of them go to a committee to close taxes and duties.  Paryani continued on the Ministry of Health ’ s pursuit of non-advertising of harmful health products from television networks, saying: “Our colleagues in medical universities have given the necessary warnings or report the issues to the Ministry of Guidance and we try to prevent them from being advertised in this way, of course, there have been cases that have been handed over to judicial pursuits. ”  The results of these measures vary in different provinces.  For example, in Yazd province, there is a good coordination between the University of Medical Sciences, the Judiciary and the Ministry of Guidance, which strictly enforce this law.  In some cases, the judge may conclude that the action taken is a violation and not a crime.  Stating that non-communicable diseases are not affected by a single factor, he said: The origin of non-communicable diseases are risk factors, part of which is nutritional, but lack of mobility, tobacco use, age and so on.  They will also play a role.  Therefore, it is not possible to talk about non-communicable diseases just by looking at the nutrition and consumption or non-consumption of harmful goods, but certainly the consumption of high-fat and high-calorie foods is one of the causes of non-communicable diseases that we try to reduce by announcing this list.  At the same time as announcing this list to the ministers of science and education, we announce that these goods are from buffets, eateries, and so on.  It is collected in schools and universities.  At the end, he emphasized that the goods on the list of harmful substances are not prohibited goods, that is, their low consumption does not cause a problem.  Consuming too much or too much of it in certain groups, such as children, can have negative effects.  Also, the consumption of these items in childhood can cause changes in taste in adulthood and the habit of consuming high-fat and sugary foods and...  He created it in person.  End of message.

Among the most recent allegations made by a few media outlets and currents that have targeted the country ’ s legal institution, tax evasion of lawyers and focusing on it as a new pretext for launching a new round of attacks on the Bar Associations and its members, which of course has been accompanied by the constant support of the national media.  Claims of tax evasion by lawyers start with providing false statistics about the number of cases filed in the judicial system.  While some newspapers have pointed to the existence of 15 million cases annually in the judiciary, which of about 15 million cases in the judicial courts, less than 10 percent of cases have lawyers, and they have assumed that 10 percent of the cases are equal to 1.5 million cases, which if both parties have lawyers, therefore, lawyers represent a total of 3 million cases annually, and then with The unrealistic assumption and confirmation of the 20 million Tomans figure for each of the lawyers on both sides of the case has concluded that the total turnover of the attorney market is 60 trillion tomans, and lawyers, if they account for 20% of this turnover, have 12 trillion tomans tax evasion!!  Regardless of the fact that many cases in the judiciary do not have a second party in the sense of private interest (such as cases of drugs or alcohol, etc.).  The remarkable point in this article is that the claimants of the existence of 15 million current cases in the country ’ s judiciary are not yet familiar with a category called “rotational statistics ” and“ unique statistics ” in the country ’ s judiciary, and therefore, ultimately, their analysis turns out to be incorrect and wrong.  It should be noted that a case goes through different stages from the time it is registered in the judicial authorities and until the end of the hearing and execution of the verdict, and in each of these stages, it is registered with a new number.  For example, the plaintiff ’ s lawsuit is filed once in the first phase in the general legal court.  After the verdict is issued, the person who has been harmed by the court ’ s decision will appeal the verdict and the case will be registered again in the province ’ s appeals court, and if the appeal court ’ s decision is admissible (such as claims on the principle of divorce), it will be registered again in the Supreme Court. The operation would take that number.  In this way, a case can be registered several times in different judicial authorities and the statistics of its registration can reach 10 cases, while a single case and a single case that is registered only with different numbers.  However, these statistics, which result from the repeated registration of the case in the judicial system and at each stage, are determined for that class of archives; this is the case of "rotational statistics" that shows the workflow of a case in different stages and the path that a case has taken in different stages of the judicial system; in fact, if we add a process to the cases, we get rotational statistics; while "unique statistics" The actual number of disputes processed in the courts and the number of entries to the judiciary is disconnected from the steps that a case goes through in order to reach a conclusion and execute a verdict.  Thus, despite the statistics that the existence of current cases in the judiciary by some media and the honorable people of Iran is statistically among the most contentious people in the world, the actual statistics of current cases in the Iranian judiciary are about a third of the statistics wrongly announced by some media.  According to the Minister of Justice, in 95, about 5 million and 585 thousand cases and in 96, about 5 million and 825 thousand and 331 unique cases entered the judicial system of the country.  Thus, even if we accept the impossibility of 10% of the claim for the presence of lawyers and 20 million Tomans of lawyers for each case, in this case, the turnover of the country ’ s legal district will be reduced to 20 trillion, which is a significant difference with the alleged figure of some media.  On the other hand, the claim of 12 thousand billion Tomans by lawyers is not an unjustified claim, because regardless of how the lawyers calculate the amount of income of lawyers is based on incorrect components, apparently the perception of tax evasion lawyers has been that lawyers with an income of 60 trillion Tomans per year, do not even pay a rial for taxes to the government, which the charge of twelve thousand Tomans by calculating the 20 percent of the above amount attributed to them!  Meanwhile, lawyers both pay tax at the time of the declaration of attorney, through the annulment of tax stamps, and each year by submitting tax returns to the asset offices, their taxes are calculated with amounts much heavier than the actual figure, which is not proportionate to the income and expenses of lawyers.  However, the statistics provided by some of the newspapers are such that statistics are used to reach a predetermined result, for example, one of the newspapers that previously claimed 20 percent of cases entered the court with a lawyer and the income of each lawyer for each case was 50 million tomans; subsequently, after a departure from the previous statistics, another statistic was presented as above, which based on what was stated in the previous chapter, was false. income.  On the other hand, the number of cases that lawyers who are members of the Bar Association in the form of public and cooperative attorneys during the year and free of charge is more than 18,000 cases a year for which lawyers do not receive a royalty in order to be obliged to pay taxes.  This proves that the average of 20 million Tomans for each case is also a false and indisputable statistic, and the number of cases that lawyers are involved in the process of judicial proceedings without receiving the right of attorney is much higher than the public imagination.  For example, the chairman of the Committee of Emadamam Khomeini recently reported the statistics of five thousand voluntary legal services by lawyers members of the Bar Associations to the clients of this institution in the first quarter of 2019 that the lawyers have not received any amount in return as a fee or a fee for consultation, and yet the media are less likely to mention such services provided by lawyers.  It should also be noted that today, due to the inproportion of the number of lawyers with their referrals and the saturation of the labor market, many young lawyers accept legal cases with small amounts of money, and sometimes the tax that is demanded for a case from the lawyer is more than the amount of his salary, but the general misconception that people are considered to have a high income in the minds of the tax authorities. In many cases, the tax identification card issued to lawyers is not proportionate to the income and expenses of the lawyers and is more than the tax authorities' entitlement.  In addition, statistically, there are not very few important cases that do not require the presence of lawyers in their investigation.  Cases such as traffic accidents that are solved by insurance companies, or simple insults that take a significant number of cases in the court, or cases such as the determination of the guardian and cases related to the sensory affairs, which usually have a very low presence in the process of the lawyers and also has a significant statistics.  Another point to be discussed is that unfortunately, many authorities and some newspapers do not differentiate between unauthorized legal institutions and lawyers, and all illegal and illegal actions of legal institutions are written at the feet of lawyers.  This is while the unauthorized legal institutions that merely act as intermediaries and brokers among the people and lawyers, and their income from many lawyers is due to false advertising and false promises and deception of the people and the lack of any supervision; due to the lack of need to file a tax case at the time of registration of the institution and the presentation of a certificate of tax file to the lawyers of the registration office, the tax evasion of these illusionary legal institutions, A small percentage of the royalties received by the institution are paid to them, while a lawyer without a tax case is not able to obtain a lawyer ’ s license and renew it, and the claim that five thousand lawyers do not have a tax case is also one of the same category of strange and unfounded claims, apparently caused by the confusion of lawyers ’ activities with unauthorized legal institutions.  There is no doubt that among the lawyers, a few of them may have so-called astronomical revenues, which naturally must be paid taxes in proportion to the income earned; but with the root causes of their astronomical revenues, it can be understood that the main reason for the existence of such high incomes is the rents that have been created by some legal regulations such as the Note to Article 48 of the Criminal Procedure Code for a few lawyers, and the macro-economic cases have been exclusive or There is a rent that due to the previous employment of some lawyers in the judicial or legal advice of government organizations, other lawyers do not have it. Therefore, recourse to incomplete induction and going from part to part and generalizing the income of a few lawyers to the entire legal community and deducing tax evasion is logically null and untrustworthy and is one of the obvious examples of the publication of lies. Title: Roskachestvo has refuted the myth of preservatives in protein bars
Content: https: / / static.news.ru / photo / thunk _ 660.jpg Roskachestvo specialists checked four types of bars of 20 brands from Russia, Poland and Germany and did not find them exceeding the permissible norms for preservatives.  According to 86 indicators, protein (protein) bars, cereal bars, fruit and nut-fruit bars, as well as bars for weight loss were checked.  The myth that the bars consist of solid preservatives has not been confirmed.  Manufacturers, if they use them, then without exceeding the regulatory norms.  In addition, trans fats in any of the goods are not found at all, — stated in the message of Roskachestvo.  According to experts, protein bars justified their name, since they do contain the highest amount of protein in comparison with other categories.  At the same time, the spread in protein content was more than twice: from 35.7 g per 100 g to 16.9 g.  In the bars of two trademarks revealed a discrepancy in the mass fraction of carbohydrates with the declared indicators in the labeling.  In the healthy snack cereal bar, it is overstated ten times, and in the Bombbar protein bar it is understated almost three times.  Experts also found that a third of manufacturers indicate incorrect data about the energy value of their bars.  At the same time, some underestimate the number of calories, others overestimate.  There was also a discrepancy in the amount of vitamins and minerals in bars, although the discrepancy with the number indicated on the label is small.  Earlier, NEWS.ru reported that Roskachestvo conducted a study of spices that are sold in most Russian stores.  A number of violations on microbiological indicators were identified.  The study began after a survey that showed that some buyers are afraid of low-quality products that may contain hazardous substances.

Title: Scientists have learned the taste of an electronic cigarette, which “kills ” the lungs
Content: All 10 fragrances tested cause some level of toxicity in the cells.  A new study shows that e-cigarettes with a taste of chocolate are "particularly harmful" to the lungs.  As reported in a study published on Psychology.org, in fact, scientists have found that all 10 of the flavors tested cause some level of toxicity in the cells lining the lungs, which in some cases leads to their death.  Toxins also significantly reduce the ability of immune system cells to remove bacteria and regulate inflammation.  An article about the study was published in the American Journal of Lung Physiology, Cell and Molecular Physiology.  Data show that the chemical profiles of the studied e-liquid flavors (apple, banana, chewing gum, cappuccino, cherry, chocolate, cinnamon, mango, peppermint and tobacco) contained up to 15 chemicals.  The most harmful flavors, such as chocolate and banana, contain a large amount of a chemical component called the benzene ring.  Flavors with a lower concentration of the benzene ring were less harmful.  The researchers also found that different brands of chocolate and banana-flavored e-cigarette liquids with fewer benzene ring chemicals were also less harmful.  According to the researchers, the aim of the study was to determine whether immune dysfunction and toxicity in the lungs, which were previously observed in earlier studies, depended on the taste used, regardless of the presence of nicotine.  To find out, they exposed lung cells from healthy, non-smoking people to e-cigarette vapors produced with a variety of flavorings.  "We believe that this study provides evidence that the potential harm from the use of flavorings is not related to the name on the bottle, but rather to the chemical composition of the flavorant, the flavorings present and their concentration," said researcher Miranda Win, Ph.D., Adelaide Hospital in Australia.  "This suggests that any restrictions on permitted flavors should be based on data of this kind to ensure that permitted foods do represent the least possible level of harm," she adds.

Therefore, it is not possible to talk about non-communicable diseases just by looking at the nutrition and consumption or non-consumption of harmful goods, but certainly the consumption of high-fat and high-calorie foods is one of the causes of non-communicable diseases that we try to reduce by announcing this list. Title: Roskachestvo has refuted the myth of preservatives in protein bars
Content: https: / / static.news.ru / photo / thunk _ 660.jpg Roskachestvo specialists checked four types of bars of 20 brands from Russia, Poland and Germany and did not find them exceeding the permissible norms for preservatives.  According to 86 indicators, protein (protein) bars, cereal bars, fruit and nut-fruit bars, as well as bars for weight loss were checked.  The myth that the bars consist of solid preservatives has not been confirmed.  Manufacturers, if they use them, then without exceeding the regulatory norms.  In addition, trans fats in any of the goods are not found at all, — stated in the message of Roskachestvo.  According to experts, protein bars justified their name, since they do contain the highest amount of protein in comparison with other categories.  At the same time, the spread in protein content was more than twice: from 35.7 g per 100 g to 16.9 g.  In the bars of two trademarks revealed a discrepancy in the mass fraction of carbohydrates with the declared indicators in the labeling.  In the healthy snack cereal bar, it is overstated ten times, and in the Bombbar protein bar it is understated almost three times.  Experts also found that a third of manufacturers indicate incorrect data about the energy value of their bars.  At the same time, some underestimate the number of calories, others overestimate.  There was also a discrepancy in the amount of vitamins and minerals in bars, although the discrepancy with the number indicated on the label is small.  Earlier, NEWS.ru reported that Roskachestvo conducted a study of spices that are sold in most Russian stores.  A number of violations on microbiological indicators were identified. Title: Scientists have learned the taste of an electronic cigarette, which “kills ” the lungs
Content: All 10 fragrances tested cause some level of toxicity in the cells.  A new study shows that e-cigarettes with a taste of chocolate are "particularly harmful" to the lungs.  As reported in a study published on Psychology.org, in fact, scientists have found that all 10 of the flavors tested cause some level of toxicity in the cells lining the lungs, which in some cases leads to their death.  Toxins also significantly reduce the ability of immune system cells to remove bacteria and regulate inflammation.  An article about the study was published in the American Journal of Lung Physiology, Cell and Molecular Physiology.  Data show that the chemical profiles of the studied e-liquid flavors (apple, banana, chewing gum, cappuccino, cherry, chocolate, cinnamon, mango, peppermint and tobacco) contained up to 15 chemicals.  The most harmful flavors, such as chocolate and banana, contain a large amount of a chemical component called the benzene ring.  Flavors with a lower concentration of the benzene ring were less harmful.  The researchers also found that different brands of chocolate and banana-flavored e-cigarette liquids with fewer benzene ring chemicals were also less harmful.  According to the researchers, the aim of the study was to determine whether immune dysfunction and toxicity in the lungs, which were previously observed in earlier studies, depended on the taste used, regardless of the presence of nicotine.  To find out, they exposed lung cells from healthy, non-smoking people to e-cigarette vapors produced with a variety of flavorings.  "We believe that this study provides evidence that the potential harm from the use of flavorings is not related to the name on the bottle, but rather to the chemical composition of the flavorant, the flavorings present and their concentration," said researcher Miranda Win, Ph.D., Adelaide Hospital in Australia.  "This suggests that any restrictions on permitted flavors should be based on data of this kind to ensure that permitted foods do represent the least possible level of harm," she adds.

passages.title: 23 year old Klimt painting accidentally found in stolen museum
passages.passage: A painting by Austrian painter Klimt was stolen from an Italian art museum nearly 23 years ago, but it was accidentally recovered when a gardener cleaned the ivy on the exterior of the museum.  But exactly why this painting is hidden in the alcove of the outer wall of the museum is still a mystery.  Italian authorities have confirmed that the painting found last December at the Ricci Oddi Gallery of Modern Art in the northern Italian city of Piacenza is indeed the “Portrait of a Lady ” by Gustav Klimt, which was stolen from the gallery in 1997.  The painting was painted by Klimt in 1916-1917, bought by Italian collector Giuseppe Ricci Oddi in 1925, and kept in his own museum of the same name until it was stolen in preparation for a special exhibition on February 22, 1997.  The painting is valued at at least 60 million euros.  Just when everyone thought that the "lady portrait" will always evaporate, in December last year, the gardener cleaned the ivy of the outer wall of the Richie Odie Museum of Modern Art, but accidentally found a metal door panel, opened to find an alcove, there is a black bag in the wall, which is suspected of the painting.  In order to determine whether the paintings found were genuine, the experts irradiated them with infrared and ultraviolet light and compared them with the images taken during the examination of the original paintings in 1996.  "I can tell you with emotion that this work is genuine," said Italian prosecutor Ornella Chicca.  As for whether the painting has been placed in this niche after it has been stolen, or only after it has been placed, more tests are still needed to clarify.  According to the museum ’ s official statement, the exterior wall of the painting has not been trimmed for nearly 10 years.  Zika said that once the relevant tests are completed, the works will be displayed again in the museum.
