Title: Four refugees, including two children, drowned in the English Channel.
Content: Four asylum-seekers, including two children, drowned in the English Channel (Reuters) Photo source: A rescue operation has been going on for hours by French boats since French authorities announced the deaths of two children and a man and woman who were trying to cross the English Channel to reach Britain.  A boat carrying refugees has sunk across the English Channel between France and Britain.  The prosecutor of the French city of Dunkirk has opened an investigation into the cause of the sinking of the ship.  These people are said to be Iranian.  A massive rescue operation has been under way for hours, which crashed near the northern French city of Dunkirk.  According to French authorities, two children aged 5 and 8 and a man and woman died.  The other 14 were taken to hospitals in the port of Calais and the French city of Dunkirk.  The English Channel, between France and Britain, is one of the world ’ s busiest waterways, and it can be dangerous to cross by small vessels, especially in winter when the sea is stormy.  Another disaster came after the British Meteorological Office warned of bad weather and strong winds in the Channel region.  Natalie Alpeik, MP for the Dover region in the British Parliament, said: “It ’ s terrible that there ’ s been another disaster on the canal.  Human traffickers have no respect for human life: "A sailboat accidentally encountered a ship and alerted French authorities of the incident.  Four French ships, a Belgian helicopter and a French fishing vessel were involved in the rescue.  Since the beginning of the year, more than 7,400 asylum seekers have arrived in Britain by sea in small boats.  While there are still two months left until the end of 2020, that number is 1,825 more than in 2019.  The survivors were taken by helicopter to hospitals in the port of Calais and the northern French city of Dunkirk on Thursday, August 6, and a total of 235 migrants, including several pregnant women, crossed the English Channel from Europe to the southern coast of Britain.  This is the highest recorded number of illegal immigrants arriving in the region in a single day.  About ten days ago, Home Secretary Priti Patel announced the “most significant revision ” of the country ’ s asylum system in a decade.

Title: Iranian Refugees Steal Fishing Boat to British Coast
Content: Reports say 17 Iranian migrants made their way to British shores early Tuesday after hijacking a French fishing boat and crossing the English Channel, but were stopped by coast guard forces.  British officials have confirmed that the 17 migrants, including three children, were able to reach British shores by hijacking a 12-meter fishing boat near the French port of Calais early Tuesday.  French naval officials described the migrants ’ actions as “unprecedented ” and said they had previously tried to reach Britain in small boats, but in most cases failed.  The Home Office said in a statement that the group of migrants stopped arriving in Dover.  "They are 14 men and three children and all have declared themselves Iranian."  A Home Office spokeswoman said their asylum applications were being investigated and that three children had been handed over to the social services.  The report also said that three other small boats were stopped at Kent by the British Coast Guard on Wednesday, possibly from Iran.  According to the BBC, the passengers of one of the small boats were "seven men, a woman and a small child" and 10 other men were found in another boat.  According to the report, the British Coast Guard first noticed at 4: 30 that the passengers of a boat in the southwest of the shipping lane were in trouble and had gone to the aid of the refugees.  The second boat was found at 9: 00.  The report said five people on another boat were rescued a few miles off the coast of Ramsgate.  AFP says thousands of migrants from the Middle East and Africa are trying to reach Britain's shores.  The coastal city of Calais has the shortest water route between France and Britain, and since the destruction of the so-called "Jungle" camp, many Calais refugees have stepped up their efforts to reach Britain.

Title: Is it going to be harder for Britain to get asylum?
Content: Will it be harder to get asylum in Britain?  Journalist Kianoosh Bustani An hour ago image source, Getty Images, a refugee boat in the south of the United Kingdom On Thursday, April 25, British Interior Minister Priti Patel unveiled in the House of Commons a plan that will soon be implemented and the future of asylum in the United Kingdom will undergo a serious and irreversible transformation.  Ms Patel said: “For the first time, asylum claims in the UK will be processed based on the route migrants took to reach the country.  Boris Johnson ’ s interior minister refers to migrants who reach northern France via the Central European or Spanish route and then arrive on small boats off the southern coast of England.  Last year, 8,000 refugees arrived in the UK via smugglers' boats, crossing the dangerous waters of the English Channel or English Channel.  Iranians are at the forefront of these travelers in terms of the number of refugees.  A journey that is not safe and in some cases ends up costing the lives of refugees.  Ms Patel, referring to international gangs of human trafficking, said: "Sufficient tolerance".  The Home Secretary pointed to the determination of the British government to destroy these gangs.  "The British government believes that human trafficking gangs are the same gangs that are involved in the trafficking of arms and drugs."  Ms Patel called them "organised and dangerous gangs" that take advantage of refugees trying to reach the UK.  The UK government considers its new asylum application process “fairer and quicker ”.  The Labour Party, the official government opposition in the British parliament, has called the plan lacking human sentiment and unable to resolve the issue.  Under the new scheme, people who enter the UK via routes deemed illegal by the UK government will not be given the same rights as those who enter the UK via ‘ authorised ’ routes.  The British government says the new plan will create “safe and legal pathways ” to seek asylum in the country.  The Home Office accuses many migrants arriving in the UK of using EU territory to reach the UK ’ s shores.  Interior Minister Preeti Patel made it clear in Parliament on Thursday that “if you ’ re going to enter the UK illegally through a safe country where you can apply for asylum, it ’ s clear that you ’ re not trying to escape danger.  “Contrary to the international community ’ s stated goals for asylum, you have only chosen the UK as your preferred destination. ”  Last year, news that refugees arriving by sea on the UK coast could be transferred to Ascension Island, a remote location in the South Atlantic, drew criticism from British charities and human rights organisations.  The plan, which his critics said was reminiscent of the relocation of refugees to remote Australian islands and "difficult living conditions" for asylum seekers in those areas.  The possibility of such a return to the Home Office has drawn criticism from the Conservative government.  Mike Anderson, executive director of the British Red Cross, said sending refugees to remote locations was “ineffective in solving the refugee problem. ”  Anderson says, “Such a plan ignores the root cause of the refugee influx. ”  He added: “The government ’ s plan will undoubtedly lead to unfortunate human consequences. ”  The source, Getty Images, has also faced criticism from political parties.  Nick Thomas Simond, Labour ’ s shadow cabinet interior minister, called Priti Patel ’ s remarks “absurd ” and a sign of“ the government ’ s lack of control over the refugee situation and lack any compassion. ”  In addition to the official opposition, the Liberal Democratic parliamentary party has joined the ranks of opponents of the new asylum plan.  Elder Carmichael, the party's spokesman for state affairs, called the plan ineffective and inhumane.  Mr Carmichael said: "The government should instead think of a plan for refugees who have been waiting more than six months to process their application."  In the face of all this criticism, the government considers changing the asylum procedure as the only way to avoid risking the lives of people who consider the sea route to be the best way to reach Britain.  With the end of the Brexit transition period in December 2020, the British government lost the right to access the EU ’ s integrated asylum rules, known as the Dublin Regulation.  According to these rules, the state that is obliged to process the asylum application is determined.  These rules allow union governments to ask another member to take responsibility for handling an asylum application or, in some cases, repatriation of an asylum seeker.  The general purpose of these regulations is to ease the burden of some countries and prevent rework at the EU level.  With the end of Britain ’ s membership in the European Union, the Conservative government sought to replace it with a similar deal, which was strongly opposed by the European Union.  The plan was to return all refugees arriving in the UK from a third country to EU countries.  The plan, which Brussels has called “unbalanced and unprofitable ” for the EU, has been rejected.  Is Britain a good destination for refugees?  According to the United Nations Refugee Agency, 79 million people are currently displaced from their homes.  Of these, 26 million are refugees.  Asylum seekers are people who leave their country in the hope of finding a safe environment for themselves and their families.  According to data from the Office of National Statistics, nearly 29,000 people applied for asylum in the UK last year, including more than 5,000 children.  More than 2,000 children arrived in the UK alone and without their parents.  Among them, Iran, with 4,000 refugees, is at the top of the countries seeking asylum.  This makes up 12% of all asylum seekers in the UK.  On average, more than half of Iranian asylum seekers received asylum in the first stage.  In addition to those seeking asylum on UK soil for the first time, nearly 6,000 asylum seekers who arrived in the UK years before Iran are still waiting to be resettled.  According to available information, 21% of the applicants received a negative response from the Home Office.  Iraq, Albania, Eritrea, Sudan and Syria are next in the rankings.  According to previous Home Office regulations, those entering the UK via water can apply for asylum on British soil.  In order to receive the right to asylum, people had to prove that they would be persecuted if they returned to their home country.  Racial, religious, sexual and gender discrimination or suppression of freedom of expression and opinion are the main reasons why asylum seekers seek asylum in the UK.

Title: 39 'Iranian' refugees detained on Britain's southeast coast
Content: Sean Gallup / Getty Images Image caption One of the boats normally used by asylum seekers to cross the Channel to the UK, four boats carrying 39 Iranian refugees were taken off Sunday, November 17, at separate events off Britain's southeast coast.  The British Interior Ministry confirmed that all of the asylum seekers identified themselves as “Iranian ”.  The first boat, which had nine people on board, took off at 4: 40 a.m. yesterday, while the second, with five people on board, reached the British coast at around 6 a.m.  According to the Coast Guard and Kent County Police, a boat with 11 people on board was seized at around 7 a.m. and a half hour later another boat with 14 people was taken off the coast of the UK.  As soon as they received a message of help from the boats, rescue helicopters, as well as rescue boats from the ports of Dover, Dunness and Hastings, as well as two coast guard vessels, took action to rescue the passengers.  A Home Office spokesman said: "Crossing the canal by these small boats is extremely dangerous.  For those who have gone through such a journey, their lives and their loved ones are at risk. ”  According to the British Home Office, over the past two years Iranian citizens have applied for asylum more than any other country in the UK.  In 2017, about 9% of all 26,350 asylum applications were submitted by Iranians.  In November last year there was a significant increase in the number of asylum seekers trying to cross the English Channel to Britain, with the Home Secretary calling the issue a "serious incident" and calling for the French government to work together to resolve the issue. Title: Brexit is on the verge of a surge in the number of people crossing the sea to test British border controls
Content: Image copyright Susan Pilcher Image caption On New Year's Eve 2019, 12 stowaways arrived in the UK on a small rubber dinghy, including a 10-year-old child.  British Border Agency agents inspect what they have discarded.  Soon after Brexit, a large number of stowaways in small rubber dinghies flooded from the European continent to England.  At the request of the Home Secretary, the Royal Navy and the Air Force sent aircraft and warships to help resolve the crisis.  Once the formal Brexit, both Britain and the EU will no longer be bound by the Dublin Agreement, which originally defined refugee ownership, but the UK may find it difficult to repatriate any influx of migrants to the EU.  The 2019 New Year holiday has been a rough ride for Home Secretary David Javid: he ended his holiday in South Africa early and rushed back to London to discuss the crisis of stowaways arriving on British shores by boat from the sea. And this is not yet the summer, which traditionally accounts for the peak of the wave of illegal migration from Asia and Africa.Now in the center of attention is Ceuta, a Spanish enclave in North Africa, where thousands of illegal refugees from Morocco rushed.  The refugee crisis in Ceuta and Melilla (another Spanish port in Africa) is largely the result of the artificial escalation of relations between Spain and Morocco.  According to many observers, Rabat decided to take revenge on Madrid for the assistance recently provided to the Polisario Front (which for many years has been fighting for the independence of Western Sahara from Morocco).  The revenge was the actual inaction of the border guards of this country, who turned a blind eye to the crowds of migrants breaking into Ceuta.  According to The Economist magazine, in this way King Mohammed VI of Morocco “made migration a weapon ” .But in fact, the sharp influx of refugees from Africa began not only in the Spanish enclaves.  Again, a series of flimsy ships illegally transporting Africans (mainly Libyans) from Tunisia to the Italian island of Lampedusa.  Last week, 1,200 people were transferred there during 12 hours of good weather alone.  And even despite the weather, accidents were recorded: 73 refugees from Bangladesh almost drowned trying to reach the cherished island.  How long it took, no one can say.  According to the Italian Interior Ministry, 4,290 migrants reached the country ’ s shores in the first three weeks of May.  While for the whole of May last year, their number was 1654 people.  The flow of illegal refugees is also increasing between the EU and Britain.  Since January, more than three thousand people have crossed the English Channel.  And over the same period last year, this figure was 1,400 refugees – more than double the growth.  Just the other day, the Belgian coast guard rescued a sinking ship on which 49 migrants, mostly Vietnamese, tried to cross the strait.  Based on the above facts and statistics, we can safely assume that the migration crisis will return to the European agenda in the foreseeable future.  However, the numbers are not as catastrophic as they were in 2015, when Europe was literally drowned by a flood of refugees.  And the increase compared to last year is easily explained by the fact that in 2020, many people in Asia and Africa gave up their intentions to go to pandemics in Europe.  In addition, the result of the shift of public attention from the problem of migration to the fight against the covid was a noticeable decrease in the ratings of a number of parties advocating strict measures to limit the influx of immigrants (in the Western media, these political organizations are usually indiscriminately called ultra-right, even despite the rather liberal economic program of many of them).  It is quite logical that now, with the rapid return of migration problems to the agenda, many publications have sounded the alarm in connection with the imminent growth of the popularity of these political forces.  Almost all analysts agree that the crisis around Ceuta, which has not descended from the front pages of the Spanish press for several days, will significantly strengthen the anti-Islamic party Vox (Voice).  Even before the current crisis, it actively dispersed the fears of the enclave residents in connection with the influx of poor Africans.  And in the end, it won the first place in the parliamentary elections of 2019, receiving more than 35 percent of the vote – and this is in a city where 40 percent of the population is Muslim.  It would be strange if the Vox party did not now take advantage of the crisis to increase its popularity in Ceuta.  For example, a local cell of the party is publicizing protests against the fact that African migrants entering the Spanish enclave receive coronavirus vaccinations, while Spanish citizens living there wait months for their turn.  This is confirmed by events in the regional parliament of Andalusia, where after the 2018 elections, for the first time in history, the People ’ s Party took the first place and was able to form a minority government.  Until last week, it relied solely on the informal support of Vox MPs.  However, on Thursday, they announced the termination of cooperation with the senior partner in connection with the fact that the authorities of the region agreed to accept 13 minor refugees who infiltrated Ceuta.  This could lead to the fall of the regional government and early elections.  That is why the People ’ s Party is forced to show more and more rigidity in the migration issue, causing panic in the European liberal media.Even more worrying in the mainstream is the electoral situation in Italy.  After the 2015 crisis, the League party, led by Matteo Salvini, has been the consistent leader of the polls there.  Having proved himself a tough fighter against illegal migration as the Minister of Internal Affairs, he increased the leadership of his party to record levels.  At the peak of popularity in the summer of 2019, the League ’ s figures were approaching 40 percent, which gave it hope even for the formation of its government.  Based on these calculations, Salvini provoked a government crisis in order to hold early elections, but was outplayed by opponents.  Since last year, there has been a drop in the ratings of this political force, whose supporters cannot forgive the support it expressed for the technocratic government of Mario Draghi.  Liberals can breathe freely.  But the fact is that the ratings of the League, which is still in the first place in the polls, are moving on opposite courses with the rapidly growing indicators of the even more right-wing and even more anti-migrant party “Brothers of Italy ”.  According to some polls, she already came in second place after the League, behind that couple of percent.  Three years ago, its ratings fluctuated around three to four percent, and now confidently approaching 20.  If elections were held now, these two forces, with the support of Silvio Berlusconi ’ s Forward Italy party, could well form a majority government.  They do not hide their ideological continuity from the far-right Italian social movement, which was created in 1946 by former supporters of Benito Mussolini.  This legacy is clearly indicated by the logo of the party, which includes the former symbol of ISD.The growth of the popularity of the "Brothers" will contribute to the charisma of the head of the party Georgia Meloni ("Sisters of Italy", as it was nicknamed by the press) - she last year surpassed in the approval ratings of the leader of the "League", becoming the second most popular politician in the country after the current prime minister.  There is no doubt that in the event of an aggravation of the migration crisis, the League and Brothers will be able to get additional votes to their already serious ratings.  Trends in the first months of the year show that the threat of the covid is no longer deterring refugees seeking to Europe.  And this means that the nightmare of 2015 may repeat itself — and the popularity of far-right, anti-migrant, anti-Islamic, Eurosceptic parties will again sharply rise. Javid said the reasons for the sudden increase in the number of people trying to sneak into Britain by dinghy were complex, including the turmoil in the Middle East, organized crime operations and Britain's efforts to prevent stowaways from travelling to Britain by truck, train and ferry.  Many of them will come to the police and ask the British government for asylum.  Although these people will be detained by the police, the British side will always need to provide basic humanitarian guarantees to these refugees, especially the children among them.  Although France has promised to help strengthen the fight against illegal immigration in the English Channel, the departure of illegal immigrants from France does not appear to have caused any pressure on French society.  How many people are currently applying for asylum in the UK?  The United Kingdom grants "refugee status" to those who are unable to live in their country because of fear of persecution on various grounds, such as race, religion, nationality, political opinion or sexual orientation, and provides the basic necessities of living, food, shelter and welfare, as well as cash assistance.  Successful applications usually allow applicants to stay in the UK legally for five years, after which they can apply for permanent residence in the UK as long as they meet the conditions such as no criminal record.  The applicants include those who arrived in Britain by rubber boats, but also stowaways who arrived in Britain by ferry, truck and other means.  According to the Home Office, in 2017, the Home Office received more than 26,000 asylum applications.  This is a small number compared to the number of asylum applications received by other large countries in Western Europe during the same period: 198,000 in Germany, 126,000 in Italy and 91,000 in France.  The EU has been critical of Britain over the number of refugees it has received.  In the same period, the Home Office issued more than 21,000 applications, and granted 31.8% of them asylum needs.  At the end of 2018, more than 24,500 people in the UK were waiting for the Home Office to approve their asylum applications, of which 42% had been waiting for more than six months.  Most asylum seekers rejected by the Home Office go to court. In 2017, out of more than 14,000 asylum applications rejected by the Home Office, more than 5,000 were approved by court decisions, meaning that the Home Office ’ s initial refusal to approve was overturned.  Image copyright Lewis Morris Image caption A large number of migrants, many of them Iranians, have recently arrived in Britain by boat from France.  It is noteworthy that the number of illegal immigrants from China to Britain, which attracted attention more than a decade ago, has been greatly reduced in today's refugee influx.  More than a decade ago, many Chinese people smuggled into Britain through Russia and Europe. The deaths of 58 stowaways in the port of Dover in 2000 and 23 scavengers in Merkham Bay in 2004 reflect the problem of a large number of illegal immigrants from China sneaking into Britain more than a decade ago.  The British government has also stepped up its efforts to crack down on illegal immigrants and illegal workers in the wake of the Merkham Bay tragedy, but due to the high appeal of Britain's welfare social and humanitarian policies to war-torn and economically backward areas, the problem of illegal immigration in other countries is still very serious.  The top 10 countries with the largest number of asylum seekers are Syria, Eritrea, Sudan, Iran, Afghanistan, Iraq, Pakistan, Nigeria, Bangladesh and India.  Most of the stowaways who enter the UK find it difficult to repatriate if their asylum claims are rejected. In 2016, the British government spent a huge amount of money to repatriate 6,000 foreign criminals.  Britain has a population of 70 million, but there are huge numbers of illegal immigrants, including stowaways and people who have overstayed their visas in the UK illegally.  On the one hand, these people's work income, welfare and even human rights are difficult to be guaranteed, such as being exploited by people's groups, and on the other hand, they live in society to increase the invisible pressure on the British system of free medical care, education and other systems, and the crime problem that a few people breed has caused serious losses to society.  How many illegal immigrants are there in the UK?  There are no accurate official figures, and no one seems to be able to tell.  In 2001, the Home Office estimated the number of illegal immigrants in the UK at around 430,000.  A 2017 report in the British “Guardian ” quoted senior Home Office officials as saying that 150,000 to 250,000 foreigners leave the UK each year without due dates, including 26,000 who were denied asylum applications in 2016, and more than 1.2 million people may be living in the UK illegally.

passages.passage: Over the weekend, the Stratolaunch, the world ’ s largest aircraft to date, successfully passed one of the final tests in preparation for the giant ’ s first attempt at takeoff.  We remind our readers that the purpose of the Stratolaunch project, founded by Paul Allen, is to create a space launch system capable of launching payloads weighing up to 230 tons into low Earth orbit using conventional runways, a giant aircraft and single-stage launch vehicles. It has a length of 72.5 meters and a wingspan of 116 meters.  The aircraft has two fuselages, in the right of which crew members are located, and the second fuselage serves as a place where navigation systems, flight systems and other aviation electronics are installed.  Both fuselages are connected by a reinforced wing, which serves as a mounting point for the rocket that will rise to the height of its launch.  During these tests, the suspension, brake system and a number of other related technologies were tested.  All these tests were carried out at low speed, despite the operation of all six Pratt and Whitney turbojet engines, the plane moved at a speed of no more than 45 kilometers per hour.The latest tests of the Stratolaunch aircraft were carried out on Saturday and Sunday in the traditional place, on the lanes and taxiways of the Mojave Air & Space Port in California.  This time the plane was allowed to accelerate to a speed of 75 kilometers per hour, a speed that is the limit at which this giant aircraft will have to start take-off in any case.  This, unfortunately, does not mean that the first attempt to take off the aircraft will be made in the near future. passages.passage: The American company Stratolaunch Systems has tested a prototype Stratolaunch aircraft with a fully assembled airframe. passages.title: Pandora ’ s Box – In the United States for the first time rolled out of the hangar the largest aircraft in the world (PHOTOS, VIDEO)
passages.passage: May 31, 2017 in Mojave (California) took place the roll-out of the almost completed construction of the Stratolaunch Model 351 carrier aircraft (also sometimes referred to as "Roc", in fact, the official name has not yet been assigned) of the aerospace system "air launch" Stratolaunch, created by the American company Stratolaunch Systems (as part of Vulcan Aerospace Corporation). The BMPD blog.  Rolling out of the carrier aircraft Stratolaunch Model 351 aerospace system "air start" Stratolaunch American company Stratolaunch Systems.  Mojave (California), 31.05.2017 (c) Stratolaunch Systems The built twin-body Stratolaunch Model 351 aircraft is the largest aircraft in history, having a wingspan of 117 m and a length of 73 m. The maximum take-off weight should be 590 tons, with a suspended payload weight of 230 tons.  Thus, the Stratolaunch Model 351 aircraft in wingspan exceeds the former largest aircraft in the world, the Soviet An-225 "Mriya" (which has a wingspan of 88.4 m), although the An-225 retains an advantage in length (84 m) and maximum take-off weight (640 tons).  The Stratolaunch Model 351 aircraft is equipped with six twin-circuit Pratt & Whitney PW4056 turbojet engines with a thrust of 25 tons, removed from two decommissioned Boeing 747-400 aircraft.  The landing gear of the aircraft is 28-wheel, take-off distance with full load should be calculated to be 3800 m. The maximum range of the aircraft with full load will not exceed 3700 km.  The aircraft is designed to be used as a carrier for the aerospace system Stratolaunch, created by the American company Stratolaunch Systems, founded by co-founder Microsot Paul Allen and the famous aircraft designer Bert Rutan (who acted as the actual chief designer of the aircraft) (since 2015 Stratolaunch Systems is a subsidiary of the corporation created by the same Paul Allen Vulcan Aerospace).  The aircraft is designed to launch space launch vehicles using the "air launch" method, which will be carried out from an altitude of approximately 10,500 m. The launch vehicle should be suspended under the central part of the wing between the fuselages.  In the course of design and construction, the SpaceX Falcon 9 Air and Orbital ATK Pegasus II launch vehicles were successively replaced as payload options, and now only the long-known Orbital ATK Pegasus XL light launch vehicle used for “air launches ” from“ conventional ” aircraft in the United States since 1990 is considered as such (starting mass of 23.2 tons, payload mass load of 443 kg), and for which there was no need to create such a giant carrier - although the possibility of carrying and launching from it in one flight up to three Pegasus XL launch vehicles is claimed.  In light of this, the outlook for Stratolaunch is still uncertain.  In 2014, the notorious Sierra Nevada Corporation announced the development of a smaller version of the project of its lightweight manned shuttle Dream Chaser (previously rejected by NASA), which was to be launched using an unnamed launch vehicle developed by the Orbital ATK.  However, there is no information about the development of this project in relation to Stratolaunch.  During the launch vehicle roll-out ceremony on May 31, Stratolauch Systems CEO Joan Floyd said that the company would "actively explore a wide range of launch vehicles, allowing us to provide more flexibility for customers."  Rolling out of the carrier aircraft Stratolaunch Model 351 aerospace system "air start" Stratolaunch American company Stratolaunch Systems.  The Stratolaunch Model 351 was designed and built under the contract of Stratolaunch Systems by Scaled Composites, founded by Bert Rutan and now owned by Northrop Grumman Corporation.  The project was announced in December 2011.  The construction of the aircraft was carried out in a specially built for this purpose in 2012 in Mojave giant hangar.  The scheme of the intended use of the aircraft carrier Stratolaunch Model 351 of the aerospace system "air launch" Stratolaunch American company Stratolaunch Systems (c) Stratolaunch Systems The program is lagging behind in terms of about two years.  Currently, the beginning of flight tests of the carrier aircraft is scheduled for the end of 2017, and the first demonstration space launch from it - in 2019.  The start of commercial launches will be possible in this case from 2020. The aircraft is designed to be used as a carrier for the aerospace system Stratolaunch, created by the American company Stratolaunch Systems, founded by co-founder Microsot Paul Allen and the famous aircraft designer Bert Rutan (who acted as the actual chief designer of the aircraft) (since 2015 Stratolaunch Systems is a subsidiary of the corporation created by the same Paul Allen Vulcan Aerospace).  The aircraft is designed to launch space launch vehicles using the "air launch" method, which will be carried out from an altitude of approximately 10,500 m. The launch vehicle should be suspended under the central part of the wing between the fuselages.  In the course of design and construction, the SpaceX Falcon 9 Air and Orbital ATK Pegasus II launch vehicles were successively replaced as payload options, and now only the long-known Orbital ATK Pegasus XL light launch vehicle used for “air launches ” from“ conventional ” aircraft in the United States since 1990 is considered as such (starting mass of 23.2 tons, payload mass load of 443 kg), and for which there was no need to create such a giant carrier - although the possibility of carrying and launching from it in one flight up to three Pegasus XL launch vehicles is claimed.  In light of this, the outlook for Stratolaunch is still uncertain.  In 2014, the notorious Sierra Nevada Corporation announced the development of a smaller version of the project of its lightweight manned shuttle Dream Chaser (previously rejected by NASA), which was to be launched using an unnamed launch vehicle developed by the Orbital ATK.  However, there is no information about the development of this project in relation to Stratolaunch.  During the launch vehicle roll-out ceremony on May 31, Stratolauch Systems CEO Joan Floyd said that the company would "actively explore a wide range of launch vehicles, allowing us to provide more flexibility for customers." passages.passage: An accident in the Tour de France; police in pursuit of the 'reckless woman' 46 minutes ago Image source Gendarmerie du finistere Image caption Police are searching for a woman who caused a bicycle accident French police are searching for a woman whose carelessness made headlines during the Tour de France.  The spectator entered the path of the cyclists with a placard in his hand, and as a result, many athletes crashed and fell to the ground in the first round.  On Saturday, she leaned into the road in the speed section of the race in Brittany, France, holding a placard.  The first cyclist he encountered was German Tony Martin, followed by a significant number of athletes.  Police say they have filed a criminal case for the incident.  According to police, the charge is "deliberate violation of safety regulations and causing injuries that could prevent someone from working for up to three months."  The image of the incident has been widely circulated on social media.  A woman in a yellow coat with a sign in German that reads “Grandma and Grandpa. ”  The woman stands with her back to the group of cyclists and does not notice that they are approaching.  One of the injured cyclists was forced to retire from the Tour de France, and eight other cyclists were suspended by the official doctor.  Police said the woman fled the scene after the incident.  Police have asked witnesses to give their information to officers.  The vice president of the Tour de France also called for legal action against the woman, saying: “We will sue her for her very bad behavior.  We do this so that a small group of people can ’ t ruin a show that ’ s for everyone. ”  France has recently eased some of the restrictions imposed by the coronavirus outbreak, with a sizable population making its way to cyclists to watch races.  The Tour de France is an annual cycling race for men.  It is considered to be the most prestigious bicycle road race in the world.  France hosts the tournament, but sometimes competitions are held in the surrounding countries.

passages.title: Mass blockage at the cycling race "Tour de France" because of the antics of the cheerleader: the girl hit the racers with a poster and ran away
passages.passage: The girl showed the camera a poster with a joke inscription, knocked down the racers on the asphalt and fled from the scene.  45 km before the end of the first stage of the legendary cycling race "Tour de France" there was a massive blockage, as a result of which more than two dozen athletes were injured.  Almost half of the peloton fell, including the main favorites.  The culprit of the accident was a cheerleader who put up a poster with a joke inscription right in front of the riders.  Now she is wanted by the police, who asked witnesses for help through social networks.  The organizers of the race promised her legal proceedings.  "Allez Opi-Omi" The cheerleader intervened in the battle of the strongest riders of the world at the most famous stage race in history at the first stage from Brest to Landerno.  About 45 km before the finish, the girl in blue jeans and a bright yellow jacket jumped from the side of the road and put on camera in front of the athletes a poster with the inscription “Allez Opi-Omi ” (a joke and caressing appeal to grandparents in German, something like“ Go, old men ”).  Driving on the right side of the rider of the team “Jumbo Wisma ” German Tony Martin had no chance to dodge the collision with the poster and fell, which led to a major blockage.  Not escaped this and the main favorites: Slovenes Tadej Pogacar and Primož Roglic.  But they at least cost bruises and abrasions, but Spaniard Mark Soler of “Movistar ” broke the radial bones on both hands.  By some miracle, he reached the finish line, but he will not be able to continue the race.  Like the German Jascha Sutterlin.  Those who continued the Tour de France lost a lot of time.  “We had everything under control, I led the guys on the right side of the road, but crashed into a fan poster.  It all happened very quickly, all of a sudden, almost everyone was on the ground.  Many viewers behave respectfully, but in this case this was not the case, unfortunately.  I hope that there will be no consequences for the health of all the guys who fell into the rubble, ” said Tony Martin.  A year behind bars and a 15,000 euro fine The cheerleader, who became the culprit of the accident, quickly disappeared.  The Gendarmerie Landerno put her on the wanted list and asked for help from witnesses, posting a post on social media.  However, the comments are more negative towards the police than the desire to help find a negligent fan.  The organizers of the Tour de France have already promised that the culprit of the collision is awaiting trial.  “We must not allow a small number of hooligans to spoil the sporting event for participants and fans, ” said Pierre-Yves Tuo, deputy director of the race.  What threatens the offender?  While injured in the accident riders did not submit a statement to the police – a fine of 1500 euros.  But if Soler and Sutterlin write such a statement, the case will be reclassified.  Now the fan is accused that failure to comply with the required security measures led to harm to health.  In the case of a statement from the riders unknown until the violator faces a fine ten times more and up to a year in prison.  The organizers appealed to all fans with a request to observe security measures and even released a special video reminding how dangerous such clashes can be.  There are a lot of fans in the current Tour de France.  And almost no one follows the antiquated rules.  The organizers are ready to turn a blind eye to this, but when the physical safety of athletes is threatened, it is quite another matter.  The athletes themselves also urged fans to be more restrained in the display of emotions, although clashes with fans in cycling are quite regular.  But now it has crossed all boundaries.  “I hope Opi-Omi are proud of you, ” Belgian cyclist Jasper Stuyven wrote on Twitter.  It is wonderful to see that there are so many fans who love our sport and support us.  But please stay on the side of the road, not on the road! ”  The participants of the Tour de France quite cope with the organization of force majeure and without the participation of fans.  At the same first stage, about 8 km before the finish line, Briton Chris Froome forked to the side and organized another blockage, himself and being the main victim.  But serious injuries to athletes were avoided.  The leader in the overall stage race after two stages is the Dutchman Mathieu van der Poole from the Alpesin-Phoenix team.  Russian riders do not participate in the current Tour de France.

Title: Mass blockage at the cycling race "Tour de France" because of the antics of the cheerleader: the girl hit the racers with a poster and ran away
Content: The girl showed the camera a poster with a joke inscription, knocked down the racers on the asphalt and fled from the scene.  45 km before the end of the first stage of the legendary cycling race "Tour de France" there was a massive blockage, as a result of which more than two dozen athletes were injured.  Almost half of the peloton fell, including the main favorites.  The culprit of the accident was a cheerleader who put up a poster with a joke inscription right in front of the riders.  Now she is wanted by the police, who asked witnesses for help through social networks.  The organizers of the race promised her legal proceedings.  "Allez Opi-Omi" The cheerleader intervened in the battle of the strongest riders of the world at the most famous stage race in history at the first stage from Brest to Landerno.  About 45 km before the finish, the girl in blue jeans and a bright yellow jacket jumped from the side of the road and put on camera in front of the athletes a poster with the inscription “Allez Opi-Omi ” (a joke and caressing appeal to grandparents in German, something like“ Go, old men ”).  Driving on the right side of the rider of the team “Jumbo Wisma ” German Tony Martin had no chance to dodge the collision with the poster and fell, which led to a major blockage.  Not escaped this and the main favorites: Slovenes Tadej Pogacar and Primož Roglic.  But they at least cost bruises and abrasions, but Spaniard Mark Soler of “Movistar ” broke the radial bones on both hands.  By some miracle, he reached the finish line, but he will not be able to continue the race.  Like the German Jascha Sutterlin.  Those who continued the Tour de France lost a lot of time.  “We had everything under control, I led the guys on the right side of the road, but crashed into a fan poster.  It all happened very quickly, all of a sudden, almost everyone was on the ground.  Many viewers behave respectfully, but in this case this was not the case, unfortunately.  I hope that there will be no consequences for the health of all the guys who fell into the rubble, ” said Tony Martin.  A year behind bars and a 15,000 euro fine The cheerleader, who became the culprit of the accident, quickly disappeared.  The Gendarmerie Landerno put her on the wanted list and asked for help from witnesses, posting a post on social media.  However, the comments are more negative towards the police than the desire to help find a negligent fan.  The organizers of the Tour de France have already promised that the culprit of the collision is awaiting trial.  “We must not allow a small number of hooligans to spoil the sporting event for participants and fans, ” said Pierre-Yves Tuo, deputy director of the race.  What threatens the offender?  While injured in the accident riders did not submit a statement to the police – a fine of 1500 euros.  But if Soler and Sutterlin write such a statement, the case will be reclassified.  Now the fan is accused that failure to comply with the required security measures led to harm to health.  In the case of a statement from the riders unknown until the violator faces a fine ten times more and up to a year in prison.  The organizers appealed to all fans with a request to observe security measures and even released a special video reminding how dangerous such clashes can be.  There are a lot of fans in the current Tour de France.  And almost no one follows the antiquated rules.  The organizers are ready to turn a blind eye to this, but when the physical safety of athletes is threatened, it is quite another matter.  The athletes themselves also urged fans to be more restrained in the display of emotions, although clashes with fans in cycling are quite regular.  But now it has crossed all boundaries.  “I hope Opi-Omi are proud of you, ” Belgian cyclist Jasper Stuyven wrote on Twitter.  It is wonderful to see that there are so many fans who love our sport and support us.  But please stay on the side of the road, not on the road! ”  The participants of the Tour de France quite cope with the organization of force majeure and without the participation of fans.  At the same first stage, about 8 km before the finish line, Briton Chris Froome forked to the side and organized another blockage, himself and being the main victim.  But serious injuries to athletes were avoided.  The leader in the overall stage race after two stages is the Dutchman Mathieu van der Poole from the Alpesin-Phoenix team.  Russian riders do not participate in the current Tour de France.

Title: Mass blockage at the cycling race "Tour de France" because of the antics of the cheerleader: the girl hit the racers with a poster and ran away
Content: The girl showed the camera a poster with a joke inscription, knocked down the racers on the asphalt and fled from the scene.  45 km before the end of the first stage of the legendary cycling race "Tour de France" there was a massive blockage, as a result of which more than two dozen athletes were injured.  Almost half of the peloton fell, including the main favorites.  The culprit of the accident was a cheerleader who put up a poster with a joke inscription right in front of the riders.  Now she is wanted by the police, who asked witnesses for help through social networks.  The organizers of the race promised her legal proceedings.  "Allez Opi-Omi" The cheerleader intervened in the battle of the strongest riders of the world at the most famous stage race in history at the first stage from Brest to Landerno.  About 45 km before the finish, the girl in blue jeans and a bright yellow jacket jumped from the side of the road and put on camera in front of the athletes a poster with the inscription “Allez Opi-Omi ” (a joke and caressing appeal to grandparents in German, something like“ Go, old men ”).  Driving on the right side of the rider of the team “Jumbo Wisma ” German Tony Martin had no chance to dodge the collision with the poster and fell, which led to a major blockage.  Not escaped this and the main favorites: Slovenes Tadej Pogacar and Primož Roglic.  But they at least cost bruises and abrasions, but Spaniard Mark Soler of “Movistar ” broke the radial bones on both hands.  By some miracle, he reached the finish line, but he will not be able to continue the race.  Like the German Jascha Sutterlin.  Those who continued the Tour de France lost a lot of time.  “We had everything under control, I led the guys on the right side of the road, but crashed into a fan poster.  It all happened very quickly, all of a sudden, almost everyone was on the ground.  Many viewers behave respectfully, but in this case this was not the case, unfortunately.  I hope that there will be no consequences for the health of all the guys who fell into the rubble, ” said Tony Martin.  A year behind bars and a 15,000 euro fine The cheerleader, who became the culprit of the accident, quickly disappeared.  The Gendarmerie Landerno put her on the wanted list and asked for help from witnesses, posting a post on social media.  However, the comments are more negative towards the police than the desire to help find a negligent fan.  The organizers of the Tour de France have already promised that the culprit of the collision is awaiting trial.  “We must not allow a small number of hooligans to spoil the sporting event for participants and fans, ” said Pierre-Yves Tuo, deputy director of the race.  What threatens the offender?  While injured in the accident riders did not submit a statement to the police – a fine of 1500 euros.  But if Soler and Sutterlin write such a statement, the case will be reclassified.  Now the fan is accused that failure to comply with the required security measures led to harm to health.  In the case of a statement from the riders unknown until the violator faces a fine ten times more and up to a year in prison.  The organizers appealed to all fans with a request to observe security measures and even released a special video reminding how dangerous such clashes can be.  There are a lot of fans in the current Tour de France.  And almost no one follows the antiquated rules.  The organizers are ready to turn a blind eye to this, but when the physical safety of athletes is threatened, it is quite another matter.  The athletes themselves also urged fans to be more restrained in the display of emotions, although clashes with fans in cycling are quite regular.  But now it has crossed all boundaries.  “I hope Opi-Omi are proud of you, ” Belgian cyclist Jasper Stuyven wrote on Twitter.  It is wonderful to see that there are so many fans who love our sport and support us.  But please stay on the side of the road, not on the road! ”  The participants of the Tour de France quite cope with the organization of force majeure and without the participation of fans.  At the same first stage, about 8 km before the finish line, Briton Chris Froome forked to the side and organized another blockage, himself and being the main victim.  But serious injuries to athletes were avoided.  The leader in the overall stage race after two stages is the Dutchman Mathieu van der Poole from the Alpesin-Phoenix team.  Russian riders do not participate in the current Tour de France.

Title: Police are looking for the woman who caused the collision of cyclists during the Tour de France 2021
Content: The woman held a cardboard poster and stood very close to the roadway.  Soon there was a column of cyclists, but the woman, apparently, did not notice.  German cyclist Tony Martin crashed into a poster, causing him to lose his balance and fall.  This created a domino effect, and several cyclists collided with each other, creating a rather serious collision.  As a result, several cyclists were injured, 21 of which required medical attention, and one, because of the injuries, had to be removed from the race.  French police say an investigation will be carried out and the woman is being actively sought.  Police also conducted interviews with eyewitnesses to find out where the woman might have gone.  The organizers of the event also said that the woman will be charged.  "We will bring charges against this woman so that the rest of the small population that acts so irresponsibly does not spoil the viewing and the competition for others," Tour de France spokesman Pierre Yves told AFP.

passages.title: SpaceX successfully sent two astronauts into space as part of the Demo-2 mission » DailyTechInfo
passages.passage: On May 30, 2020, at 19: 22 GMT, the famous American space company SpaceX successfully launched a manned mission Demo-2.  The Crew Dragon spacecraft, which now holds two astronauts, Robert Behnken and Douglas Hurley, was launched into space by a Falcon 9 rocket launched from Launch Complex 39A at NASA ’ s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.  The spacecraft is currently in space, performing maneuvers that will lead it to the International Space Station (ISS), docking with which will be made during today, May 31, 2020.Yesterday's launch was made after the first attempt, scheduled for Wednesday last week, was postponed due to the approach of the storm front, carrying strong wind, rain and an increased risk of lightning strike.  By the time of the delayed launch, the weather had improved significantly, but NASA weather forecasters still gave a 50 percent chance of re-carrying the launch.  The Crew Dragon spacecraft successfully entered orbit, which was a mark of two significant events at once.  The Demo-2 mission was the first manned mission launched from the United States since 2011, when NASA retired its fleet of space shuttles.  And the second event was that the Demo-2 mission is the world ’ s first commercial mission, in which a spacecraft with astronauts on board was put into orbit. If the Demo-2 mission is successfully carried out until the very end, then SpaceX will begin to carry out regular flights to the ISS, delivering astronauts and various cargoes back to Earth.  And in conclusion, it should be noted that in the case of a successful docking of the Crew Dragon spacecraft with the space station, astronauts Robert Benken and Douglas Hurley will spend on board it from one to three months, after which they will return to Earth.

passages.title: Roscosmos welcomed the launch of Crew Dragon
passages.passage: The successful launch of SpaceX ’ s Crew Dragon spacecraft Elon Musk opened up additional opportunities for the global space program.  On Saturday, may 30, said the Executive Director of Roscosmos for manned space programs, Hero of Russia Sergey Krikalev.  The representative of the department welcomed the American colleagues and noted that the success of the Crew Dragon mission will open a new stage for the development of manned flights in the world space program, the ISS program.  The launch of the Falcon 9 carrier rocket with a private manned spacecraft Crew Dragon of SpaceX took place on Saturday 15: 22 on the time of the East Coast of the United States (22: 22 MSK) from the launch pad LC-39A of the John F. Kennedy Space Center at Cape Canaveral.  The launch was broadcast on the NASA website.  The goal of the Demo-2 space mission is to deliver astronauts Douglas Hurley and Robert Benken to the International Space Station (ISS), where they will stay from one to four months, depending on the state of the spacecraft ’ s solar panels.  Crew Dragon docking with the orbiting station is scheduled for May 31, 19 hours after launch.  The launch of the Falcon 9 with Crew Dragon was the first launch from the United States since July 2011.  Then NASA stopped independently sending astronauts into orbit in connection with the completion of the operation of the Atlantis spacecraft Space Shuttle program.  After that, the Americans were delivered to the ISS by Russian Soyuz ships.  The first test launch of Crew Dragon to the ISS without a crew took place in March 2019.  The cargo ship after the first test unmanned flight as part of a month-long mission to the ISS returned to Earth in early April

passages.title: SpaceX successfully launches manned space capsule
passages.passage: On Saturday, space exploration technology company SpaceX launched its first crew Dragon, a critical flight to prove to NASA the safety of astronauts in future flights.  The mission, called Demo-1, was launched on a Falcon 9 rocket from the Kennedy Air Center in California.  This space capsule does not carry a human, but a model of an astronaut called Ripley, wearing sensors to measure various indicators of the human body in the space capsule.  This is the first of two SpaceX test flights under NASA ’ s Commercial Crew Program. Demo-2 will be the first to fly with a human pilot, scheduled for July of this year.  According to NASA ’ s plan, SpaceX will be the first company to send astronauts into space since 2011.  NASA Administrator Jim Bridenstine later stated that the successful launch marked a new chapter in American excellence, bringing us once again closer to carrying American astronauts from American soil on American rockets.  Since the retirement of the Space Shuttle in 2011, the United States has been unable to use its own rockets to transport astronauts to space on its own. NASA is working with private companies to develop the future of human spaceflight.  Currently, SpaceX and NASA have a contract value of $2.6 billion, and Boeing is $4.2 billion.

passages.title: Roscosmos welcomed the launch of Crew Dragon
passages.passage: The launch of the manned spacecraft Crew Dragon opens a new stage in the world space program.  This statement was made by the Executive Director of the state Corporation “Roscosmos ” Sergey Krikalev.  “I would like to welcome our American colleagues.  [...] I am confident that the success of this mission will give us additional opportunities that will benefit the entire international program, "Krikalev said, a video posted on Roscosmos's Twitter account.  According to him, a new cycle of tests has begun - before the ship has already flown in an unmanned version, but today "an important and responsible option", when astronauts went into orbit.  "This opens a new stage in the manned program - the world manned program, the ISS program, where this ship flew, because we have new opportunities, new reserves," Krikalev said.  SpaceX launched the Demo-2 mission on its second attempt.  It became the first manned flight of a private spacecraft Crew Dragon, as well as the first orbital space flight launched from the United States since 2011.  The ship will take astronauts Bob Benken and Doug Hurley to the ISS.  The launch was an important event in the history of American astronautics.  The first reusable stage of the Falcon 9 rocket has already made a successful automatic landing on a floating platform in the Atlantic. passages.title: Tomorrow SpaceX will test the emergency rescue system of the Crew Dragon spacecraft in flight. This is the last major test before the first operational flight with astronauts on board
passages.passage: Tomorrow, January 18, SpaceX intends to make the final major test of Crew Dragon ahead of the long-awaited Demo-2 mission with the first operational flight of a crewed spacecraft to the ISS.  We are talking about those additional tests of the emergency rescue system (SAS) with the shooting of the capsule during the flight.  Of course, the launch will be broadcast online, and those who want to watch the broadcast will find it below in this note.  The carrier rocket itself with the ship is already installed at the site of the SLC-40 complex at Cape Canaveral and is waiting for the countdown; a suitable launch window for the launch of the rocket opens on January 18 at 15: 00 Kyiv time.  SpaceX will have four hours to conduct the launch; assess the weather conditions as favorable and state that the probability of a successful launch is 90%.  Falcon 9 and Crew Dragon went vertical and the crew access arm was extended last night ahead of tomorrow's in-flight demonstration of the spacecraft's launch escape system.  The four-hour launch window opens at 8: 00 a.m.  EST, 13: 00 UTC → https: / / t.co / gtC39uBC7z pic.twitter.com / dS6R3hCgZi — SpaceX (@ SpaceX) January 17, 2020 These tests are not a mandatory part of NASA ’ s Crew Dragon certification program, but SpaceX on its own initiative intends to conduct them to demonstrate the reliability of the SAS and even donate one Falcon 9 rockets - for the purity of the experiment with simulated accident, it is likely to be destroyed during the flight, and the capsule soon after firing parachutes and splashdown in the ocean.  The animation for tomorrow ’ s launch can be seen below.  @ SpaceX's uncrewed in-flight abort test is targeted for 8am ET on Jan. 18.  This test will show that the # CrewDragon can protect astronauts even in the unlikely event of an emergency during launch.  Currently, weather is 90% GO for the demonstration.  https: / / t.co / PgHZol6PQA pic.twitter.com / kWCq7IHiq1 — NASA Commercial Crew (@ Commercial _ Crew) January 15, 2020 Recall that the Crew Dragon ship is equipped with two types of propulsion systems (low and high pressure).  The first with sixteen Draco engines is designed for orbital maneuvers and orientation of the ship in space, and the second with eight SuperDraco engines is responsible for shooting and controlled landing of the rescue capsule in case of an emergency.  The first Pad Abort Test simulated a rocket crash before launch and shot off the capsule from the launch pad SpaceX held back in 2015, and at the end of the year passed static tests of the emergency rescue system Crew Dragon in a new configuration with rupture diaphragm valves in the pressurization tubes instead of titanium valves.  The improvement should prevent the very possibility of a repeat of the scenario that led to the crash in April.  Also not so long ago, in preparation for the Demo-2 mission, SpaceX successfully tested new parachutes for Crew Dragon.  A few weeks ago, Elon Musk shared a video with computer animation of the first manned flight of the Crew Dragon spacecraft to the ISS.  It is hardly worth saying how important for SpaceX and the entire world of cosmonautics is this launch, to which SpaceX has been going for eight long years.  Recall, Crew Dragon is being developed as part of NASA ’ s program to stimulate the development of private ships Commercial Crew Development to send American astronauts to the ISS and ensure independence in this matter from Russia.  After the closure of the Space Shuttle program in 2011, the only means of delivering crews to the International Space Station are the Russian Soyuz spacecraft.  It is noteworthy that on January 20, SpaceX plans to carry out the next launch of Falcon 9, sending into orbit another batch of 60 satellites as part of its own project of a global satellite Internet network of a new generation.  This year, SpaceX plans to begin providing communication services to its first customers, and full network deployment is scheduled for the mid-2020s.  In total, in 2020, SpaceX plans to make from 35 to 38 launches, of which at least 24 in the interests of the Starlink project.
