Title: What is Turkey looking for with the ‘ establishment ’ security series?
Content: What is Turkey looking for with the ‘ establishment ’ security series?  Turkish affairs expert Beryl Akmal, BBC monitoring 57 minutes ago image source, TRT Description of the picture, the organization is broadcast from the Turkish state television network Tarti, a television series that aired in Turkey in March and praised the Turkish intelligence and security agency, has become a popular program.  The series has attracted attention due to its many parallels with Turkey ’ s sharp foreign policy and nationalist rhetoric.  The series "The Establishment", broadcast on the state television network TRT, focuses on the missions of the National Intelligence and Security Agency (MITT) forces who want to return the security documents related to the stolen drone program to the country.  The series reportedly shows pictures of the new headquarters and has received positive feedback among the public.  However, critics say the series has an "informational" function.  The establishment is the latest in a popular series that opens a window into the world within Turkey ’ s ruling circles, as Ankara tries to strengthen its international power.  What is the story?  The series revolves around the operation to protect Turkey from a shadowy global network that tries to turn the world against Turkey ’ s ambitions.  A group of agents is responsible for returning documents related to the drone program to the country.  Image source, TRT1 Image Description, is the villainous Fadi in the series, whose plan is to curb Turkey ’ s ambitions; Zayed Fadi is the villainous and villainous character who is a member of the “Company ” group.  The pro-government Yeni Shafagh newspaper wrote that Fadi was an allusion to Mohammed Dahlan, the ouster and former leader of the Palestinian Fatah movement.  Fadi ’ s background is reminiscent of Dahlan, both Palestinians who grew up in refugee camps.  It is said that Dahlan was known as Abu Fadi.  Dahlan has long been on the Turkish government ’ s hate list.  The Turkish government has placed him on the "Most Wanted Terrorist List", which includes those accused of involvement in the July 2016 coup.  Images of Turkish drones appear throughout the series.  Turkey-made drones have attracted global attention in recent years and have been used in Libya, Iraq and Nagorno-Karabakh.  Image source, TRT Image caption, Turkish-made UAVs are frequently shown in the series, showing UAVs flying over northern Iraq, and emphasizing their use in operations against Kurdish forces.  In one episode of the show, Fadi said, “I can ’ t wait to see [the faces of the Turkish forces] being shocked by the drone crash. ”  The series also advertises Turkey ’ s efforts to build military hardware.  On March 23, Ismail Demir, head of defense industries, posted a video showing the conversation, talking about Turkish-made military technology that has developed despite foreign sanctions and promised that Turkey will build domestic fighters.  He said, “Don ’ t hesitate for a moment, we ’ ll do it. ”  The “terrorism ” of Turkey ’ s overseas operations is a central theme in the series, with“ terrorists ” among the evil forces working with Fadi.  The sixth episode shows a clash between "terrorists" and Turkish forces in northern Iraq, and the seventh episode shows a militant who vows to avenge his friend who was killed by Turkish forces.  The final episode of the series is an allusion to Eren Belbel, a boy who was said to have been killed in northern Turkey in 2017 by the "illegal" Kurdish Workers' Party (PKK).  See: Turkey 's booming TV series industry. To play this file please enable JavaScript or use another browser.  Turkish TV series are popular around the world, and this episode shows agents sitting next to a young boy named Eren on a plane.  He said: “The Yankees have always been very brave.  You are always very brave.  Thank you for being with us, Erin. "  The PKK has been fighting the government for decades for greater autonomy for the Kurdish minority in Turkey.  The party is on the list of terrorist organizations in Turkey, the United States and the European Union.  Turkey has carried out several operations against the group in northern Iraq.  In January, the Turkish Interior Ministry announced the start of "Operation Ern" against the PKK "in memory of Ern Nightingale, who was martyred by the separatists of the terrorist organization."  The foreign policy of Mitt ’ s characters repeatedly underscore the importance of patriotism as they fight the opposition.  In the opening scene of the first episode, neo-Nazis in Germany lead the attack on a house owned by Turkish immigrants, leaving Mitt's future agent Sardar orphaned.  The source of the image, TRT explaining the picture, the attack on Turkish immigrants in a scene from the series apparently refers to the Salingen attack.  The incident probably refers to the 1993 Salingen attack when a group of extremists set fire to a house and killed five Turks.  A diplomat promised to bring Sardar to Turkey after the raid.  When Sardar says he has no one, the diplomat replies, “You have your country. ”  The camera then focuses on the diplomatic ring, which has an image of the Turkish flag engraved on it.  The series ’ tenth episode, after a character asks about Turkey ’ s presence in Syria, focuses on Turkey ’ s military policies in the region.  “What are Italy, France, the United States and Russia doing there?  What is China doing there? ”  Another officer, referring to the Ottoman period, added: “The place we call Syria has been a part of the motherland for the last 100 years. ”  The comments echoed what Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan said in March 2020: “They ask what Turkey is doing in Syria.  But they don ’ t ask other countries that question. ”  The ninth episode shows a conversation between two agents and a local man in the Greek city of Kozani, reflecting the Turkish government ’ s criticism of the Greek government.  The man says, “They [the Greeks] don ’ t want us to have the rights of minorities.  Everyone is working to take children away from their own language, religion and culture. ”  Western Thrace Muslims in Greece are the cause of tensions between Turkey and Greece, and Ankara often accuses Athens of violating minority rights.  The impact of the series has attracted attention on social media and social media.  Image source, TRT Image Explanation, Artoghrol Uprising, is a historical representation of the T.R.T. network, which gained worldwide fame, the hashtag series Enterprise often trended on Twitter and drew significant reactions on Facebook.  According to an analysis by social media outlet Khuros, more than 620,000 tweets with the hashtag were posted between the first episode of the series in March and the last episode in June.  Each episode had more than three million viewers on YouTube, and people made passionate comments about it.  One of the comments at the bottom of the last part reads: "[This message] was sent throughout the whole series: Don't go head-to-head with the Turkish government."  High-ranking security expert Mathew Yarar praised the series for showcasing the “advances ” of the Turkish intelligence agency, the technology used in warfare and covert operations.  But some critics discredited the series as a "propaganda" series.  One user wrote, “This series is entirely a propaganda series for the ruling Justice and Development Party. ”  TV critic Sina Kluoğlu in the Milliat newspaper added: “Advertising in this type of series is natural.  The point is that it should be done cautiously. ”  Internationally Benefit?  Formation is one of several T.R.T. series that deal with national and religious issues in parallel with the government ’ s vision.  The series, centering on its story, the founder of the Ottoman Empire, gained international fame with its religious flavour and heroic stories.  The recently released “Bir Zamanlar Kibris ” depicts attacks on the island ’ s Gravey-Turkish family in 1963 before Turkey ’ s controversial intervention.  The upcoming series of Barbaros (named after the Ottoman admirals Barbaros Kheiruddin Pasha) is a narrative to highlight the heroes of the Ottoman Navy, which coincides with Ankara ’ s naval and war policy as “The Blue Homeland ”.  Tarti General Manager Ibrahim Ehren said: “We always put our finger on scripts and products that support the country ’ s history, culture, ethics and human values and we will continue to play that role.  Many of our products have attracted the attention of international viewers in recent years.

Title: The first round of turkeys didn ’ t stop.
Content: While the coronavirus outbreak stopped imaging Turkish series, some of these series continued to work in a new way.  According to ISNA, the Al Jazeera website has reported on how to continue shooting Turkish series that broadcast with a short distance.  The report said that some production groups of Turkish series used a new method to continue shooting their series.  In this way, some parts were filmed in the home of the actors and with the camera of their mobile phones, and without violating the rules of the home quarantine, the desired parts were prepared for broadcast.  The series “Eighties ” and“ Let ’ s Go ” continue to air, reaching audiences both inside and outside Turkey.  In the new episodes, these series also deal with the coronavirus.  In the final episode of the series "Forbidden Apple", before its broadcast temporarily stops, one of the actors of the series, while sitting in a taxi, has used a disinfectant and is worried about the coronavirus.  This is the first scene of the Turkish series that deals with the issue of Corona.  In an episode of the “Miracle Doctor ” series, there is mention of a dangerous virus that has entered Turkey through an East Asian traveler, but the name of the coronavirus is not mentioned.  Turkish actors these days have shared pictures of themselves on social media and in various places have been wearing masks and gloves to warn against the spread of the coronavirus.  The comedy series "Tranquility Neighborhood" has dedicated parts to the coronavirus and the importance of prevention in order to reduce the spread of the virus and how to spend free time during the quarantine.  The series, which explores various social issues with humor, now continues through shooting on mobile phones and in the actors ’ own homes.  Gülce Biersel, author of the series, said: “Shooting on mobile phones and in the actors ’ homes was a new exercise that taught us a lot, but some of the things that are necessary for a comedy show, such as walking, running, and certain body movements, can ’ t be done.  It had to be filmed in a consistent manner.  He added that turning each actor ’ s home into a suitable location for filming was difficult.  We asked them to send us a picture of their house.  The show has 11 actors, all of whom it was difficult to coordinate, but with the effort of the actors, we overcame the technical hurdles and got the job done.  Turkish actor Genghis Buzghorud said on Twitter: “The idea of having mobile phones in our homes was Jali ’ s idea.  I welcomed it as an initiative and set up a tent in my backyard for photography.  Mohammad Oymak, president of the Association for Culture and Literature, also welcomed the idea and expressed hope that the scenes filmed in the actors ’ homes would convey happiness and hope to the viewers.  In particular, this idea has been realized through extensive efforts and cooperation between actors and their technical staff and their Internet communication.  End of message.

Title: Turkey's hot markets in South America
Content: Turkish television series now reached South America after capturing the film market of the Indian subcontinent, the Middle East, the Caucasus, Central Asia and the Balkans.  In South America, Chile, Argentina and Mexico are among the biggest customers of Turkish TV series.  The popularity of Turkish series in the Middle East or the Caucasus may be due to cultural and historical commonalities, but what could be the reason for the booming Turkish series market on the other side of the Atlantic in South America?  Tuggs Shaw, a German broadcaster, has been trying to answer this question in a report on the popularity of Turkish shows in South America.  Yamaj Okur, producer of the Çukur story series, which has been translated into Persian as “Gut ”, says that a 140-minute episode will be produced every week, which will be broadcast on Turkish television five days later.  The Trench series is currently one of Turkey ’ s most successful series.  It tells the story of a family who controls one of Istanbul ’ s most dangerous neighborhoods, the Pit.  The neighborhood has long been in the hands of small families, whose most important rule is to be strict about the distribution of drugs in the neighborhood.  If someone spreads drugs, they have to leave the neighborhood.  The first episode of the series premiered on October 23, 2017 on TV and is still ongoing.  Correspondents from Istanbul and Rio de Janeiro say the demand for Turkish TV shows has increased.  Diazis, or series, forms a separate genre on Turkish television that is more comparable to the well-known South American telenovelas.  Araya Kisternas, a Chilean couple who have been married for almost 50 years, has just discovered their love for Turkish TV shows.  They say they show love with respect in this series.  The looks are romantic and traditional families are portrayed as important and valuable.  The Chilean couple have a herd that "in modern South American nostalgia traps shows a lot of bare limbs, men kiss men, and violence is part of the film."  Juan Vicente, director of the Chilean TV channel Mega, brought the first Turkish series to South America seven years ago.  He recalls that when the show “Binbir gece ” was broadcast on the mega network, he enthralled people and saved the mega network from bankruptcy at the time.  Juwan goes on to say that since many South Americans are conservative and dream of an ideal world, Turkish TV shows are in their best interest.  Family structures in Turkey are comparable to those in South America.  The patriarchal structures with a strong grandfather or father who determines and leads everything in the family are similar to the Chilean family structure.  The traditional family structure is also popular in Turkey, thanks to Erdoğan ’ s conservative and Islamist government.  Thousands took to the streets in recent days to protest Turkey ’ s withdrawal from the Convention against Violence against Women, but the protests have not been successful so far.  Yamaj Okor, producer of The Pit, says sex, swearing, alcohol in movies and TV shows are as taboo as they were in the '90s.  Okor added, “We have to tell our stories more gently, otherwise the TV won ’ t play it. ”  The series as Turkey ’ s “soft power ” is different from most Turkish series that depict the glamorous life of the middle and upper classes.  In this series, usually luxury cars, expensive clothes are displayed.  But the hole has a different atmosphere.  The series is filmed in the Balat district of Istanbul.  In the Balat district of Istanbul, which used to be home to Jewish, Armenian and Greek communities, it is now a simple working-class area, but thanks to the series, the neighborhood has now flourished and many cafes have opened in its corners over the past few years.  Tagus Shaw reports that at any given time during filming, about 200 fans of the Pit series gather at the scene.  On the other hand, vendors are trying to sell their goods, and in the future, visitors to South America are likely to be seen in the narrow alleys of Balat.  The series was recently sold to Chile.  The Chilean couple who are fascinated by the film are also planning a trip to Turkey.  Hector said: “A trip to Turkey would be a dream for us. ”  His wife, Patricia, interrupts him: “In the past, we never had any idea of Turkey.  We knew a Turkey full of violence with terrorist attacks.  But now it seems to be getting better. ”  Turkey ’ s $1 billion in revenue has become the world ’ s second-largest TV series exporter after Hollywood.  Recent research by Turkish state television shows that Turkish dramas are a “soft power, ” often trying to convey a specific image in the form of a romantic historical drama from the Ottoman period, which is usually reflected in the politics of the current Turkish government.  Follow Deutsche Welle on Instagram: “We are exporting Turkish culture, language and products.  Many of them just became popular abroad through our series.  Take, for example, Turkish music, which is now popular in South America. ”  According to estimates by the Turkish film industry, the revenue of the series could reach $1 billion by 2023.  At the end of his report on the Turkish series, Tagus Shaw has written that the next goal of the Turkish series is to capture the film market in Spain and Italy.

Title: Home show, competitor or second branch of Turkish networks?
Content: According to the Cinema Zone, the cultural group of the Young Journalists Club, with the increasing influence of satellite networks among Iranian families, one of the most significant damage that was mentioned for these networks was the cultural impact of the works broadcast by these networks, especially the Turkish series dubbed.  The series, based on the family as the central subject, provided sexist, pornographic, aristocratic and corrupt narratives of Turkish families, which due to the visual and sexual attractions, these series were able to tell stories of love triangles, betrayal, class divisions, anti-family, mere pleasure and corruption in the context of melodrama to many audiences with their own.  The increase in the activity of satellite networks and the distribution of Turkish works in Iranian satellite networks coincided with the increase of activities in Iran ’ s home theater network; at that time, some cultural analysts considered the home theater network as a reasonable response to satellite networks and an opportunity to overcome their works, a network that had less audits on its works and could attract the audience of Turkish TV series.  But that ’ s where the mistake started.  Many of the programmers and artists who were born and raised by the IRIB moved from television to the home theater network in order to gain more profit and freedom.  This, more than ever, left the hands of the cultural authorities of the IRIB empty to produce attractive and popular works and caused the TV audience to collapse.  On the other hand, less monitoring of the home screen network caused the creators active in this network, instead of presenting a new form and production of a cultural product, to resort to repetitive and sexual formulas of Turkish series and, with a glance from the rival, produced works that even in some cases, had lower quality and content than their Turkish rivals, and even caused some Iranian families to protest against some of these works.  Works that were only economical and did not spare any effort to sell more, from unnecessarily stretching the story, music-based video clips and creating triangular and square love nodes to the inclusion of erotic sequences.  Content works that, as a cultural commodity, had a countercultural function and only filled the pockets of its creators.  This is something that even the creators of these works are aware of.  From Manouchehr Hadi, the director of the love and romance series, who himself has confessed to modeling the Turkish series, to the writer of the series Dell, who says that the reason for the increase in the series' episodes is more money.  Now, some time after increasing the activity of VOD and attracting the audience through free subscription services and attractive plans to sell the works of the home theater network at a lower price than physical broadcasters and strengthening their position among the families as a multimedia and video broadcaster, in their latest action, they have dubbed and broadcast exclusive Turkish series.  The home theater network and VOD, which were supposed to rival Turkish satellite and TV channels, have now become their second branch.  Their cultural and content performance shows that the lack of proper supervision of the production of cultural works and the transfer of the field to individuals who are concerned only with financial interests, not cultural ones, provides the way for cultural influence and the destruction of the cultural foundations of the country and Iranian families.  Now that we are living in the era of the soft cultural war, the abandonment and lack of supervision in the field of cultural production can cause irreparable damage to our country; therefore, it is recommended that we not leave the field of culture to the enemy, by increasing the controls on the production of cultural works in the home theater network, and by producing great cultural works, such as Mokhtarnameh, the lost innocence, Hazrat Yusuf, English Kiev, Imam Ali, zero degree Hats off and...  We ourselves become the issuer of TV series, not the importer of Turkish serials, which can leave Iranian families with many cultural problems.  Author: The End of the Message

background: I work for a tech company that may be involved in future expeditions to Mars. Our task is to determine whether it is possible to create a sustainable atmosphere for Mars expeditions.
title: Oxygen-generating experiment on Mars

passages.title: New Discovery to Survive on Mars
passages.passage: A new experiment conducted by researchers at the University of Bremen in Germany has shown for the first time that a type of bacteria called Anabaena cyanobacteria, or blue and green algae, can thrive in Martian atmospheric conditions, allowing it to survive on Mars.  Astronauts on Mars need oxygen, water, food, and other consumables.  So this is a significant development, as it makes it very easy to create sustainable biological systems supporting life.  Scientists have found that despite the low pressure, cyanobacteria can use gases in the Martian atmosphere, at low pressure, as a source of carbon and nitrogen.  These materials can be replicated by suspending Martian dust in water, which makes it possible for them to be used as food for other living organisms.  The researchers believe that cyanobacteria could use gases in the Martian atmosphere, with low overall pressure, as a source of carbon and nitrogen.  Cyanobacteria, or jelbecks, are a group of organisms that, like plants, make different materials from sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide, and in scientific terms, they are called phototrophs.  Unlike plants, these organisms have tissue structures that increase life expectancy on Mars.

passages.title: Oxygen and hydrogen on Mars proposed to get from brine
passages.passage: Scientists have developed a method for producing oxygen and hydrogen from a liquid saline solution in Martian lakes using electrolysis.  A feature of the experiment was the use of lead-ruthenium oxide as an electrocatalyst for oxygen production.  The production of oxygen using such an installation was 25 times more energy efficient than in the case of MOXIE, launched to the Red Planet as part of the Mars 2020 mission, and the size and weight of the device for life support based on the described technology will be less than that of analogues.  The article was published in the journal PNAS.  Conditions on Mars are far from favorable for humans: the atmosphere is rarefied and 95 percent consists of carbon dioxide, and temperature changes exceed 100 degrees Celsius with an average temperature of minus 63 degrees.  Therefore, colonization of the Red Planet is impossible without the creation of a life support system that would be able to provide people with oxygen for breathing and fuel (for example, hydrogen) for energy supply and, ideally, return flight.  To solve the first problem, NASA created MOXIE (Mars Oxygen ISRU Experiment) - an experimental installation for obtaining oxygen from atmospheric carbon dioxide by electrolysis.  To test the effectiveness of such a method in the field, the installation became part of the Mars Rover Perseverance, which was launched on July 30, 2020 as part of the Mars 2020 mission.  An alternative source of not only oxygen, but also hydrogen on Mars can be water, the first direct evidence of the existence of which on the red planet was obtained in 1971.  Particularly attractive for use in applications, however, would be the reserves of salt water, impurities in which would allow it to remain in a liquid state even at low temperature and pressure.  The first traces of such brine (liquid salt solution) with magnesium perchlorate as the main component were found on Mars in 2015, and in 2018, a reservoir with a diameter of about 20 kilometers was found under the polar ice of the planet, which could have been formed due to volcanic activity.  Later, planetary scientists confirmed that such lakes on Mars really exist and can be numerous.  Now Pralay Gayen (Pralay Gayen) from the University of Washington in St. Louis together with colleagues created an installation for obtaining oxygen and hydrogen from a saline solution close in composition and temperature to that in Martian lakes.  As a brine in the experiment, a solution of magnesium perchlorate in water with a concentration of 2.8 mol per liter was used, cooled to minus 36 degrees Celsius and blown by carbon dioxide (the latter played the role of the Martian atmosphere).  As an electrocatalyst for the production of oxygen, the scientists used lead-ruthenium oxide Pb2Ru2O7-δ, the effectiveness of which they previously showed for alkaline solutions.  The electrocatalyst for hydrogen production was platinum on activated carbon - the standard catalyst in this case, and a commercially produced anion-exchange membrane was used as a separator.  Installation diagram.  In the red region, oxygen is produced, in the blue - hydrogen.  Image source: Pralay Gayen et al. / PNAS In the course of the study, scientists showed that lead-ruthenium oxide as an electrocatalyst is indeed several times more effective than the ruthenium oxide commonly used in such installations.  After the behavior of the created installation was studied in a wide range of temperatures from − 36 to 21 degrees Celsius and saw no radical fluctuations in the efficiency and rate of production.  The current output of the experimental installation was 70 percent, and the energy efficiency was in the range between 36 and 70 percent (depending on the voltage applied to the plates).  In addition, the installation was resistant to degradation of the catalyst: scientists were not able to find traces of ruthenium in the solution after 300-minute operation of the device.  The rate of production of oxygen (blue dots) and hydrogen (red dots), depending on the density of the cathode current.  Image source: Pralay Gayen et al. / PNAS Also, the researchers compared the achieved rate of oxygen production with MOXIE values of 10-22 grams per hour: it turned out that with the same energy supply, the created installation produces 25 times more oxygen than the experiment on the Mars Rover “Perseverance ”.  To have the same rate of oxygen production as MOXIE, the device would have to have electrodes with an area of ​ ​ 28-62 square centimeters, and to ensure the vital activity of a sleeping and actively moving person, this parameter would have to be 375 and 1235 square centimeters, respectively.  At the same time, the mass and volume of the installation will be less than if you use the technology inherent in MOXIE.  Moreover, the developed method of obtaining oxygen does not require its subsequent purification, while during electrolysis in MOXIE, carbon monoxide is also produced, which must be filtered.  Dependence on the power consumption of the rate of oxygen production of the installation (blue line), as well as its capes and volume to ensure various modes of human life (black lines).  The blue dot is the power and rate of oxygen production at MOXIE.  Image source: Pralay Gayen et al. / PNAS Previously, we talked about another method of obtaining oxygen from carbon dioxide in the Martian atmosphere (like MOXIE): scientists proposed to do this using low-temperature plasma.  And what is the role of the Mars Rover “Perseverance ” in addition to checking the method of oxygen production, you can read in our material“ Mars, there and back ”.  Nikita Kozyrev

passages.title: A million people will live on Mars!
passages.passage: Currently, there are almost 50 projects of manned flights to Mars.  The most grandiose of them belongs to the American engineer and entrepreneur Elon Musk, who plans to transport a million people to the Red Planet in the coming decades to create an independent civilization.  This idea seems absolutely fantastic – and meanwhile, the company Srace X, led by Mask, announced that very soon will begin the first flights of its space shuttles.  Go to the Red Planet!  At the International Astronomical Congress held in September 2016 in Mexico, the report of the engineer and entrepreneur made a real sensation.  According to Elon Musk, only the resettlement of a significant part of earthlings to Mars will save humanity from possible extinction.  Life on our planet can be interrupted by many factors: the explosion of a nearby supernova, superflares on the Sun, falling into a black hole, a global epidemic, a collision with a huge asteroid, a man-made disaster.  A large colony of people on another planet will ensure the continued existence of terrestrial civilization.  Why choose Mars?  Compared to other celestial bodies of the solar system, it is better suited for the possible life of earthlings.  The day here lasts 24 hours 37 minutes - that is, suitable for our residents and plants.  Gravity is much smaller than the earth, but is quite suitable for the normal functioning of the human body.  Finally, there is water – albeit in the form of polar ice caps, but it can be easily reached, and pieces of ice melt and use.  The rest of the planets of the solar system are practically unsuitable for such a mission: Mercury has extremely high surface temperatures during the day and very low at night, Venus has a too aggressive atmosphere, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune are mostly composed of liquefied gas.  The closest suitable celestial body to us is the Moon, but it depends entirely on the Earth and in the event of a space disaster may die with it.  Why is the number of one million people chosen?  According to experts, this is the minimum number of people so that their colony can become completely independent and develop.  It will have specialists of all the necessary professions, it will cope with possible diseases and epidemics, as well as ensure a stable natural population growth.  At first, the colonists will face the most difficult task - to turn the Red Planet into their home.  The set of actions to achieve this goal, Maek called the term “terraforming ” – that is, changing the conditions of life on another planet in such a way that they resemble earthly ones.  First of all, you need to melt a sufficient amount of ice at the south pole of the planet, since it will turn to the Sun in the summer, which means that it will be easier to do this than at the north pole.  The water accumulated here is enough to create an ocean several meters deep on the planet.  As the ice cap decreases, a chain reaction will begin - water vapor will begin to compact the atmosphere, which, in turn, will retain more solar heat, due to which the melting process will be more intense.  Technically, it can be launched using nuclear charges or placing laser devices over the south pole of Mars.  After liquid water appears on the planet, you need to start planting plants: initially it will be mosses, but later - vast forests that will saturate the atmosphere of Mars with oxygen (now it is 95% carbon dioxide).  According to Musk, the cultivation of “green lungs ” and the creation of a livable air without spacesuits will take from 300 to 1000 years.  But after that, the Red Planet can be considered terraformed, and people will choose where they live - on Mars or on Earth.  100 thousand flights Elon Maek listed the things and equipment that the first colonists needed.  First of all, these are devices for the production and conversion of energy - nuclear or space.  The most promising direction, the researchers of the company Srace X consider the delivery to Mars of a large number of light folding solar panels.  It will also require a huge amount of plants, both to create oxygen and to supply the settlers with food.  Until the atmosphere of the planet is formed properly, earthlings will need means of protection from solar radiation - after all, until this time, Martian cities will have to be under special domes.  First, the settlers will build small houses, then they will equip complexes, where there will be not only housing, but also schools, hospitals, shops, etc.  Experts Srace X calculated: one flight with the colonists should account for nine flights with payload.  It is based on a ship capable of carrying 100 passengers.  Thus, the total number of flights required to create a million colony on the Red Planet will be about 100 thousand (10 thousand - passenger flights, 90 thousand - cargo).  Elon Maek has already announced that the first expeditions for the delivery of goods should begin at the end of 2022.  By 2035, spacecraft will be built capable of reaching the Red Planet in 80 days, and a million colonists will arrive on Mars within the next few decades.  The main obstacle to the implementation of such a large-scale project, according to Musk and his team, is the high cost of a flight to the Red Planet.  In fact, it is steadily declining.  In 1989, the US national aerospace agency YABA estimated sending astronauts to Mars at $450 billion.  It was assumed that there will be from four to six earthlings — that is, each place was estimated at about $100 billion.  But already in 2004, the same agency reduced the cost of the project nine times — to $50 billion.  Thus, the flight of one person would cost a little more than 10 billion dollars.  This figure is still too high, but the trend towards its decline is clearly visible, and therefore such a task can be solved.  Elon Maek believes that the optimal amount for a flight of one person should be 500 thousand dollars – this is the approximate cost of a middle-class house in a good place.  Moreover, people should understand that they will become real space pioneers, the first permanent residents of another planet – and therefore must pay for their flight themselves.  Opinions of economists and psychologists are unambiguous: only in the United States there are at least a million people who will agree to pay such money for an unprecedented space travel.  But how to reduce the cost of flying each person from 10 billion to 500 thousand dollars, that is, 20 thousand times?  Elon Mayek knows the answer to that question.  Rocket from a private company Team plan Srace X works in two directions.  The first of these is the creation of spacecraft, each of which will be able to carry at least 100 people.  The company Ilona Mask has a successful experience in the construction of devices of a new type.  The engineer and entrepreneur himself says that the huge cost of missiles is primarily a consequence of the lack of competition and the presence of a huge number of subcontractors.  NASA constantly entrusts the execution of its orders only to a few companies.  For example, ULA (United Launch Alliance), a joint venture owned by Boeing and Lockheed Martin, regularly performs missions of the space agency and the US Department of Defense, but at the same time receives more for each launch than anyone else in the world.  Under the pretext of national security, the system of government orders in this area is completely opaque, and the task of many companies is not to reduce the cost of the spacecraft, but to make it more expensive for their own benefit.  In turn, having received the order, large companies transfer it in parts to small subcontractors, who also inflate prices.  But the main thing is that in the absence of competition, there is no need to invent something new!  As a result, the technology of modern spacecraft at best dates back to the 1990s, and the costs of their production and launch are declining extremely slowly.  SpaceX was the first company to start working on a fundamentally different scheme.  Not fulfilling an order, but creating your own device, cheaper and more reliable, which can then be offered to space agencies and organizations.  The company was founded in 2002 with the personal funds of Elon Musk, received from the development and operation of the largest electronic payment system in the United States.  The company created its first rocket, called the Falcon 1 (translated from English “falcon ”).  The two-stage vehicle and its engine were made by Space X workers without the help of intermediaries.  The first three launches ended in accidents.  But the fourth flight, which took place in 2008, was successful.  A cargo detachment simulation was conducted (it remained in the rocket so as not to increase the amount of space debris), and the first stage made a safe landing.  At the same time, Elon Maek, who was in the Mission Control Center at Cape Canaveral, heard the clap, ran out into the street in despair - he thought that this test ended in an explosion.  But it turned out that the sound was caused by the passage of the disconnected first stage of the rocket sound barrier.  The successful launch of the Falcon 1 cost $7.9 million – three times cheaper than the best alternative indicators. passages.title: Perseverance makes oxygen on Mars for the first time outside of Earth - Technology
passages.passage: NASA said today that the Mars rover "perseverance" continues to make history, yesterday successfully converted carbon dioxide into oxygen in the Martian atmosphere, the first successful oxygenation on another planet.  "Turning carbon dioxide into oxygen on Mars is a very important first step," said Jim Reuter, NASA's deputy director of space technology missions.  Perseverance uses the Mars Oxygen In situ Resource Utilization Experiment (MOXIE) built in front of its right and designed by MIT to produce oxygen. This car battery-sized gold box uses electricity and chemical properties to break down carbon dioxide molecules and successfully produce oxygen.  Since carbon dioxide is composed of 1 carbon atom and 2 oxygen atoms, the by-product of MOXIE's oxygen production is carbon monoxide.  MOXIE not only can produce oxygen for future astronauts to breathe on Mars, but also need not drag a large amount of oxygen from Earth as a propellant in the future, which is expected to pave the way for future human exploration.  MOXIE ’ s first score was to produce 5 grams of oxygen, equivalent to the amount an astronaut needs to breathe for 10 minutes of normal activity.  MOXIE was originally designed to produce up to 10 grams of oxygen per hour, and engineers will now conduct more experiments to try to increase production.  MOXIE is made of heat-resistant materials such as nickel alloys, which can withstand high temperatures of 800 degrees Celsius. The thin gold coating on the top ensures that it will not cause damage to the car ’ s Perseverance.  MIT engineer Michael Hecht said the one-ton version of MOXIE could produce about 25 tons of oxygen needed for a rocket to launch from Mars.  Since 96% of the Martian atmosphere is carbon dioxide, producing oxygen from the Martian atmosphere is much more feasible than extracting ice from the Martian surface.  (Translator: Zheng Shiyun / Authored by: Chen Chengyi) 1100422 (Central News Agency)

passages.title: NASA ’ s Mars Rover Perseverance will turn CO2 into oxygen on the planet
passages.passage: NASA ’ s Perseverance rover will turn CO2 into oxygen on the planet 09.08.2020, 20: 30, Miscellaneous NASA ’ s Perseverance rover, launched on July 30, equipped with a variety of advanced technological systems, will try to convert CO2 on the surface of the planet into oxygen.  This is a very important step towards detecting signs of life on Mars.  In translation, the name Perseverance means perseverance, perseverance.  The device was developed by specialists from the Jet Propulsion Laboratory of the California Institute of Technology.  In order to generate oxygen on the Red Planet, the rover was equipped with the experimental Mars Oxygen In-situ Resource Utilization Experiment or MOXIE.  The device was developed by scientists at the University of Massachusetts to produce from the atmosphere of the planet necessary for life gas.  Oxygen is very cumbersome for space transportation to Mars.  Experts doubt that the astronauts will be able to deliver it in the right number for people and refueling ships.  This problem will try to cope with the device MOXIE.

passages.title: Secrets of the Fourth Planet
passages.passage: 2050.  Humanity has finally become an interplanetary species, establishing a colony on Mars that is home to about a million people — more than Amsterdam or Athens.  This is not the beginning of a new science fiction novel or the plot of the film.  This is a vision of the future that Elon Musk recently shared.  The entrepreneur often paints the most fantastic scenarios, but one cannot blame him: it is not only him who is drawn to Mars.  Unfriendly neighbor Mars is not the most hospitable world, if you compare it with the Earth.  The force of gravity here is only 37.5% of the earth ’ s.  The temperature on the surface ranges from freezing -153 ° C to comfortable + 20 ° C.  However, a thin, unsuitable for humans atmosphere, consisting mainly of carbon dioxide, nitrogen and argon, is not able to effectively trap heat from sunlight.  If you were standing on the Martian equator at noon, your feet would have a temperature of + 24 ° C and your head would have a temperature of 0 ° C.  In addition, the pressure on the red planet is much lower – even at the top of Everest on Earth, it is 50 times greater than on the surface of Mars.  However, these worlds have a lot in common.  Beneath our feet is solid land, the area of which is comparable to the land area on our planet, although Mars is about half its size.  The duration of the day, which is called soles, is 24.6 hours, and close to the Earth's angle of inclination of the axis of rotation (23.5 for the Earth and 25.2 for Mars) provides the world with pronounced seasons, which, however, last longer than ours.  For example, spring in the northern hemisphere lasts as much as 194 solas - this is the longest season on the planet.  But the main similarity of the planets remains in the distant past.  Numerous evidence points to the fact that Mars used to be warmer, had a denser atmosphere, and its surface was covered with water - the cradle of intelligent life on our home planet.  That ’ s why researchers are looking so closely at this harsh world.  The chances of life on Mars are slim.  For example, in 2018, a group of European scientists found signs of the existence of a liquid lake hidden 1.5 km below the surface of the southern polar glacier.  Microbes may exist in such a reservoir, but this is only a hypothesis that is difficult to test.  Therefore, scientists rely on the search for signs of the existence of a past life.  It may not sound so exciting, but even such a find will be colossal.  Otherwise, we will face a much larger scientific mystery: why the Earth gave life, and the neighboring world with the right conditions - not.  The race for Martian life began in the 19th century.  In 1877, the Italian astronomer Giovanni Schiaparelli looked through the telescope Mars, which no one imagined, and even made a map.  It depicted seas and continents, as well as an extensive network of lines, which the astronomer called channels.  The word itself prompted the idea of ​ ​ the man-made origin of these objects.  It was later established that the channels were an optical illusion, but the idea of the existence of the Martian civilization that built them was picked up by others.  Astronomers such as American Percival Lowell or Frenchman Camille Flammarion believed in the habitability of the Red Planet, and science fiction writers such as Edgar Burroughs and H.G. Wells.  Of course, this theory was not accepted by everyone, but it was not possible to test it for a long time.  That all changed in the 1950s.  After the launch of the first Soviet satellite in 1957 and the start of the space race, the views of the USSR and the United States quickly rushed beyond the Earth ’ s orbit and even the Moon.  Already in the 1960s, the first automatic interplanetary stations rushed to the Red Planet.  No one thought about landing or orbiters at that time.  AMS sent to other worlds had to fly by, trying to take as many pictures as possible and send them to Earth.  But this task was not easy either.  The first attempt to send a research apparatus to the Red Planet was made by the Soviet Union in 1960, but it, like many others after it, failed.  Soviet devices died, not having time to leave the orbit of the Earth, at best broke down in flight to Mars.  In 1964, NASA entered the game, but its debut was unsuccessful.  The second attempt was successful.  Mariner 4 arrived safely on Mars in 1965.  It flew about 10 thousand km above the surface of the planet and sent 22 photos to Earth.  These were the first images of Mars from such a short distance.  There were no channels on them, but scientists saw the craters decorating the Martian earth, and confirmed that the atmosphere of the planet consists of carbon dioxide.  NASA has been successful ever since.  Until the end of the decade, the agency launched two more AMS, which managed to take two hundred photos, as well as carry out measurements of the surface and temperature of Mars.  The first spacecraft to make a soft landing on Mars was the Soviet Mars-3, but on the surface it worked for a few seconds The Soviet Union caught up with the Americans only in 1971, but by that time the ambitions of local scientists and engineers had grown.  Just flying over the surface wasn ’ t enough.  In 1971, the Soviet Union sent to the Red Planet at once two AMS - "Mars-2" and "Mars-3", which included both orbiters and lander.  These missions have been successful.  Orbiters have been orbiting the planet for months, transmitting data.  As for the landers, one crashed during the landing, and the second successfully inscribed his name in history.  "Mars-3" was the first device to make a soft landing on the red planet, even if it worked in a matter of seconds.  1971 proved to be a fruitful year for the study of the fourth planet.  That year, the American orbiter Mariner 9 arrived, which not only took thousands of photos and made a map of 85% of its surface, but also helped to see the main attractions of Mars.  For example, data from Mariner 9 helped establish the height of Olympus, the tallest volcano in the solar system, which rises 25 km and the diameter of the base is 600 km.  And the NASA research apparatus helped to estimate the scale of the Mariner Valley - the famous system of canyons, which stretches for 4 thousand km along the Martian equator and crashes 7 km deep into the surface of the planet.  The system, named after the probe, is four times deeper and five times longer than the Grand Canyon on Earth.  The next breakthrough in the study of Mars was made only in 1976, when NASA delivered there two AMS - "Viking 1" and "Viking 2".  Like the Soviet Mars, they were equipped with orbiters and landers, but the Vikings were more successful.  They successfully placed in orbit and landed on the surface of the planet, having worked for more than one year.  The Viking 1 lander fell silent only in 1982, and even then after an erroneous command from Earth.  During this time, they replenished the Martian photo archive with tens of thousands of images, but most importantly - they conducted the first field experiments to search for traces of life.  Alas, they did not give a convincing "yes" or a definite "no", but still it was a breakthrough, since previously Mars was studied on the principle of "look, but do not touch".  "Vikings" involuntarily added fuel to the fire of the myth of the Martian civilization, when one of the orbiters sent a curious picture.  It showed a pile of stones, one of which was strikingly reminiscent of a human face.  NASA researchers immediately realized that this is a game of light and shadow, but the impressionable public began to build theories about the remains of an ancient Martian city that rests underground.  The tradition of looking for the usual forms in photos of the Red Planet is still alive today, and those who want to constantly find rodents and insects in the pictures.  But these are just illusions.  Face on Mars.  This image, taken in the AMC "Viking 1" 1976, refreshed the myth of the existence of a developed Martian civilization After the "Vikings" study of the red planet for many years stalled.  For two decades, the US and the USSR, and subsequently Russia, continued to send mechanical researchers, but the attempts were mostly unsuccessful.  A new breakthrough occurred in the second half of the 1990s.  In 1997, NASA delivered the Mars Global Surveyor orbiter to Mars, which helped make a revolutionary discovery: somewhere under the surface of a dead planet, water can still flow, the hunt for which continues to this day.  In the same year, the Pathfinder landed on the surface, which has not happened since the time of the Vikings.  But much more interesting was the cargo that Pathfinder brought with him.  With him on the planet arrived the first mobile research apparatus Sojourner, able to move on

passages.title: Astronomers: Venus may be habitable until mysterious event occurs
passages.passage: 2019-09-21 15: 46 [News / Roundup] Michael Way, a scholar at NASA ’ s Goddard Space Science Research Center, presented his recent research at the 2019 European Planetary Science Conference (EPSC-DPS) in Geneva, which shows that Venus may maintain habitable conditions for billions of years, but a mysterious event has suddenly changed the planet ’ s environment.  According to CNN, Venus, like other planets in the solar system, formed 4.5 billion years ago. Its current atmosphere is full of toxic gases and is 90 times thicker than the Earth's atmosphere, and the surface temperature is 864 degrees Fahrenheit (about 462 degrees Celsius), enough to melt lead, so that Venus is a place of death.  But Michael Weiss compared Venus to five climate simulations, each of which showed that Venus could support liquid water and temperate climates for at least 3 billion years, with temperatures as high as 122 degrees Fahrenheit (50 degrees Celsius) and as low as 68 degrees Fahrenheit (20 degrees Celsius), until some cause of release of carbon dioxide from rocks 750 million to 700 million years ago changed Venus ’ s climate.  Astronomers in the past thought that Venus was too close to the Sun to maintain liquid water on the surface, but all the simulations created by the Michael Weiss team found that the surface temperature of Venus allows liquid water to persist.  These simulations show that Venus underwent a rapid cooling phase after its formation, and the atmosphere began to fill with carbon dioxide, but if it is similar to Earth's evolution, the atmospheric carbon dioxide will be absorbed by the surface silicates, and the composition of the atmosphere gradually becomes a combination of nitrogen and a small amount of carbon dioxide and methane, providing stability.  However, a mysterious event about 700 million years ago caused carbon dioxide from the surface rocks of Venus to escape into the atmosphere and not be absorbed back, and such a large amount of carbon dioxide caused the greenhouse effect to get out of control.  Researchers believe that the mysterious event may be volcanic activity, because magma releases carbon dioxide into the atmosphere, and as the magma cools, the carbon dioxide can no longer be absorbed back to the surface, but the reasoning needs to be further proved.  Michael Wei said that the importance of this research is to re-understand the "Venus region", where the planet is still possible to maintain liquid water and temperate climate, and in the future, we will continue to explore the mysterious events in the end, the cooling rate after the formation of Venus, whether there is real water on the surface, carbon dioxide only once or more issues. passages.title: There is no life in the closest star system to Earth.
passages.passage: Alpha Centauri made a harsh verdict on whether there is life on exoplanets Alpha Centauri tried to find out American astrophysicists.  Scientists from the Georgia Institute of Technology and NASA conducted studies of the celestial bodies of the nearest star system to us.  Alpha Centauri is the closest to the Sun and historically the most known to mankind triple star system.  In the night sky it can be seen with the naked eye.  It was from there that scientists and science fiction writers expected to meet space caravans of aliens.  Astrophysicists from the Georgia Institute of Technology, together with NASA experts, conducted a series of studies of the star system in the hope of finding inhabited worlds.  With the help of modeling the orbits of the proposed exoplanets and the influence on them of the gravity of the three luminaries of Alpha Centauri, they were able to establish that the development of complex life depends mainly on the stability of the tilt of the axis of rotation of the proposed planet.  This largely depends on the stability of the climate, allowing the development of living organisms.  Our Earth in this sense can be considered almost a standard.  The axis is slightly inclined relative to the plane of the orbit and its oscillations are minimized due to the gravity of our satellite.  “If we didn ’ t have the moon, the tilt of the Earth ’ s axis could change by about 60 degrees.  Perhaps then the Earth would look like Mars, ” says study leader Billy Quarles.  Comparison of the history of the formation of the Earth and Mars, according to scientists, allows you to visualize the theory of the origin, and then the preservation of life.  The axis of rotation of our planet is relatively stable and inclined by 22-24 degrees.  But Mars, without such a large satellite balancer, every 2 million years changes the inclination of its axis from 10 to 60 degrees.  As a result, the condensate of the already rarefied Martian atmosphere from the white caps at the poles turns into a cold ice belt of the equator.  In such extreme conditions, the planet is simply not able to support the evolution of complex life forms.  That's the system Alpha Centravra scientists have made a harsh verdict - it is highly likely uninhabited.  There's good news, though.  According to astrophysicists, even if suitable exoplanets are not found near the Sun, they can be a little further, in other star systems, the number of which in the universe is infinite.  Andrey Sidorenko.  TV Center.

passages.passage: In the story, Soviet cosmonauts go to the aid of aliens who have suffered an accident near Mars.  Starring Otar Koberidze (left) and Boris Borisenok / A shot from the film “Dream towards ” / 1963 Roscosmos this year plans to study the question of how to change the human body at the level of genetic engineering for flights into deep space.  The project will involve the Institute of Biomedical Problems of the Russian Academy of Sciences (RAS), the Federal Biomedical Agency, as well as medical institutions of the Ministry of Health.  What is happening in the industry today and how to return our country to unconditional leadership in space, was understood by “Evening Moscow ”.  I think Yuri Gagarin would be disappointed if, having looked into the relatively near future, he found out that his country, which opened the door to a new world for humanity, stopped on the threshold and with incomprehensible politeness skips ahead of competitors.  On April 16, when we were still not cool off from the lush celebrations associated with astronautics Day, NASA signed a contract worth almost $3 billion, entrusting Space X with the development of the HLS Starship lander, which should take two astronauts to the moon, and a week later bring them home.  If such an agreement had been concluded in our country, it would have been a much more valuable contribution to the continuation of the Gagarin case than all the articles and films about the first cosmonaut taken together.  It is planned that Starship will replace the existing space transportation systems Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy and Dragon, which are also created by Space X.  The strategic goal of Starship goes beyond Earth and lunar orbits and involves a manned flight to Mars.  With the modernization of the ship in the future, its versions will be able to make interstellar flights.  One of the quick and obvious opportunities to cover costs is commercial suborbital flights within the Earth over long distances.  A hundred years ago, Mars was the cherished dream of the Russian man.  Red Count Alexei Tolstoy wrote a wonderful story about the Red Planet "Aelita".  Engineer Friedrich Zander, whose name is one of the Moscow streets, formulated a romantic motto: "Forward to Mars!"  Colonization of Mars was part of the schedule of space conquest, compiled by Konstantin Tsiolkovsky.  According to the main theorist of astronautics, the research base on the moon was supposed to appear in 2015.  The industrial development of Mars, as well as Venus and Mercury, is attributed to the sky-high distance - 2700.  In the atmosphere of romantic dreams and technological challenges, the genius of Sergei Korolev was formed, who in the early 1960s, even before the Americans, sent 5 spacecraft to Mars.  The first launches ended in failure, but in 1962, a Soviet satellite first approached the Red Planet and conducted important experiments.  Unfortunately, our dream of Mars has moved to America.  Previously, the descendants of the conquerors of the West looked at Mars with childish ignorance — like the way American tourists walk around Paris.  In 1938, a radio play based on Wells ’ book War of the Worlds caused widespread panic.  But now three American spacecraft are operating in the orbit of Mars, and two rovers are on the surface.  Elon Musk ’ s ambitions have matured in a competitive atmosphere.  In addition to NASA, plans for flights to Mars are hatched by private companies Lockheed Martin, Boeing, Sierra Nevada Corporation. frame from the film "The Martian" / 2015 The owner and chief engineer of the company Space X Elon Musk promises the first manned flight to Mars in 2024-2026 years.  And by 2050, according to his vision, a million earthlings will move to Mars.  Architectural bureaus are already creating projects of Martian dwellings, physiologists are thinking about the Martian diet, and biochemists are making plans to change the Martian atmosphere to acceptable parameters.  Almost inevitably, terrestrial settlers on Mars will feed on insects that will provide them with proteins.  Europeans to withstand such a diet will be extremely difficult, so with a high probability to master Mars will come from Asia.  Elon Musk understands that an expedition to Mars, which, under optimal ballistic conditions, will take 6 months in one direction, carries a huge risk.  The first colonists clearly will not be able to quickly (and perhaps never) return to Earth.  Musk said, “Are you ready to die?  If there is no problem with that, you are a great candidate! ”  However, the businessman himself is not going to Mars.  There is no doubt that when the time comes, there will be no escape from those who want it.  The first analysis of the expedition to Mars was made immediately after World War II by Werner von Braun, who at that time was sitting without a job, hiding the SS uniform and waiting for an invitation to the United States.  But these were theoretical quirks.  At the beginning of the space age, thanks to energy and dedication, the Queen of the USSR was the undisputed leader in interplanetary flights, having carried out a number of unique expeditions to the nearest celestial objects.  Unfortunately, gradually our attraction to the stars weakened.  I think this is largely due to the fact that cosmonautics ceased to serve as a propaganda argument in the dispute between the two superpowers.  Our interplanetary plans are modest.  2022 is a joint mission with Europe to Mars on our Proton M rocket and with the Russian Kazachok landing platform.  In 2021, we are going to launch the Luna-25 spacecraft with a lander.  The last flight of the machine to the moon took place in 1976.  Then there will be more machines.  And in 2030, Dmitry Rogozin promises a manned expedition to the moon.  Photo: twitter.com / roscosmos The success of Russian plans depends on whether it will be possible to bring to mind the family of missiles "Angara".  There are doubts about this, if only for the reason that work on “Angara ” has been underway since the 1980s.  One has to wonder how in five years Elon Musk managed to put into orbit the Falcon 9 rocket, which was trusted by space crews.  In addition, Elon Musk built a private spaceport Boca Chica in Texas, spending tens of times less money than we threatened on the “East ”.  And for some reason it was without astronomical embezzlement and avalanche of criminal cases...  Mars in the last decade has been the main object of attraction for spacecraft.  Currently, in the vicinity of the red planet are just three Earth apparatus.  The American mission Perseverance (Perseverance), during which on April 19 (a week after our Cosmonautics Day) on Mars for the first time flew a jet helicopter Ingenuity (Inventiveness) - 3 meters and 40 seconds of flight.  As well as a satellite from the UAE and a Chinese ship.  By the way, the Ingenuity helicopter did not become a pioneer in terms of independent movement in the atmosphere of another planet.  The first such cruise was made in 1985 by the Soviet apparatus Vega-1 in the atmosphere of Venus.  But this era has long passed...  The cost of the Perseverance mission is $2 billion.  If we take into account that the financing of the expedition was started 7 years ago, in terms of money it is quite possible for Roscosmos, whose annual budget even now, after several drops in the ruble, is equal to just $2 billion.  The scientific potential of Russian cosmonautics, despite all the problems, is still high and allows us to swing at the most difficult tasks.  Where are you, romantics?  Ilona Mask is often called an adventurer who feeds the public with chimerical promises.  Without in any way acting as his lawyer, I note that it is precisely such accusations that ordinary people threw at the great inventors and innovators.  From Archimedes to Tsiolkovsky, they walked in eccentrics, and many, like Korolev and Babilov, were innocent victims.  The phenomenon of Elon Musk is a contradictory mosaic, but for us two fundamental points are important.  First: Musk fuels public interest in science and serves as a magnet for attracting ambitious and curious young people to research.  We would like such popularizers, but they are not visible on our horizon.  And the second.  Elon Musk is the first private trader who came with his ideas in space.  This is a mandatory stage in the development of the industry, but in Russia, unfortunately, entrepreneurs do not look at the stars.  No one even went to space tourists.  They prefer to lie in a hammock on the grass at home.  Elon Musk / Photo: twitter.com / mfame _ guru Incidentally, 20 years ago Elon Musk came to Russia twice, but he was not yet a billionaire.  The self-confident young man offered cooperation in the creation of new rocket technology for manned flights with a distant eye on the Martian expedition.  Our officials considered the businessman a frivolous person, because they were confident that only the state could deal with space.  Musk also nudged and in record time created the Falcon 9, which was the first rocket with a retractable first stage.  In addition, Elon Musk ’ s Dragon ship

passages.title: Air & Space (USA): a million people on Mars? It is possible. But the colonists will have to change their diet and learn to eat crickets – Rambler
passages.passage: Air & Space (USA): a million people on Mars? It is possible.  But the colonists will have to change their diet and learn to eat crickets A self-sufficient population of a million people could appear on Mars within 100 years.  At first, 12 people will land there, after which numerous spacecraft should begin transporting passengers about once every 26 months.  But will humans be able to have children on Mars?  And how to solve the problem with nutrition?  A sustainable and self-sufficient population of one million people could appear on Mars within 100 years, according to a new study with modeling elements conducted by Kevin Cannon and Daniel Britt of the University of Central Florida.  In their study, they relied on a plan drawn up by Elon Musk of SpaceX.  To begin with, he planned a landing on the Red Planet of 12 people, after which numerous spacecraft should begin to carry passengers, from 100 to 200 people per flight, which will be carried out at each opportunity approximately once every 26 months.  Population growth will be ensured both by immigration and by the birth of children on Mars.  Cannon and Britt in their study show that four of the five main "consumables" necessary for Martian settlements (energy, water, oxygen and building materials) can be mined on the surface of Mars in sufficient quantities.  On Mars, only food can not be obtained from raw materials.  So how do we solve the food problem?  The authors propose to grow plants, breed insects and engage in meat cattle breeding of cellular genetic direction.  In the past, it was suggested to grow plants quite often, but it is very important to plant high-calorie crops in order to feed so many people.  Breeding insects is also very useful, as it will give a large number of calories per unit area.  For these purposes, homemade crickets are best suited, and they are already used in some cereal bars.  Protein-rich foods can also be obtained from cells grown in bioreactors.  Interestingly, fish on Mars will be more popular than cage-grown meat, because this culture can be preserved at lower temperatures (about 20 degrees Celsius), while warm-blooded animal cells need 37 degrees Celsius.  To me such ideas and extrapolations seem very intriguing.  But life on Mars may not be as easy as it seems, even if people will enjoy the fruits of technological progress.  Growing plants in Martian soil will be very difficult, because there are large amounts of chloric acid salt and other chemicals in sediments.  The same authors conducted another study on this topic, using soil close in composition to Martian.  Now: their plants died quickly, and earthworms suffocated in this land.  Biological factors must also be taken into account.  It is far from clear whether people will be able to easily give birth to children on Mars, because Martian gravity is only 38% of Earth ’ s.  The human body adapts to earthly conditions, and when the constant physical quantity is two-thirds less than usual, unexpected complications may occur.  Martian farmers may face other problems, including unfamiliar plant diseases that will destroy crops, causing hunger among the settlers.  The upside is that efficient and sustainable food production technologies on Mars can benefit many more people adapting to climate change on Earth, and therefore can prove invaluable to our entire civilization.  Musk ’ s idea of a million people living on Mars is unlikely to materialize in the near future.  But it ’ s becoming more real as NASA ’ s independent planetary protection watchdog recently issued new recommendations that could lead to a relaxation of sterility requirements when landing in certain areas of Mars where local life is unlikely to exist.  If people come to the Red Planet in passenger spacecraft to settle there, they will most likely settle in these places.  Air & Space (USA)

passages.title: Earth is attacking. What will China, the United States and the Emirates look for on Mars?
passages.passage: On the night of July 15, the UAE will send its first orbiter to Mars.  Also in July, the launch of their research missions planned by China and the United States.  What and how they will look for on the red planet, says Focus October 30, 1938, the United States was engulfed in mass panic.  People called newspapers and police stations, believing that the Earth had been attacked by the Martians.  This reaction was caused by the radio play of the novel by H.G. Wells "War of the Worlds", which the audience took at face value.  After almost 100 years, we know for sure that the Martians will not arrive, because they do not exist, and in general - if there is life on the Red Planet, then microscopic and well hidden.  Earth has been conquering Mars with varying success for more than half a century.  This year, humanity will make an unprecedented breakthrough towards the Red Planet: three countries will send research missions to it at once.  Hope Country: United Arab Emirates Start date: July 15, 2020  Arrival time: February 2021 Type of research vehicle: orbiter Mission duration: 1 Martian year (687 Earth days) Mission objectives: to provide a holistic picture of the Martian atmosphere and weather The times when space exploration was the monopoly of superpowers are long past.  Today, more and more countries and private companies are looking to the stars, and the United Arab Emirates seems to want to be among the pioneers.  The UAE may become the first Arab state to launch an interplanetary mission.  The UAE did not pursue a more ambitious goal of landing on the planet – in the history of Mars exploration, there were far more failed attempts to do this than successful ones.  Preferably confined to an orbital probe.  The research apparatus with a mass of 1.3 tons will make a full orbit around the planet every 55 hours, then approaching it for 20 thousand km, then moving away to 43 thousand.  On board, it will carry infrared and ultraviolet spectrometers, as well as a camera that can not only take pictures, but also shoot video in 4K resolution.  With the help of these tools, Arab scientists want to carefully study the Martian atmosphere, to understand the mechanisms due to which it loses much needed oxygen on Earth.  In addition, they are interested in the weather systems of Mars.  Thanks to the features of the orbit of the probe, they will be able to observe how the weather changes throughout the entire Martian days (24 hours).  38 minutes of Earth time) at one point or another on the planet.  This year, the UAE is sending a probe to Mars, and in 100 years they want to build a city there Data that researchers will receive during the mission will not settle in closed laboratories.  The UAE plans to share them with colleagues from 200 scientific institutions around the world in the hope that the new information will help to better understand the history and mechanisms of functioning of the Martian climate.  However, the Arab mission to Mars does not only pursue scientific goals.  Its organizers hope that the conquest of the neighboring planet will inspire young people and help educate a new generation of scientists and engineers - specialists who can prove that the Emirates is more than just a country with rich oil deposits.  “It is a matter of the future of the UAE and our survival, ” said Omran Sharaf, the head of the mission.  In the view of local scientists, Mars does play a significant role in the future, and perhaps in the survival of the state.  After all, they plan to build an entire city on the Red Planet within the next century.  With an eye on all this, it is obvious that for their first "scout" they chose the most appropriate name - "Al Amal", which means "Hope".  Question to Heaven Country: China Start date: July 23, 2020  Arrival time: February 2021 Type of research vehicle: Mars rover, orbiter and lander Planned mission duration: Rover - 90 sols (equal to 92 Earth days), probe - 1 Martian year (687 Earth days) Mission objectives: study of the magnetosphere, ionosphere and atmosphere of Mars, mapping of terrain, observation of dust storms, study of the composition of rocks and soil, mineral distribution Another debutant in the conquest of Mars will be China.  Local scientists decided to act on a much larger scale than their Arab counterparts.  They will send a rover, landing and orbiters to Mars.  The mission was named Tianwen-1 (Questions to Heaven) after a poem written more than 2,000 years ago.  Each machine has its own task.  For example, the probe, which will be located in the orbit of Mars, will study the geological structure and natural conditions of the planet, as well as transmit data to Earth.  On the lander lies perhaps the most important part of the mission - the actual delivery of equipment to Mars.  This process takes about seven minutes, but this time period is called “seven minutes of nightmare ”.  It depends on China whether it will have its own research apparatus on another planet or it will simply deliver a heap of expensive, high-tech garbage there.  China will name all missions to study other planets Tianwen ("Questions to the Sky") - after the ancient work of the poet Qu Yuan Landing will be broken down into four stages.  First, the aerodynamic brake will slow the device from 4.8 km / s to 460 m / s.  Then the parachute will open, which will reduce the speed to 95 m / s., and then reverse engines will go in the course.  They'll slow the lander down to 3.5 m / s.  The final stage of braking starts at a mark of only 100 m from the surface of the planet.  Ideally, it will end with a soft landing, after which the rover will smoothly move to the surface of the planet.  The first Chinese rover will be equipped with several scientific instruments, including a GPR.  With the help of this device, he will be able to literally look underground.  Earlier this year, this tool helped archaeologists without excavation to make a map of the ancient Roman city, which for many years rests underground.  The rover will not have to search for lost settlements, but he will be able to examine underground geological objects with the help of GPR.  As in the case of the Arab mission to Mars, the Chinese pursue not only scientific goals.  First, it will be a major test of the country ’ s technological achievements.  Secondly, it has a strong reputation subtext.  China already has a successful lunar program – in January last year, its Chang ’ e 4 research apparatus was the first in history to make a soft landing on the far side of the moon.  In early summer, the country launched the last satellite in its global navigation system, which will compete with the American GPS.  Conquering Mars will strengthen China ’ s position as the world ’ s leading space power.  Perseverance and resourcefulness Country: USA Start date: July 30, 2020  Arrival time: February 18, 2021 Type of research vehicle: Rover and helicopter Planned duration of the mission: 1 Martian year (687 Earth days) Mission objectives: search for traces of the existence of life in the past, collect samples, prepare for future missions with the participation of people In the conquest of Mars, the United States is the leader.  The local aerospace agency NASA was the first to deliver a research probe to the Red Planet, the first to land a lander there that lasted longer than a few seconds, its rovers were the first to wheel on the surface of another world.  Today, three of its probes orbit Mars, two more research vehicles are working on the surface of the planet, and soon they will be joined by another.  NASA will send a new rover Perseverance (“Perseverance ”).  The American space agency has a tradition, according to which the names for rovers come up with schoolchildren.  NASA did not deviate from it this time.  The name of the rover "Perseverance" was born in the head of seventh-grader Alexander Mazer, who believed that this feature of human character should be immortalized in it.  In an essay in which the student explained his choice, he noted that in the conquest of Mars, humanity can wait for many difficulties, but it is perseverance that will not allow him to give up and help move towards the goal, no matter what.  However, Perseverance can boast not only a loud name.  Despite its resemblance to Curiosity, which has been traveling on Mars since 2012, the new rover has the most modern technical equipment.  NASA calls Perseverance the most advanced of the rovers he created.  "There is every reason to believe that in the coming years Mars and all its secrets will become more and more understandable to the inhabitants of the Earth" Carl Sagan, astronomer He is equipped with a number of scientific tools that will help him monitor important meteorological indicators (humidity, temperature, wind speed, etc.), recognize the chemical composition of materials on the surface, consider objects the size of a grain of salt and look for organic compounds that would indicate the existence of Martian life in the past or have been exposed. impact of water.  In addition, Perseverance will be able to look under the surface of the planet using GPR and extract oxygen from carbon dioxide.  Finally, the rover will have
